articleTitle: Object Detection Based on YOLO Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Object detection based on the deep learning has achieved very good performances. However, there are many problems with images in real-world shooting such as noise, blurring and rotating jitter, etc. These problems have an important impact on object detection. Using traffic signs as an example, we established image degradation models which are based on YOLO network and combined traditional image processing methods to simulate the problems existing in real-world shooting. After establishing the different degradation models, we compared the effects of different degradation models on object detection. We used the YOLO network to train a robust model to improve the average precision (AP) of traffic signs detection in real scenes.

articleTitle: Improved dynamic load balancing algorithm based on Least-Connection Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, the commonly used load balancing algorithms are mainly round_robin and least_conn, but they do not take into account the constant changes of server performance over time. The paper on the basis of the Least-Connection Scheduling, proposes a dynamic load balancing algorithm, collection server static load factor and dynamic load factor to calculate the weight of the closest server real-time performance parameters, and then introduced the response time and the number of connections as statistics class load factor, finally calculated the current server load. By testing the built-in round_robin and least_conn strategies of Nginx and the dynamic load balancing strategies proposed in this paper, it is found that the improved load balancing strategy makes more efficient use of resources in the server cluster and improves the throughput and processing capacity of the system.

articleTitle: A Survey of UAV Visual Navigation Based on Monocular SLAM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional GPS/INS integrated navigation system has many limitations. The advantages of visual navigation with large information and precision, small coordinated interference and strong real-time performance are quickly called research hotspot. This paper introduces the basic steps and some key technologies of visual SLAM, and analyzes the difficulties in real-time and robustness of UAVs. Finally, it proposes some research directions of visual SLAM, including integrated navigation, improvement based on deep learning, semantic map and mitigation feature dependence.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Aero-engine Bearing Using a Stacked Auto-Encoder Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As an important part of the rotor system of the aero-engine, the bearing has always been the key site of fault. However, it is hard to monitor and diagnose the bearing's health state. In this paper, the authors used a deep learning methods of Stacked Auto-Encoder Network (SAE) to diagnose and classify the bearing faults, which have different varieties and different levels, basing on the bearing failure data obtaining by the bearing failure test bed. In this paper, the accuracy and convergence rate of SAE algorithm are studied by changing the sample length of the collected data and transforming the original time domain signal into frequency domain signal by fast Fourier transform (FFT). In the case of equal input, it is compared with Deep Believe Network (DBN), which is another method of deep learning. The results show that with the increase of the sample length, the diagnostic accuracy is also increased. And the diagnostic accuracy of algorithm which input data is frequency domain parameter is higher than the one which input data is by original time domain parameter. When the input data is frequency domain parameters, the diagnostic accuracy is up to 97%, and the algorithm is also more stable.

articleTitle: Research on Kinematic Modeling and Analysis Methods of UR Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Kinematic modeling and analysis is the foundation and focus of robotics research. In this paper, taking a 6 degrees of freedom (DOF) UR10 robot as the research object. Based on the homogenous transformation and screw theory, the kinematic modeling of the robot was performed with Denavit-Hartenberg (D-H) parameterization method and product-of-exponentials (POE) method respectively. In addition, the forward and inverse kinematics analysis are carried out based on the established kinematics models. Finally, the D-H parameterization method and POE method are compared in kinematic modeling and analysis, the advantages and disadvantages of the two methods are pointed out as well, which provide guidance for the modeling and analysis of a robot with specific configuration.

articleTitle: An anomaly detection model of user behavior based on similarity clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The ability to automatically detect anomaly user behavior to enhance system reliability is important for the system administrator. To achieve this objective, an anomaly user behavior detection model based on similarity clustering has been presented in this paper. The model consists of four components: data log collector, data log analyzer, profile storage and behavior detector. The data log collector is responsible of collecting the audit log of the system, and the data log analyzer executes a similarity clustering algorithm on the logs to establish the normal user behavior profile, which is stored in the profile storage. The behavior detector calculates the distance between the observing user behavior with the profile to determine whether the observing user behavior is anomaly. The algorithms of establishing profile and anomaly detection are also discussed in detail in the paper.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Battery Model Based on Forgetting Factor Recursive Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The accuracy of the lithium-ion battery model directly affects the reliability of the battery management system. Since the parameter values of the model vary with the operating conditions. Therefore, it is especially important to identify model parameters based on measured data. Based on the second-order RC equivalent circuit model, this paper uses the forgetting factor recursive least squares algorithm to realize the adaptive identification of battery model parameters. The comparison between the identification curve and the measured data shows that the recursive least squares algorithm with forgetting factor can fit the actual terminal voltage well, the calculation speed is fast, and the error of the identification result is small, which not only can guarantee the local identification accuracy, but also can achieve good identification effect for the whole.

articleTitle: Study on the temperature distribution of the outer surface of the cable intermediate joint based on ANSYS simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The cable intermediate joints is the weakest part of cable line, and the temperature is too high to lead to failure. But in practice, the temperature of cable connector core can not be measured directly. Therefore, the distribution of surface temperature is an important basis for us to judge the running condition of cable and its joints. In this paper, the geometric model of cable intermediate joints is established by using ANSYS software. The distribution of temperature field on the outer surface of cable joint is simulated by adding different boundary conditions. The surface temperature of cable joint under different ambient temperature is obtained, and in normal operation and cable core short circuit, existing gap and water droplet in the joint, the temperature distribution of the outer surface of the joint is obtained. Based on the simulation results, it is found that the outer surface temperature decreases gradually from the central position to the two sides, and every temperature gradients are uniformly distributed, when the cable joint is in an ideal and stable state; and when there are defects in the cable intermediate joint, the temperature distribution on the outer surface of the cable joint is not uniform, and the temperature on both sides of the cable joint is increased. This provides the theoretical basis for the on-line monitoring system of cable intermediate joint temperature.

articleTitle: Android Malware Classification using XGBoost based on Images Patterns
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet, mobile terminals gradually become the national basic information equipment. As the most popular mobile operating system, Android has many extr, emely serious security issues. In our wok, we extracted the dex file from the Android malware and visualized it as the image to extract features. Depend on the massive Android apps, we used XGBoost as the classification models to expand experiments. Compared with KNN, ET and GBDT, the XGBoost adopted the best classification effect, reaching the 99.14% accuracy and the 99.10% recall. The experimental results testing on a malware sets containing 10 families demonstrate that XGBoost has the excellent performance for Android malware classification.

articleTitle: DC-Link Voltage Fluctuation Reduction of Vector Controlled PMSM Drives with Reduced DC-Link Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In some applications, to increase the system power density and lower the system cost, the dc-link capacitance of PMSM drives needs to be reduced. However, such practice may cause considerable dc-link voltage fluctuation. In this study, a method is proposed to reduce the dc-link voltage fluctuation. By adjusting the sixth harmonic component of the inverter dc-link current, the proposed method can indirectly lower the dc-link capacitor current, thus reducing the dc-link voltage fluctuation. Compared with other voltage fluctuation reduction methods, the proposed method is independent of a controllable front-end rectifier, and it does not require any motor parameters. The simulation results show that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: Parameter Design Method of a Series-parallel Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: LCC series-parallel resonant converters with single-capacitor filters enable soft switching over the full load range, but with outstanding nonlinear characteristics, adding to the difficulty of analysis and design. Based on the improved fundamental approximation method, the high-frequency transformer, The secondary rectifier and the output filter capacitor are equivalent to a complex impedance as a whole, and the equivalent circuit model of the LCC series-parallel resonant converter is established, and discusses the circuit characteristics of the converter on the basis of the equivalent circuit. The influences of key circuit parameters such as input impedance angle and secondary rectification turn-off angle on the steady-state characteristics of the converter are pointed out, and a parameter design method for limiting the input impedance angle is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on SDN Load Balancing based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Network load balancing is one of the important methods to manage resources. Through network load balancing technology, both system resource utilization and system performance can be improved. This paper presents a Joint Load Balancing Algorithm based on Software Defined Network. The algorithm proposed in this paper not only considers the load balancing of data links, but also considers the server load balancing. When data flows reaches the data center, the Joint Load Balancing Algorithm first uses a Dynamic Server Load Balancing Algorithm to select the optimal server and then uses Hybrid Routing Algorithm to select the best path to the selected server. The Hybrid Routing Algorithm combines the Shortest Path Algorithm with the Ant Colony System. Finally, the Joint Load Balancing Algorithm proposed in this paper is implemented as a load balancing module in the OpenDayLight controller and simulated by Mininet. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the algorithm. Compared with the shortest path polling algorithm and the shortest path random algorithm, the algorithm proposed in this paper makes the network performance significantly improved, and achieves higher network throughput and lower delay.

articleTitle: Four-rotor UAV Virtual Simulation System for Agricultural Sowing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, research on the application of UAV agriculture sowing has developed rapidly. This topic combines the flight characteristics of four-rotor UAV to design and develop a four-rotor UAV virtual simulation system applied in agricultural sowing with using Unity3D engine and realistic picture effects, based on virtual reality technology. This system solves the problem that the restriction of UAV flight in real life, and provides example for virtual reality of the four-rotor UAV agricultural sowing, which has great practical significance.

articleTitle: Matlab Programming Environment Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Matlab is a mathematics software, which is the industry leader in numerical calculation, but this software takes up a lot of system memory and is extremely cumbersome to install. As various types of modeling rise and the intensity and frequency of discipline penetration are deepened and accelerate gradually, Matlab has gradually entered more people's field of vision. In order to simplify the programming environment and improve the convenience, a Matlab programming environment based on Web is proposed in this paper. Compared with the traditional Matlab programming environment, the main features of the system are that it does not need to deploy any development environment locally, and users can write and run Matlab code through the browser of mobile phone, tablet, computer; at the same time, the system also supports standard input, parameter input, and image output. Through the research and testing of the system, the programming environment has strong feasibility, excellent user experience, good concurrency and stability.

articleTitle: An Improved Centroid Localization Algorithm for WSN
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Node localization is one of the key technologies in wireless sensor network (WSN). Centroid localization algorithm is totally dependent on the density of the size and distribution of anchor nodes, but they distribute randomly and the density of them is small. In view of the traditional centroid localization algorithm is vulnerable to the influence of network deployment status, and the present situation of low positioning precision, put forward an improved centroid localization algorithm. Firstly, put the thinking of weight to the process of node coordinates' calculation, introduce the concept of reference anchor nodes. Then design the weighting strategy accordingly, using the weighted results as the unknown nodes' estimated coordinates, and improve the positioning accuracy through multiple weights. Finally, use simulation experiment to compare the accuracy and stability of the improved algorithm with the classical one. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the improved algorithm's localization accuracy is higher.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Aero-Equipment Components Life Based on Normal Distribution Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to describe the failure and life rule of aeronautical equipment components more truly and improve the accuracy and efficiency of reliability analysis, a reliability data analysis method based on general normal distribution is proposed to meet the needs of modern aeronautical equipment fault prediction. The purpose of this paper is to establish a reliability analysis model for normal distribution of aeronautical equipment components, and to present a probability plot method for directly judging the type of distribution. Then, a method for estimating the parameters of normal distribution is presented, which is accurate, simple and easy to implement, in order to improve the accuracy and applicability of reliability analysis. Finally, an application example in the field of aeronautical equipment support is given. The analysis results show that the use of probability plots to determine the type of probability distribution is simple and feasible. The maximum likelihood estimation method is used to estimate the fault distribution function and data characteristics, and the fitting accuracy is relatively high.

articleTitle: Research on autonomous navigation of mobile robot based on multi ultrasonic sensor fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the mobile robot platform with multi-ultrasonic ranging sensors, a method is proposed to obtain local maps by ultrasonic ranging, and to obtain global maps through detection in the process of motion, so as to complete path planning and navigation. This method effectively fuses multi-sensor to detect obstacles around the mobile robot. The global map is constructed by local map, which overcomes the shortcoming of ultrasonic ranging. The method is easy to implement. The validity of this method is verified by a certain type of mobile robot platform.

articleTitle: Design and Testing of a monitoring system for mushroom planting greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to realize intelligent control of mushroom planting's parameters of air temperature and humidity, lighting intensity, and temperature and humidity of soil culture materials, it carries out design with ZigBee network, and intelligent fuzzy control algorithm as core. With advantages of high precision and stability, the design of sensor circuit mainly employs digital module sensors. The closed loop control is realized by employing fuzzy control algorithm and the test result shows that the deviation of air temperature is controlled within ±0.8°C, the deviation of air humidity is controlled within ±9%, the deviation of lighting intensity is controlled within ±21 LUX, the deviation of temperature of soil culture materials is controlled within ±0.9°C, and that of humidity of soil culture materials is controlled within ±6%, thus all parameters fully meet practical requirements of mushroom planting greenhouse.

articleTitle: A Balances Energy Consumption Clustering Routing Protocol for a Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the wireless sensor network (WSN) routing protocol, due to the unreasonable distribution of cluster head nodes, lead to the node energy consumption is too fast problems. In this paper, proposes a balances energy consumption clustering routing protocol for a wireless sensor network(BECR). In BECR, the improved fuzzy C-means (FCM) method is first used to divide the network into clusters, and the node closest to the cluster center is regarded as the initial cluster head. When the energy of the initial cluster head drops by 20%, the fuzzy logic system (FLS) is used to select the cluster head of each cluster. When the energy of the cluster head each drop by 10%, the next round of cluster head elections is performed, otherwise, the cluster head election is not performed. The final simulation results prove the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Multi-stream I3D Network for Fine-grained Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Recent research in the area of action recognition has focused on coarse-grained action recognition, and there have been few studies on fine-grained action recognition. In response to this phenomenon, we propose a method for fine-grained action recognition using a deep convolutional network. This method uses the I3D network, which has achieved great success in the area of coarse-grained action recognition, as the basic network architecture. At the same time, the human pose and hand are extracted for obtaining local features of the fine-grained action. The I3D network is then used to extract RGB video frames, optical flow, human pose, and hands features, respectively. Finally, these features are combined. Since there are multiple different input streams input to the I3D network, our method is called a Multi-stream I3D Network. We validated this method on the MPII Cooking 2 dataset and reported the results in detail.

articleTitle: Research on Tracking and Tracing Bitcoin Fund Flows
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of illegal activities of Bitcoin, in this paper, transaction data structure of Bitcoin and data storage mechanism of Bitcoin Core (official client for Bitcoin) and are firstly analyzed, then a MapReduce-based structured method for processing transaction data from Bitcoin Core is introduced. Based on above knowledge, mechanisms of tracking and tracing Bitcoin fund flows are proposed, along with the visualization powered by D3.js. This paper provides a practical tool for researching and analyzing flows of illegal transaction funds.

articleTitle: Prediction of Short Term Electric Load Based on BP Neural Networks & ARIMA Combination
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Currently, in terms of electric load, single item prediction method is mainly applied based on traditional research methods or artificial neural networks technology. This paper proposes a new method of electric load prediction based on BP neural networks and ARIMA combination model, which first extracts time series data sample in terms of the variation trend of the electric load of Shiqu County, GanZi State, China, and then applies BP neural networks to make correction to the prediction errors, and finally adds the corrected value with ARIMA predicted value. The results show that the mean relative error of the combined prediction method is 0.042, which is of better prediction precision compared to single BP neural networks & ARIMA model prediction method. Thus, to use combination model in the electric load prediction is feasible.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation System Urban Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The existing distribution network evaluation system fails to cover the high and medium voltage distribution network, and it is not suitable for horizontal comparison of the urban distribution network. To this end, a comprehensive evaluation system for urban distribution network with universal adaptability is proposed. Firstly, starting from the needs of stakeholders in the power grid, the fishbone diagram method is used to analyze the key factors that affect the construction of distribution networks, and a comprehensive evaluation index system that fully reflects the characteristics of distribution network construction is established; secondly, the weights of indicators that establish unified standards are established using the Delphi method. Finally, by setting an index evaluation criterion and curve fitting the index evaluation criterion to obtain the index scoring function, thereby forming an urban power distribution network comprehensive evaluation system that can be used for horizontal comparison of different distribution networks and covering high and medium voltage distribution networks. The example results verify that the evaluation system can reasonably reflect the overall development level of the distribution network, compare the advantages and disadvantages of different distribution networks horizontally, and find the weak links of each distribution network, and provide reference for planning, construction and development of power distribution network.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Differential Frequency Hopping Communication System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Differential Frequency Hopping(DFH) communication technology has made great progress in the past two decades, which greatly improve the concealment and survivability of signals in the communication process. On the basis of in-depth study of previous achievements, this paper firstly uses the FPGA tool to complete the implementation of the key modules of DFH communication transmitter and receiver. Then through the implementation combination, the implementation of the whole system is completed achieve.

articleTitle: A Parameter Optimization Design Method Based on LCC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For a fixed frequency LCC resonant converter have some problems of the full switching state of the lag arm is easily lost and the resonant current is large at heavy loads, resulting in only a narrow ZVS range and large conduction losses. Firstly, perform time domain analysis on the converter. Secondly, parameter design of LCC resonant converter based on fundamental analysis method using power analysis and time domain analysis. The parameter design method broadens the ZVS conduction range of the converter, and effectively reduces the resonant current and reduces the circulating current loss. Finally, a simulation platform is built in the Matlab/Simulink simulation environment. The simulation results verify the correctness of the theory.

articleTitle: Garbage Classification and Environmental Monitoring based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Garbage classification and environmental monitoring technology has been developing rapidly in recent years. The combination of Internet of things and environmental technology has become a trend. In the process of explosive growth of cities and towns in China, the amount of waste is also expanded in the exponent growth, causing huge environmental and social problems. The current urban area commonly applies the strategy of “mixed collection, centralized transportation, centralized processing”, commonly known as the three segment management to recycle and dispose of refuse, which can not effectively solve massive waste issues. This paper is to introduce the challenges and solutions of garbage classification, and to solve the inevitable problems of “sanitation management”, “solid waste classification”, “recycling station data feedback”, and “surrounding environment monitoring”, so as to recycle of garbage efficiently and harmlessly. Based on the research and rich engineering experience, we have proposed the digital dynamic sanitation management, the cloud computing architecture, the grid large-scale real-time monitoring of solid waste recycling stations feedback, the surrounding water and air quality on-line monitoring subsystems. To overcome difficulties and provide theoretical basis and technical methods, it will strongly support the extensive deployment of garbage recycling in China, and greatly improve the recycling rate of urban and rural waste.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy PID Control Algorithm for Lower Limb Rehabilitation Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Cerebrovascular disease, hemiplegia and paraplegia may lead to lower extremity motor dysfunction. According to the theory of neural rehabilitation, proper rehabilitation training can help patients recover. In this paper, a lower limb rehabilitation robot is proposed, which can realize passive training and active training. Firstly, the mechanical structure and electrical system are designed. Secondly, in order to solve the problem of inaccurate parameters in the dynamic model of robot joint torque control, a fuzzy adaptive PID controller is established by combining negative feedback with PID regulator to eliminate the system error.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for Warehouse based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the current situation of domestic and international automated warehouse analysis and research, according to user requirements for the project. SIEMENS S7-300 PLC as the core through the analysis of the stacker operation process, puts forward a general design scheme of stereoscopic warehouse. By improving structure of warehouse to meet the storage requirements of different goods. Use STEP7 programming software and modular program design to achieve the design of closed loop control systems, data communication via the fieldbus complete PC and PLC. Select the modules needed for PLC, AC servo motor and corresponding servo drives. The positioning principle and accuracy of the stacker are analyzed, and the positioning process is described in detail. In accordance with the need of different goods, the system is the first to use a new model that is a system has two ways of working. Through experimental test, the system control effect is good, in actual operation shows that this paper studies the stereo warehouse system has certain superiority, practical and efficient, simple manipulation, has certain use and promotion value.

articleTitle: Method containing reactive voltage control for 10KV distribution network with distributed power supply
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the influence of distributed power on the voltage of distribution lines and power flow distribution, a method containing reactive voltage control for 10kV distribution network with distributed power supply is proposed. Firstly, the influence of accessing distributed power supply on the voltage characteristics of distribution network is analyzed. Then, a grid reactive power control method for balancing the operation times and optimization effects of equipment is proposed. The control precision of reactive power compensation equipment is optimized by dynamically adjusting the power factor, avoid the frequent operation of the equipment; finally, a decentralized and superior control method is proposed. By detecting the distributed power source's point of integration, the reactive power and voltage situations at the point are evaluated, and the differentiated control is performed according to different voltage levels. The simulation experiment results show that the proposed dual-layer reactive voltage control method can significantly reduce the active loss and improve the voltage pass rate.

articleTitle: Research on Load Characteristic Modeling and Optimization Control Method Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The load characteristic model based on demand response and the load optimization control method in three different scenarios are studied in this paper. Firstly, by decoupling rigid load and flexible load, according to different degree that flexible load participates in demand response, considering the influence of different control variables, three types of load characteristics models of electricity price load, direct control load and interruptible load are constructed. Secondly, based on the established the load characteristic model proposes a reasonable load control strategy optimization control method under the condition of different practical power supply gap constraints. Finally, through three cases of scenarios, we explored the control variables are direct control load and interruptible load control, the objective function is when the deviation between the actual load reduction amount and the power supply gap is the smallest, and the constraint condition considers the demand response contract. The feasibility of the constructed model and the optimization method is verified, which provides a reference for the promotion of user-side demand response in China.

articleTitle: Matrix Factorization Recommendation Algorithm Incorporating Tag Factor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Matrix factorization is a hot spot in the research of recommendation algorithms. Traditional matrix factorization algorithm only learns the user factor and the item factor from rating data, not fully considering the influence of the tag data. Therefore, a matrix factorization recommendation algorithm incorporating tag factor is proposed. This algorithm obtains user's tag preference matrix by considering rating data and tag data comprehensively, and then incorporates item preference tag factor and user's tag preference factor into the matrix factorization recommendation algorithm. In this algorithm, tag-rating sparse coefficient is proposed to better balance the use of latent factors and tag factors in the recommendation process. At the same time, the TF-IDF algorithm is used to calculate the tag factor weight of the item, which reflects the influence of different times of the tag marked on different items. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed recommendation algorithm can produce better accuracy and performance compared with the traditional matrix factorization algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of converter transformer excitation current and reactive power loss in DC bias based on field circuit coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A magnetic circuit coupling model of converter transformer is proposed. Based on the core topology and material saturation characteristics of the converter transformer, the magnetic circuit equation is established. The circuit-magnetic circuit coupling model is obtained by coupling the magnetic circuit equation with the circuit equations of the primary side and secondary side of the transformer. The method is applied to the finite element model of a converter transformer, the variation of excitation current and reactive power consumption of the converter transformer under different bias current injection are simulated and analyzed quantitatively. The simulation result shows that with the increase of the injected DC bias current, the excitation current distortion of the converter transformer becomes more and more serious, and the reactive power consumed by the converter transformer increases sharply, which has a very adverse impact on the reactive power balance of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Manufacturing Process Control Based on Multi-Agent-System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to control the complex working conditions in the process industry, this paper starts with the multi-agent system technology and combines the MOPSO algorithm to establish an optimization system model for the process industrial manufacturing process. This model is divided into control layer and execution layer, and there is a separate agent used to store the algorithm and data, so as to reduce the time consumption of the entire system due to information interaction, and it also achieves the communication between each agent in the multi-agent system, which can effectively conduct optimization and control on the whole manufacturing process.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Trajectory Planning of Collaborative Robots Base on RRT-RV Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A novel aooroach of dynamic trajectory planning of collaborative robots is proposed. Firstly, the distances of human-robot are obtained through a new simple method by RGBD camera kinect. Then, the trajectory is generated by the proposed approach(RRT-RV), which improved the traditional RRT method by adding constraint factor as well as merging RV method. This method does not only consider static obstacles, but also takes dynamic obstacles into account. Moreover, simulation experiment is utilized to execute the new method and optimize parameters. Besides, further physical experiment is conducted by RGBD camera Kinect and UR5 robot to verify the feasibility and effectivity of the designed real-time collision avoidance algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Interleaved Boost Converter with Coupled Inductors for Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Interleaved boost converters are typically used as a fuel cell power conditioner due to their low input ripple current. In this paper, based on the study of topologies, a novel converter is proposed for fuel cells combined with conventional interleaved converters, coupled inductances and switching capacitances. The converter is more conducive to reducing the input ripple current and improving the converter gain combined a reverse coupling inductor with a forward coupled inductor with the features of series and parallel topologies. Experimental results show that the converter has higher energy conversion efficiency (96%) and higher voltage ratio compared with the conventional boost converter, which can effectively inhibit the low-frequency ripple current on input and output sides. Additionally, the research method is provided in this article.

articleTitle: Research and application of real-time control system for construction quality of digital dynamic compaction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Against the drawbacks of current quality control of dynamic compaction, this paper comprehensively applied the GNSS positioning technology, sensor technology, cloud computing technology and automatic control technology to propose the overall architecture of the real-time quality control for digital dynamic compaction, which included intelligent monitoring terminal, cloud computing terminal, wireless communication network, mobile monitoring terminal and integrated information management terminal. In addition, a corresponding real-time quality control system was developed for engineering application. The application results showed that the system realized the automatic construction information collection and visual quality control, effectively guaranteed the construction quality of the dynamic compaction and improved the construction efficiency. Therefore, the proposed system has a strong promotion and application prospects.

articleTitle: 3D Digital Mockup for Honeycomb Sandwich Panels of Satellites
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The honeycomb sandwich panels are the structures which have been used widely in the spacecraft structures due to their excellent mechanical properties. In the aerospace manufacturing, as the product structure, the process planning and functional requirements are becoming more and more complex, the traditional guide way which is called 2D process is no longer suitable for work instruction. Along with the development of the 3D product design and process, the aerospace manufacturing enterprises are need of executing the manufacture in a 3D manner in order to apply the 3D digital to the 3D digital to the whole life cycle of a product. In this paper, a high efficiency 3D digital mockup for honeycomb sandwich panels is proposed.

articleTitle: Directional Folded Antenna for Brain Stroke Detection Based on Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To meet the demands on wideband unidirectional antennas in distinguishing ICH and IS stroke based on classification algorithm, a novel folded antenna is presented. The design of the antenna starts with a planar diplo antenna with bridge-shape ground. Then some slots are added to the ground to expand the bandwidth. Next, a folding technology is applied to the monopole to enhance its directivity while the overall size is reduced markedly at the same time. At last, a reflector and a pair of top-facing π-shape parasitic patches are applied to the antenna to increase the gain and decrease the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) at 1.7 GHz. The final designed antenna has a dimensions of 0.293λ×0.107λ×0.053λ (λ is the wavelength at the lowest operating frequency). It has a measured reflection coefficient less than -10 dB fractional bandwidth of 76% (1.1-2.45 GHz) and a peak gain of 4.5 dBi. In order to validate the effectiveness of the proposed antenna in the application, the proposed folded antenna is simulated with the human brain model and the result is classified by PCA and LDA classification algorithms. Finally, the accuracy of the final classification result is 100%, which indicates that the proposed folded antenna can be well applied to the brain stroke detection system.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Physical Unclonable Functions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid emergence and application of Internet of Things and artificial intelligence technology, lightweight system security certification has become a problem that needs urgent solution. Although the classic password authentication technology is effective, it is often limited to a limited amount of computing and storage resources, and the cost is greatly increased. However, physical unclonable function (PUF) can effectively solve this problem as an emerging technology. According to the implementation method of PUF, we divide 13 important PUF into three categories. Subsequently, we show its seven attributes, combine with its excellent attributes, explore its four application scenarios from the perspective of cryptographic engineering, and propose its four advantages in key generation applications. Finally, we also give three PUF chips for use.

articleTitle: A Deep Network for Pornographic Image Recognition Based on Feature Visualization Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The study of pornographic image recognition plays an important role in protecting physical and mental health of young people. However, features extracted by traditional methods are so single that these methods are difficult to deal with the diversity of pornographic contents. Therefore, we propose a deep convolution neural network (CNN) for pornographic image recognition based on feature visualization analysis. In this paper, firstly we establish a pornographic database containing 80000 images. Then, we train a basic CNN model that can accurately recognize pornographic images. To face a variety of challenging scenes, we utilize a method based on a deconvolution network to visualize CNN extractive features. By using this visualization method, we make a system analysis of our recognition model performance, and optimize the model to make it more robust and accurate. Our experimental results suggest that the proposed method significantly outperforms the state-of-art methods.

articleTitle: Review of the development of metal non-destructive testing and imaging technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Non-destructive testing technology is a comprehensive applied subject, and it has been more and more widely used with the development of modern science and technology. This paper introduces the background, classification, main methods, development status and trends of metal non-destructive testing. Moreover, its three-dimensional imaging technologies including are also discussed.

articleTitle: Design of Unmanned Surface Vehicle for Submarine Pipeline Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A large number of submarine pipelines need to be detected, School of Mechatronic Engineering and Automation, Shanghai University has specially developed a Unmanned Surface Vehicle(USV) with synthetic aperture sonar(SAS). This paper propose a novel design scheme of USV for submarine pipeline detection(SPD), called SPD-USV. In order to meet the stability requirements of SAS to detect submarine pipeline, gyro stabilizers were installed on USV to suppress the roll motion. Based on the principle of gyro stabilizer, and the mathematical relationship between gyro stabilizer movement and roll of USV, offshore experimental data was obtained. Finally, the offshore experimental data were analyzed to compare the Roll of USV angle, angular velocity, and angular acceleration when gyro stabilizer with and without. In addition, the spectrum diagrams were used to analyze the suppression effect of gyro stabilizer on different roll frequencies. The results show that the anti-rolling effect of gyro stabilizer achieve the desired, can provide guarantees for measurement of SAS.

articleTitle: Gas monitoring system for power cable tunnel based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Safety monitoring of underground power cable tunnel has very important practical significance, while gas monitoring can be used as the main means of fire detection and early warning. The wireless sensor network and 4G LTE are effectively combined to realize the power cable gas monitoring and early warning. The ZigBee network and 4G LTE data transmission are realized in the system and structure of detect node for power cable gas monitoring is given in this work. Wireless sensor networks overcome the limitations of wired sensor networks. ZigBee nodes have the advantages of low cost, low power consumption and large network capacity. At the same time, 4G LTE module has the advantages of always on-line, high transmission rate, flexible and cheap billing, so the system has a very wide range of application value.

articleTitle: Differential Evolutionary modeling and starting-up cavitation characteristics analysis for multistage centrifugal pump
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the experimental data of multistage centrifugal pump, the model parameters are identified by the differential evolution algorithm with residual correction, and the head-volume flow rate- rotation speed models of each impeller are obtained. On this basis, the analysis of the relationship between the pressure, the fluid density and the vapor content is carried out, and the cavitation analysis model of the centrifugal pump is obtained. Taking a certain type of marine condensate system as an example, the starting process of the condensate pump is simulated. It is found that the cavitation of the operating condensate pump will occur when the high temperature leaking water from the operating unit is 8t/h during the starting process. The research results can provide support for the design optimization and operation principle of the marine condensate system.

articleTitle: Parametric Modeling and Finite Element Analysis of the Camshaft Based on ANSYS APDL
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the camshaft fracture of the drum brake in use, the finite element structural analysis model of the camshaft was established by using ANSYS APDL. The static analysis of the camshaft was implemented and the static displacement and equivalent stress of camshaft were computed based on ANSYS. The maximum deformation and equivalent stress distribution were obtained. In addition, the design hidden troubles were pointed out. These results can offer references for the camshaft design and manufacture as well as improved the quality of the brake system.

articleTitle: Testability Modeling of Guided Projectile Based on Multi-Signal Flow Graphs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Testability is an important link between the reliability of guided projectile and the maintenance support. This paper introducesthe modeling method of multi-signal flow graphs. The structural characteristics of the control system of navy guided projectile are analyzed and the multi-signal flow graphs model of the control system is established. Finally the failure-test correlation matrix is given and the testability of the control system is assessmented. The results show that the multi-signal flow graphs testability modeling method is feasible and effectiveand it can improve the inherent testability of products in the testability design application of navy guided projectile.

articleTitle: Medical Data Quality Assessment Model Based on Credibility Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The current main problem of medical data is low accuracy. Although existing data quality evaluation and audit can meet the needs, network security problem will be more serious in the future. As a result, the data quality evaluation model must include data credibility. This paper proposes the medical big data quality evaluation model based on credibility analysis and Analytic Hierarchy Process(AHP). Firstly, analyze the data credibility. After eliminating the unreliable data, calculate the data quality dimensions respectively. Then obtain the data quality evaluation result by integrating all dimensions with AHP. Through simulation, the data quality evaluation model can effectively identify the data that affects the credibility. The data quality evaluation results are improved after removing the untrusted data, besides the amount of data is reduced, which is applicable to the big data scenario.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Interference in Multi-train Tracking Operation Based on CBTC
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The causes and influencing factors of interference in multi-train tracking operation are analyzed and the solution of how to track the train operation curve smoothly is determined. Based on the model of multi-train tracking of Moving Block System (MBS) in Communication Based Train Control (CBTC), a pre-intervention optimization method of tracking operation is proposed which can alleviate or avoid the influence of interference by giving the recommendation acceleration value of Tracking Train (TT). The interference in multi-train tracking operation and the pre-intervention optimization process are simulation and the simulation shows that the pre-intervention optimization can effectively reduce the operation time of TT and energy consumption under the safe operation.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dual Threshold Based Moving Target Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the problems of inter-frame difference method and background subtraction method in the detection of moving objects, such as incomplete extraction target, easy to produce holes, and sensitivity to light and external interference, this paper proposes an improved target detection algorithm based on adaptive dual threshold. This algorithm adopts adaptive dual threshold to realize the binarization of frame difference image, and then uses post-processing such as morphology to eliminate false targets and connect fracture targets, and achieve more accurate extraction of the target. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm can overcome the effects of complex background, illumination changes, and motion disturbances, and can effectively guarantee the accuracy, efficiency and stability of moving target detection.

articleTitle: A Security Defense Scheme for Encryption and Network Isolation Gateway in Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The master station of power-expenditure information collection system (the master system for short) is vulnerable to be attacked by public networks. It is necessary to enhance the security defense in the access area of the master station to achieve the network isolation, terminal identity authentication, protocol filtering and transmission protection. The encryption and isolation gateway (gateway for short) is a protective device in security entry area. Its security protection strategy involves message transmission security, key management security, equipment management security and physical protection security. The gateway use the mechanism of red and black isolation to achieve network blocking in message transmission, through strict format inspection of messages to achieve the purpose of message filtering; authentication based on cryptography technology and transmission encryption of sensitive messages between systems and terminals. These security technologies are used to reduce intrusion risk through these security technology strategies.

articleTitle: Multi-control Strategy Combinatorial Control of Burning Temperature of Cement Rotary Kiln
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The burning temperature control plays an important role in improving the yield and quality of cement clinker. In this paper, the automatic control method of the burning temperature based on multi-control strategy combinatorial control technology was researched in this paper. According to human operation knowledge and experience, the multi-control strategy combinatorial rules were formulated, and then the automatic control system of burning temperature based on multi-control strategy combinatorial control technology was designed. In practical application, first of all, the original burning temperature was filtered by using the sliding time window method. Then, the specific parameters of the burning control system were determined as follows by the repeated trial and error method. At last, the automatic control system of the burning temperature was installed in a cement enterprise, and the field control effect showed that the average of the burning temperature based on multi-control strategy combinatorial control technology was higher than that of manual control, and its fluctuation was also less than the manual control. This paper provides a feasible method for automatic control of burning temperature.

articleTitle: Regional Power Load Forecasting Based on PSOSVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power load forecasting is the basic work of power grid construction planning. Accurate load forecasting is a key requirement for modern power system planning and economic and safe operation. This paper first introduces the background and significance of power load forecasting, research status at home and abroad, and review of power load forecasting methods, and focuses on the load forecasting method of particle swarm optimization support vector machine, and proposes an improved particle swarm optimization prediction model. The method is simple and easy to implement and has a stronger global optimization capability. The load forecasting method of particle swarm optimization support vector machine is used to predict the load in Weibei area, and good prediction results are also obtained.

articleTitle: An Android Application for Plant Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents an Android application to automatically identify plant species using a single leaf image as input. At the pre-processing phase, we proposed an improved segmentation method to eliminate the noise caused by capturing on non-uniform background so we can obtain the binary image which only contains the leaf shape. Then, several morphological features and Hu moment invariants descriptors were extracted as inputs of a joint classifier which combines the back propagation neural network(BPNN) with a weighted k-nearest-neighbor (KNN) to distinguish 220 species of plants. The outputs of the joint classifier are the top ten species that best match the query leaf image. At the end, we implemented these algorithms on Android OS and the application we developed has been downloaded about a million times.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Evaluation Algorithm based on Distribution Network containing Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Comprehensive considering the connectivity from load point to power sources, adequacy of micro-source generation, and interaction between micogrid and distribution network, this paper proposes a reliability assessment algorithm based on distribution network containing microgrid. According to effects analysis of failure modes, outage effects type of load point in distribution network with microgrid is divided, and a concept called load points failure excitation set is introduced. Based on this, the classified paths are partitioned according to different types of switches, thus forming the load points failure excitation sets and calculating reliability index. Using the algorithm to assess the reliability of the distribution network containing microgrid, which is modified by the main feeder F4 system of IEEE-RBTS BUS 6, the example results show that the algorithm is feasible and practical.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Distributed Generation on Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed generation technology and the increasing grid-connected capacity of distributed power, its impact on the power grid has become negligible. The root cause of the impact of distributed power supply on the grid relay protection is that the access of the distributed power source changes the structure of the traditional power grid, which leads to the change of the fault current and the direction, and ultimately affects the correct action of the relay protection. . This paper mainly analyzes the impact of different fault points on protection under different access locations of DG, and analyzes the impact of DG access on reclosing.

articleTitle: Robot Navigation Method based on Intelligent Evolution
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Robot navigation is important symbol of its intelligent level, especially under dynamic environment. In this paper, a robot navigation method based on intelligent evolution is proposed, and Tolman Mouse Maze Experiment is reproduced by robot rather than mouse. Firstly the topological map of the indoor environment is built by Self-Organizing Map (SOM) method based on random traversal, then the path planning method based on reinforcement learning, during the navigation process, the environment of the maze will change, and the robot can automatically update its topological map according to the environment change by adjusting its neural network structure, so as to reach the goal as soon as possible. The validity of the proposed method is proved by simulation results based on MATLAB and gazebo, moreover physical experiments carried on Turtlebot robot both reproduced Tolman Mouse Maze Experiment, so our intelligent evolution algorithm made robot as clever as animal being able to find the short path to the goal.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Formation Control with Collision Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of collision avoidance between UAVs in the process of multi-UAV formation configuration, a new form of safety zone constraints for collision avoidance is proposed, which transforms the safety zone constraints from the circular zone to the half-plane zone. This transformation makes the formation trajectory optimization be a standard quadratic programming problem, and a distributed receding horizon optimization method is used to solve the problem efficiently. Simulation results show that this method can get optimal formation trajectories under cooperative collision avoidance conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Location Parameter Adjusting System for Anchor Drilling in Coal Mine Roadways
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the construction of ground anchors in the coal mine roadway, the drill boom precise adjustment of the anchoring drilling rig as well as the borehole accurate locating constitute the foundation and prerequisite for the entire construction work. For the problems of low efficiency and large error in manual manipulation, based on the intelligent control technique and electro-hydraulic proportional control technology, the location parameter adjustment system for the drill boom of anchoring drilling rig was studied. On the basis of the kinematic model solution of the drill boom, this system utilized the control method based on the kinematic model to adjust the drill boom parameters to the designed objectives. Finally, the drill boom positioning laboratory experiment was carried out in combination with the physical prototype. The experimental results showed that the adjustment system for the location parameters of the drill boom had higher control precision. Through this system, the efficiency of preparatory work prior to anchoring construction and construction safety could be improved. This could provide the technological basis for the intelligent development of coal mine machinery.

articleTitle: The Parameter Estimation of Wideband LFM Signal Based on Down-chirp and Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Wideband linear frequency modulated (LFM) signal is a kind of large time bandwidth product signal obtained by non phase modulation, the parameter estimation of wideband LFM signal requires a high sampling rate problem, combined with compressed sensing (CS) theory to estimate its parameters research, construct a measurement matrix that performs both compressed sampling and down-chirp method simultaneously, and improve it through a fast computing strategy.The simulation results show that the improved fast algorithm can accurately estimate the initial frequency and chirp rate of wideband LFM signal, and reduce the number of atoms in the dictionary, thus reducing the computation and reducing the time of parameter estimation.

articleTitle: Single-Channel Dataflow for Convolutional Neural Network Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are popular in Machine Learning and CNNs have rich parallelism. Many efficient CNN accelerators have been designed recently. Especially, the Tiling structure accelerators are widely used. However, we observe that the Tiling architecture may not be efficient when the network layers change. This situation will result in a waste of processing elements (PEs). In order to achieve a high-utilization of PEs, we propose a new architecture called Single-Channel to 1) ameliorate the Tiling architecture without increasing the hardware complexity while 2) improve the utilization of PEs. We evaluate the Single-Channel architecture with four typical CNN networks. The hardware achieves the 1.2-5× speedup and the 40%-60% utilization improvement compared with the Tiling architectures.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Breakdown Characteristics of Transformer Oil at Low Temperature
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of power systems, the capacity of power transformers has continuously increased, and the requirements for their safety have also been increasing. Because of the low winter temperatures in northern China, the transformer boot process will inevitably face the test of low-temperature environment. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the effect of low temperature on the insulation performance of transformers to ensure the safe operation of power transformers. In this paper, the change of the micro-water content in the transformer oil was studied by means of experiments, and the influence of temperature on the insulating oil breakdown characteristic was analyzed. The results show that the two processes of micro-water dissolution and precipitation in transformer oil are not completely reversible under low temperature environment; the breakdown voltage of transformer oil shows a trend of decreasing first and then rising during the cooling process. A detailed analysis of this trend is carried out theoretically, and it is concluded that when the low temperature condition is unavoidable, the moisture content in the transformer oil should be minimized.

articleTitle: Low-cost Quadrotor Attitude Solution Based on Improved Complementary Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the low-cost inertial measurement device is susceptible to external disturbance and the accuracy of real-time attitude calculation is poor, an improved complementary filter attitude calculation method based on quaternion is proposed. Using the quaternion to describe the attitude angle, solving the differential equation by the Runge-Kutta method reduces the calculation amount, and uses the accelerometer measurement value to perform the dynamic weight correction gyroscope measurement error, which effectively suppresses the drift of the gyroscope. In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, dynamic and static flight tests were performed on a quadrotor. The experimental results show that the dynamic solution error of the improved complementary filtering algorithm is about 1.5 degrees, and the static solution error is less than 0.3 degrees. Under strong maneuvering, there is still some anti-interference, and the attitude of the aircraft can be quickly tracked, which satisfies the requirements of low-cost small four-rotor attitude control, and enhances the accuracy and stability of the calculation.

articleTitle: Structural Dynamic Performance Evaluation of Industrial Robots Based on Vibration Tests
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Industrial robots have been widely used in industrial production because of their reliability and efficiency. However, due to the structural flexibility of joints and links, industrial robots have poor rigidity and are prone to vibration compared with machine tools, which has become a bottleneck for their applications in tasks with dynamic loading such as machining. This issue has brought a need for an efficient method for performance evaluation of structural dynamics of industrial robots. For this purpose, this paper proposes a local performance index to quantify the structural dynamic performance of industrial robots based on vibration excitation test data. The characteristics of robot dynamic behavior is represented by the Frequency Response Functions (FRF), which can be obtained through impact excitation tests. Then, a performance index is derived from the FRF, which provides a conservative means to evaluating the worst situation of end-effector response due to harmonic excitation with the amplitude of a unit force. The proposed dynamic performance index can be used for the optimization of robot configuration, workpiece position and machining process parameters to reduce vibrations in robotic machining.

articleTitle: Dual-Function Meander Line Circular Polarizer in C band
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on practical antennas for indoor or outdoor communication and radar systems, a meander line polarizer is designed working as a radome a circular polarizer at the same time. It has simple design method, low cost, stable structure and good performance. The polarizer works with a linearly polarized horn antenna, and is placed at the open aperture of the horn. Therefore, the plate polarizer isolate and protect the antenna from external influence, which makes an extra high-cost radome unnecessary. Moreover, no complicated design is required to achieve circular polarization by the antenna itself. Simulation results show that this design provides wide axial ratio bandwidth more that 30% at 4 GHz. No noticeable gain degradation is observed, while pure circular polarization with axial ratio lower than 1 dB can be obtained at boresight in C band.

articleTitle: Research on soft sensing of formation heat of cement clinker based on LS_SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the burning system of cement rotary kiln, formation heat of clinker is an important parameter in the calculation of energy consumption of rotary kiln. Aiming at the problem that cement clinker formation heat can not be detected on-line, a soft sensor modeling method based on least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) is proposed in this paper. The input variable set of the least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) model is constructed by introducing auxiliary variables such as coal injection from kiln head, and predict formation heat of clinker, finally the experiment is carried out. The results show that the soft measurement model of formation heat of cement clinker based on least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) can accurately predict the formation heat of clinker. It is of great significance for the calculation of energy consumption of cement rotary kiln and the optimization control of firing system.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Topology Modelling and Automatic Mapping Based on CIM and GIS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the spatial information technology of geography information (GIS) to implement the modelling of distribution network and dynamic topology relationships at the context of topology modelling specifications of Common Information Model (CIM). On the basis of the data model, this paper aims to establish an automatic mapping system oriented to the one-line electrical connection diagram. As a result, a simple and reliable thematic mapping algorithm is constructed oriented to satisfy the key technical requirements of distribution network mapping, including scientific layout of thematic map, wiring aesthetics and avoiding crossover. The given algorithm of topology model and automatic thematic mapping are applied and verified in a geographic information management system implemented by the Foshan Power Supply Bureau. The results show that the system can real-time and accurately present the attribute data of distribution network equipment, spatial data and important operating parameters.

articleTitle: Beidou RNSS Timing Technology and Application in Smart Grid Lightning Locating System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The smart grid lightning locating system is an important power service, and its lightning locating accuracy depends largely on the accuracy of time synchronization. This paper studies and compares three Beidou timing methods, and finds that the RNSS timing method is most suitable for lightning locating systems. Furthermore, the principle and characteristics of RNSS timing are studied, and a low-cost terminal timing and punctual hardware and software architecture and algorithm are proposed. The Kalman filter-based Beidou PPS is used to calibrate the terminal clock and adjust the voltage through the PID algorithm. The voltage -controlled crystal oscillator makes the deviation between the terminal time and the GNSS time less than 100 ns at any time to meet the accuracy requirements of the lightning locating system.

articleTitle: Composite MPPT Control Algorithm with Partial Shading on PV arrays
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The output power of PV (photovoltaic) array is highly nonlinear, time-varying and have multiple local power extreme points in particle shadow, which leads to the failure of traditional MPPT (maximum power point tracking) algorithm. A composite MPPT algorithm is proposed to solve the problem, in which an improved PSO (particle swarm optimization) is combined with an adaptive P&O (perturb and observe) method. The improved PSO algorithm is used to implement the fast search for the approximate GMPP (global maximum power point), and then adaptive P&O method is employed to search accurately, in order to make the PV array work stably at the maximum power point. The MATLAB / Simulink model is established to show that the proposed algorithm can achieve a better MPPT performance under different shadows even when the illumination intensity changes suddenly, compared with the traditional PSO and P&O method.

articleTitle: BP Neural Network Data Fusion algorithm optimized based on adaptive fuzzy particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) are currently the subject of scientific research in the world. With the wireless sensor network, it can collect the changes of various monitoring targets to meet the objective requirements of data transmission, signal analysis and signal processing. In order to improve the energy efficiency of the wireless sensor network and prolong the network lifetime, this paper uses fuzzy control to update the particle position in the algorithm, and proposes a BP Neural Network Data Fusion algorithm optimized based on adaptive fuzzy particle swarm optimization(AFPSOBP) algorithm. The simulation results show that compared with BP Neural Network Data Fusion algorithm optimized by Genetic algorithm and Particle Swarm (GAPSOBP), it can further reduce network traffic, save node energy and prolong network lifetime.

articleTitle: Failure prediction for linear ball bearings based on wavelet transformation and self-organizing map
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Early diagnostics of defects and prediction of failures in machines are extensively studied for savings in maintenance costs and downtime losses. This paper deals with a new method for the prediction of linear ball bearings' failure based on the combination of wavelet transformation (WT) and self-organizing map (SOM). Selecting suitable and reliable degradation indicators is the key component for fault prognostics. By the use of wavelet packet decomposition the wavelet coefficients can be extracted as fault features which have been prepared for training of SOMs. We use a powerful visualization tool U-matrix (unified distance matrix) getting clearly representation of degradation situation. Then based on the minimum quantity error (MQE) outputted from the trained SOMs, and by use of exponentially weighted moving average chart (EWMA), the failure can be effectively predicted. Through the above method, we successfully predict the failure of the linear bearings.

articleTitle: New Automatic Color Equalization Algorithm Based on Lateral Inhibition Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For solving the problems of exposure imbalance and low contrast ratio in photogrammetry and visible light remote sensing, as well as the standard automatic color equalization algorithm, which does not fully take into account the color characteristics of some regions, this paper improves the standard automatic color equalization algorithm based on the non-circulating lateral inhibition model that simulate human visual characteristics and Gaussian distribution. The corrected luminance value of the target point is calculated by using the non-circulating lateral inhibition network model, and the Gaussian distribution is used to select the sampling points with higher correlation, which reduces the complexity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Improved Ant Colony Algorithm for Multi-Robot Task Allocation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel improved ant colony algorithm is proposed to study the multi-robot task allocation problem. By introducing a backhaul optimization factor, a new task point selection method is designed. The pheromone update method uses a combination of local pheromone update and global pheromone update. At the same time, an improved strategy for re-optimizing the optimal path is designed. Simulation experiments show that the proposed algorithm can further improve the quality and efficiency of the ant colony algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Scheduling Algorithm for Periodic Real-Time Tasks in Clouds
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Fault tolerance plays an important role in guaranteeing the reliability of cloud systems. Task scheduling is an efficient approach to realize fault tolerance.
