Existing periodic task scheduling algorithms typically consider homogeneous processors. However, the cloud systems consist of heterogeneous hosts and virtual machines. In this paper, we propose a fault-tolerant scheduling algorithm for periodic real-time tasks in clouds (FTPC). The FTPC algorithm sufficiently considers the elasticity and heterogeneity of cloud computing. Moreover, the widely-used Fault-Tolerant Rate-Monotonic First-Fit scheduling algorithm is tailored to meet the characteristics of clouds. Simulation experiments are conducted to evaluate the feasibility and effectiveness of FTPC.

articleTitle: Research on Data Exchange Mechanism of Power Trading
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The data exchanged between power trading systems is complex and changeable. The traditional way of exchanging data is through web pages. Market members log on to the trade system website and download real-time transaction data in the form of text or tables. This method often cannot adapt to data explosion as the power trading reform. In this paper, the functional and nonfunctional requirements of power trading data exchange were first analyzed. Then an API-oriented interaction mechanism was proposed, based on which an interaction interface was designed. Finally, the mode and format were discussed. Considering the data security and scalability in the transmission process, the encryption and extension method of the data exchange interface were also studied. The data exchange interface of power trading designed in this paper has been applied in China's power trading system.

articleTitle: The Research of Dynamic Spectrum Allocation Based on Nash Bargaining Game
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, most of the literatures on the spectrum allocation of game theory are based on non-cooperative game models, where secondary users' (SUs) goals are to maximize the benefits they gain in the game, regardless of the impact of their strategies on other SUs. In this paper, an improved dynamic spectrum allocation model based on Nash bargaining in cooperative game is proposed, whose goal is to optimize the total revenue of all SUs in the network. Simulations show that under Nash bargaining, the quality of service (QoS) that is the minimum rate request for each SU is guaranteed, the total revenue of SUs is higher than that of non-cooperative game, and the system is more fair than non-cooperative game.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Computer Practice Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the analysis of virtual reality technology and practical teaching, combined with the application of virtual reality technology in the implementation of practical teaching, this paper constructs a three-tier application model of VR technology in practical teaching in colleges and universities. At the same time, combining with the 3 characteristics of VR Technology: immersion, interaction and conception, it discusses the interaction design strategies of teachers and students in experiential learning environment. Finally, through the application of computer virtual teaching, it shows the feasibility and effect of its teaching mode. Combining VR technology with practical teaching makes it safer, easier, more flexible, and easier to achieve the real effects of human-computer interaction. Virtual reality technology has brought new opportunities for the development of education industry, and solves the problems which lack of interaction, situational and immersion in traditional classroom.

articleTitle: A Beam-forming Method based on Constant Modulus Algorithm combined with Gradient Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Focusing on the problem that tracking performance of constant modulus algorithm(CMA) will decrease dramatically in strong interference environment, a beam-forming method based on constant modulus algorithm combined with gradient algorithm is proposed. Based on application of smart antenna, the characteristics of this method are analysed. Finally the applicability of combined method is verified by computer simulation with an example of four element uniform linear array.

articleTitle: Comparative Experimental Study of Ground Reaction Force on Hemispherical Foot and Bionic Equinus of Quadruped Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The foot and ground force directly affect the propulsion performance and stability of quadruped robot. At present, the typical robots' foot, such as flat foot, cylindrical foot and spherical foot, are being widely used. However, the bionic foot almost haven't got very good application. This paper presents a kind of bio-inspired equinus model and a mechanical single leg system. The three dimensional model of equinus had been conducted, and 3D printing technology is also been used to produce bio-inspired foot. To compare the ground reaction force on quadruped robot, this paper conducts tests of hemispherical foot and bio-inspired equinus. Experiments show that the propulsive force of bio-inspired equinus is more excellent than hemispherical foot; and the former makes the robot more stable during walking. The experimental result provides the experimental basis and references for the follow-up study on Bio-inspired foot of quadruped robot.

articleTitle: Suspension Optimization Design and Virtual Prototype Simulation Analysis of FSAE Racing Car
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The design of the suspension system has a decisive influence on the handling stability, rider safety and ride comfort of the opponent's racing car. The front and rear suspensions of the car used an unequal length double wishbone suspension structure, which used its sporting characteristics to improve the directional stability of the car. Firstly, the suspension model was built by using CATIA 3D drawing software. Secondly, the ANSYS stress analysis software was used to analyze the bearing force and load of the important force-bearing components of the suspension, so that the strength of each connecting component of the suspension met the requirements. Finally, through Adams simulation analysis, the hard point of the suspension frame was taken as a variable, and the changes of a series of positioning parameters such as the toe value, camber angle and roll stiffness of the suspension were compared and refined. It provided a certain reference for the manufacture of real vehicles.

articleTitle: Autonomous Launch and Recovery Mechanism for USV
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, there is a rapid development in unmanned surface vehicle(USV) for marine exploration and military maritime research. While the launch and recovery of USV have always confused academic and industrial fields. So this paper gave a system for launch and recovery, which is composed of 3 mechanisms: the ejection mechanism, the PTZ mechanism and the docking mechanism. The ejection mechanism needed to launch the gas cannon into the mother ship's hatch, which is an important step for the recovery to be completed successfully. Therefore, this paper combined the principle of wave compensation, made dynamic analysis and MATLAB simulation of the ejection mechanism, then controlled the launch angle of the gas cannon, analyzed the gas track and the mother ship's roll state to ensure that the gas cannon can be successfully launched into the hatch of the mother ship. And the best launch angle of the gas cannon was given in the last.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Quantitative Investment Model Based on PLR-IRF and DRNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the subjective nature of human behavior, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has less research and application in this field. This paper selects the most representative financial investment field of human social behavior as the object, and proposes an algorithm of turning point prediction named Piecewise Linear Representation-Improved Random Forest (PLR-IRF) for macro trend analysis. Then according to the Deep Learning (DL) theory, which adopts a Deep Recursive Neural Network (DRNN) to design the investment decision model. Finally, 489 days stock exchange data of the Shanghai Stock Exchange were used for verification. The results show that compared with the existing quantitative investment models, the prediction accuracy of this model is relatively high, and the investment strategy is relatively novel.

articleTitle: Development of Automatic Welding Machine for Tube-to-Tubesheet Joints of Heat Exchanger
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: An automatic welding machine is designed to deal with the heavy workload and worse welding quality of the tube-to-tube-sheet joints of heat exchangers. By using the expanding mechanism, the center of rotation of the welding torch and the center of tube can be accurately aligned in a short time. The control device adopts ARM microcontroller for process control. The results show that the automatic welding machine adapts to the situation which the tube has a smaller diameter and unable to rotate.

articleTitle: Observer-based Sliding Mode Attitude Controller Design for Spacecraft with Fuel Slosh
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For a kind of spacecraft with fuel slosh, a controller is designed to make the spacecraft system asymptotically stable, to suppress the fuel slosh while controlling the spacecraft attitude. An existing system model is adopted to analyze and verify the system characteristics. By considering the underactuated characteristic of the system, the system is transformed into a certain normalized form. A sliding mode control approach is proposed to design the controller. In addition, an observer is designed in considering that the displacement of the fuel slosh is unable to be measured in reality. By measuring the state of the velocity and attitude of the spacecraft, the estimated value of the sloshing displacement is close to the true value within a certain error range, and the estimated value is used to replace the sloshing displacement in the control law. A Simulation example illustrate the effectiveness of the observer and controller.

articleTitle: An Improved RRT Algorithm for The Motion Planning of Robot Manipulator Picking up Scattered Piston
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Taking the piston blank feeding line as the research background, motion planning for grabbing the random stacking of piston blanks is studied. Aiming at the obstacle avoidance of the manipulator caused by the obstacle piston with unknown posture around the target piston, an improved RRT algorithm is proposed. The algorithm divides the planning process into two phases by introducing a pre-pose point. In the first stage, the main purpose is to avoid the collision between the grippers of the robotic arm and the obstructing piston. The 3D mapping of area around the target piston, and the gripping direction of the robotic arm is obtained based on the principle of the highest safety factor. Afterward, the path between the target point and the pre-posture point is calculated by the space coordinate transformation formula. The main purpose of the second phase is to improve the path quality of the plan under the premise of fully exploiting the computational efficiency of the RRT algorithm. The path point is searched using the mechanical function as a cost function. Based on the shortest path principle, the path from the pre-gesture point to the home point is obtained after 20 iterations. Finally, the RRT algorithm of this paper is configured in the ROS environment with the piston blank feeding platform. The experimental results show that the mechanical arm can replace the person to complete the feeding of the piston blank.

articleTitle: Compact Dual-band Slot Antenna for WIFI Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a new type of miniaturized dual-band slot antenna that can be used in the WIFI band. It is proposed that the antenna is fed by the L-type microstrip, and three consecutive slots are opened in the floor to make resonance at 2.45 GHz and 5.8 GHz. The slots in the floor cut off the current and extend the current path. The proposed antenna is in the form of standing wave resonance at two frequencies. The resonant frequency of the antenna can be adjusted by changing the length of the slot. The low frequency band is 2.42-2.49 GHz, and the high frequency band is 5.63-6.22 GHz, and the size of the antenna is 20*21 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (0.29*0.31λ@ 2.45 GHz). The antenna structure is simple and easy to integrate.

articleTitle: Scheduling optimization of flexible flow shop
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the production characteristics of flexible job shop scheduling in practice, the initial solution is generated by random Numbers, Gantt chart is drawn, and the maximum process time is calculated. Then, a simplified algorithm is proposed with reference to Johnson's algorithm. Combining Johnson algorithm and least time principle and minimum principle, puts forward a simplified algorithm. Johnson algorithm applies only to the limitations of two machine scheduling, this simplified algorithm extends the algorithm performance, so the job-shop scheduling of multiple machines can also be calculated, and the simplified algorithm is applied to an example. By comparing the optimized algorithm with the initial random solution with the obtained data, the effectiveness and superiority of the algorithm can be seen.

articleTitle: Convolutional LSTM Networks and RGB-D Video for Human Motion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel deep neural network architecture for addressing the problem of human motion recognition. The proposed architecture enables direct mapping of RGB-D input video to output classification through an end-to-end approach. The RBG images and the depth images pass through a two-stream deep convolutional long short-term memory networks, thereby outputting a plurality of feature maps including complete spatiotemporal features of the entire sequence. Then, a couple of deep convolutional neural networks further extracts the high-level features of these feature maps and classification of action through a classifier. This network structure allows the spatiotemporal structure of the image sequence to be preserved entirely from start to finish and improves the robustness of the network through the separate processing of RGB information and depth information. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of this structure in the SBU Kinect Interaction Dataset and MSRDailyActivity3D Dataset is higher than other existing structures.

articleTitle: Parametric Modeling of Geometric Errors for Machining Center Based on Legendre Polynomial
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to predict the geometric errors of CNC machine tools, a geometric error modeling method based on Legendre polynomials is proposed. Firstly, the error data is developed with the Legendre polynomial basis function, and the linear regression coefficients are obtained by fitting the linear least squares method. The error polynomial about the Legendre polynomial basis function is obtained. Secondly, based on the relationship of variables, the polynomial model of the rotation term of the error axis is given. Thirdly, the Renishaw XL-80 laser interferometer was used to measure the geometric errors of two rotating axes of the VMC65m machine tool, and the C-axis was used as an example for parametric modeling. Finally, comparing it with the parametric modeling effect of the Chebyshev polynomial, the geometric error of the Legendre polynomial is parametrically modeled with higher accuracy and closer to the actual error of the machine tool. This paper provides a theoretical basis for machine tool error compensation.

articleTitle: Research on Jamming Method of Tactical Internet Ultra short Wave Communication based on VRNET Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Through the study of interference in the very short wave band of tactical Internet, taking VRNET as the simulation platform, the jamming model of ultrashort wave UAV is constructed. Simulation results show that the interference is effective.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning of Free-floating Space Robot Using an Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to ensure non-disturbance on the base attitude of the space robot system during the whole operation process of the robot manipulator, this paper proposes an improved Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) algorithm and uses it to solve the optimal trajectory planning problem of the kinematically redundant space robot in free-floating mode. Firstly, based on the forward kinematics, the joint trajectories are parameterized with polynomial trigonometric function to simplify the calculation. Then, considering the zero-disturbance to the base attitude and the desired pose accuracy of the end-effector, the multi-weighted optimization objective function is established. Thirdly, an improved PSO algorithm with self-adaptively updated control parameters is proposed to find the optimal solution of joint trajectories, with which the optimization objective can be satisfied. Finally, the space robot with seven degrees of freedom(DOF) redundant manipulator is employed for simulation. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Three-state Feedback Control of Electro-hydraulic Servo Shaking Table Based on State Space Research
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the control bandwidth of the electro-hydraulic servo shaking table, a three-state control strategy based on state space analysis is proposed in this paper. First, the working principle of electro-hydraulic servo shaking table is introduced. According to the theory of electro-hydraulic servo system, four equations describing the whole mathematical model of electro-hydraulic servo shaking table are given, and the open loop control model is presented. Then, the open loop model is analyzed by the state space method. The optimal three-state feedback control parameter is put forward on account of the ideal three-order closed loop transfer function. Finally, the simulation analysis shows the effectiveness of the proposed control method which can effectively improve the system frequency width of the electro-hydraulic servo shaking table.

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Maintenance Time Management based on Risk Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Project time management is an important part of project management of returning to factory for maintenance. In this paper, planning evaluation technology (PERT) is used to manage the time of the project of warship weapon equipment maintenance, and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method (FIE) is used for the uncertain factor's risk evaluation that affect the schedule of the project. It is applied to a certain grade repair example of a specific type of radar equipment, and a more scientific and reasonable project duration is obtained, which provides a reference for the project time management of the warship weapon equipment grade repair project.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on Common-mode Voltage of T-type Three-level Converter Caused by Modulation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the cause and calculation formulas of common-mode voltage of T-type three-level converter were introduced, then the common-mode voltage caused by traditional SPWM, SVPWM and two improved modulation strategies were compared. Through the comparisons in this article, it found that the improved modulation strategies have lower common-mode voltage compared with the traditional SPWM and SVPWM strategies. In order to eliminate the common-mode voltage completely, a modulation wave phase shifted PWM strategy was proposed. It has been proved that the common-mode voltage was eliminated completely under the new modulation strategy, but the THD of line voltage was also increased. Finally, all of the modulation strategies were simulated and verfied in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: High Spatial-spectral Resolution Image Fusion Algorithm Based on Spectral Mixture Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a high spatial-spectral resolution image fusion algorithm for multispectral and hyperspectral images based on spectral mixture analysis. For this purpose, correspondence was established between high-spectral-resolution data and high-spatial-resolution data by extracting the same endmember. Specifically, Linear mixture model was applied to unmixing images, and the inverse process was used to do the image fusion. To test the algorithm, Hyperion and SPOT data were chose to do the fusion experiment, taking PSNR and SA as evaluation indexes. Results demonstrate the proposed algorithm a good performance on both spectral fidelity and spatial enhancement ability.

Author Keywords: high spatial-spectral resolution image fusion algorithm

articleTitle: Design of Software-Defined-Satellite-based PID Attitude Control Application in Python
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Up to now, due to the inconvenience of updating the software of conventional satellite systems, we proposed a new satellite structure called software defined satellite system. Based on this system, we complete the design of a supported software application using Python language, in which the PID attitude controller meets the need to control the real time attitude described by Euler angles of satellite in orbit. The benefits along with the challenges of the new structure are proposed as well.

articleTitle: Inter-cluster multi-hop routing algorithm based on K-means
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a clustering routing algorithm (KICMH) of uniform clustering and load balancing based on K-means is proposed aimed at LEACH algorithm existing defects of uneven clustering and the randomness of cluster-head election. First, the K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the network according to the location information of nodes, so as to achieve load balancing of the whole network. The nodes run for cluster heads according to their distance from the center of the cluster and from the base station and the remaining energy to achieve load balancing within the cluster. After the success of the cluster head campaign, the Dijkstra algorithm is used to generate the shortest path of the cluster head to the base station according to the overhead of sending data to the base station and to build a network topology. In order to reduce the additional energy loss caused by constructing the network topology, the process is realized by the base station. For verifying the performance and accuracy of the algorithm proposed in this paper, simulation is carried out by experiments. The results show that the KICMH algorithm proposed in this paper is significantly better than the original algorithm in clustering uniformity, energy load balancing and network lifetime.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Target Recognition Based on Pruned Deep Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this work, pruned deep neural network models have been used for remote sensing image target recognition to reduce the storage resources. This model compression procedure including two parts: first, pre-train the model for remote sensing image target recognition. Second, compression models by network pruning and weight clustering. The pruning procedure was implemented by learning the important connections in the network, and the weight clustering procedure was implemented by k-means algorithm. Experiments were performed with the AlexNet and VGG-16 networks on the NWPU-RESISC-10 datasets. Results show that the proposed method reduced the storage of AlexNet by 11.4×, from 240MB to 20MB and reduced the VGG-16 by 11× from 552MB to 50MB, with no significant loss of accuracy.

articleTitle: Multichannel Sub-Nyquist Sampling for Ultrasound Imaging Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As for the ultrasound imaging systems, reducing the high rate sampled data allows more efficient processing, which can translate to both the power consumption reduction and smaller system size. Based on the similar concepts in modulated wideband converter for multiband signals, the scheme of multichannel sampling of streams of pulses can operate at sub-Nyquist rate, which would bring about simplified hardware and robustness to channel failure. So the application of multichannel sampling to the ultrasound imaging is investigated in the paper. The ultrasound signal may be modelled as finite streams of Gaussian pulses. Each channel is comprised of mixing with a properly chosen waveform followed by an integrator. And it has been verified by the experiment that the multichannel sub-Nyquist sampling allows recovery of the delays and amplitudes of ultrasound signals with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Dynamic Transmission Error analysis for CNC Machine Tools under variable speed condition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Traditional methods such as FFT are not applicable for the transmission error analysis when the rotating speed of machine tool is not a constant. The major reason may be attributed the fact that the equal-time sampled series are not stationary in angular domain. If traditional FFT is directly applied to these signals, some fake components will appear in the spectrum. Though interpolation methods could be employed to tackle this problem in theory, it is found in this paper that frequency aliasing may happen if the interpolation is not properly used. To solve the above issue, an anti-aliasing interpolation scheme is originally proposed to avoid frequency aliasing, and the corresponding algorithm has also been design for its fast implementation. The efficiency of the proposed method is proved by both simulations and a real CNC machine. The results show that the proposed method is able to the error source of a gear grinding machine successfully.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of Differential Frequency Hopping Communication system over Rician channel
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) play a progressively important role in both military and civilian affairs, the requirements on its dependability and validity are higher and higher. In order to meet the application requirements of the UAV downlink communication system, we did the theoretical research and analysis based on the basic principles of transmission and reception of differential frequency hopping (DFH) communication systems. In this paper, for a case where the sampling frequency, hopping speed, frequency hopping bandwidth, and frequency hopping points is constant, a theoretical study about the performance analysis of the differential hopping communication systems over Rician fading channels with different fan-out coefficients, full-band jamming, partial-band jamming, and comb spectrum jamming is confirmed. On the whole, the larger the fan-out coefficient, the stronger the anti-jamming comprehensiveness of the differential frequency hopping communication system.

articleTitle: How to Evaluate the Performance of Military Air Traffic Control System in China
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The performance evaluation model and indicators suited for Chinese military air traffic control system was proposed in this paper, based on which we evaluated the performance of certain ATCS in Zheng-Zhou using the comprehensive methods of Improved Analytic Hierarchy Process (I-AHP) and Delphi methods (DM). Simulation results show that compared with the traditional AHP, our comprehensive evaluation methods which consists of I-AHP and Delphi methods can reduce the involvements of experts' experience. Therefore, we can get more objective performance evaluation results.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for Electro-hydraulic Position Servo System of the Elevation-balancing Machine of Artillery Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: An adaptive sliding mode control approach is proposed for the precision control of the electro-hydraulic position servo system of the elevation-balancing machine of artillery platform. Adaptive algorithm is used to estimate uncertain parameters of the system and a simple discontinuous projection mapping is applied to ensure the boundedness of the uncertain estimated parameters, which can reduce the influence of parameter uncertainties. Switching functions is regulated by adaptive algorithm and the chattering problem is avoided. Simulation results show that adaptive sliding mode control algorithm tracks the desired trajectory rapidly with reasonable accuracy and steady-state errors.

articleTitle: Design of a Vehicle Based Data Acquisition System for Inspecting Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Distribution network inspection plays an important role in discovering defects and faults in time, arranging maintenance, and improving the reliability of power supply network. Aiming at the problem that the existing inspection data acquisition of distribution network mainly depends on manual mode and the automation level needs to be improved, a vehicle based data acquisition system is designed. The system structure, hardware and software are presented, and the system has been applied to the practical inspection tasks and improving the efficiency of distribution network inspection.

articleTitle: A novel object detection before tracking filter framework for assistive robot under global vision
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Assistive robots play an important role in recovering the independent life of the disabled people. A novel filter framework is proposed to realize object detection and tracking for the shared control robot system designed to solve the problem of motion parameter extraction. The Lucas Kanade optical flow algorithm is used to detect the motion object. The local image information covered by optical flow region is used as the prior information and the differential histogram is extracted as the object feature. Then uses the mutual tracking algorithm to obtain the object trajectory. Experimental results show that the proposed filtering framework can solve the trajectory tracking problem.

articleTitle: Dynamics Simulation and Design of Spiral Channel of Soot Purification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Spiral channel of soot purification is an important part of the dust removal equipment, which affects the fusion between soot and water curtain. During the design process, straight channel of soot purification is usually designed and optimized. However, the research shows that the separation efficiency of soot purification system is poor. Therefore, the spiral channel is designed in this paper. In the detail, considering the separation efficiency of Spiral channel, the dynamics model of spiral channel is built, and the influence of some parameters on working performance, such as flue diameter, flue cross-sectional shape and inlet velocity, are explored. Finally, the design parameter of spiral channel is optimized. The study results show that the exit velocity increases with increasing the diameter of spiral channel. When the pipe diameter is less than 100 mm, the maximum exit velocity does not change significantly with the pipe diameter. When the pipe diameter is greater than 100 mm, the maximum exit velocity begins to change drastically, and the change in the average exit velocity is small. The cross sectional shape if spiral channel is important parameter, which is concerned with pressure loss coefficient and velocity influence factor. The inlet velocity is decreasing with decreasing outlet pressure.

articleTitle: Automatic Positioning and Grinding Algorithm for Groove of Pipe Joint
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the grinding of the welded joint of the rusted pipe fitting, the grinding of the groove at the pipe joint of the pipe requires automatic adjustment of the positional relationship between the pipe and the grinding head according to the size of the pipe, which is the most complicated stage in the entire automatic grinding process. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes an algorithm for automatic grinding of pipe groove. It includes the positioning and travel distance of the relative positional relationship between the pipe groove and the grinding head motor, and the relationship between the advance and retreat speed and the displacement relationship when the grinding head motor is linked with the pipe groove in the grinding process. The algorithm can automatically adapt to the positional relationship between the grinding head motor and the welded joint of the pipe fitting according to the different radius of the pipe fittings. It has a wide application range and has good practicability, and has been used in actual grinding equipment with good effect.

articleTitle: The Design and Practice of the "Cloud Technology" Based Economic Management Experimental Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The 21st Century is an era of educational informationization, and it is required for economic management experimental teaching to advance with times. Due to the universal problems of economic management teaching such as large difficulties in resource integration and unequal utilization ratio as well as individual problems of the economic management training center of Yangtze Normal University such as decentralized resources of two frameworks of C/S and B/S on software and limited practical training field, it is imperative to conduct the design and practice of "cloud technology" based economic management experimental teaching platform. Mainly including logical structure, software construction and hardware construction, the construction of this platform will further promote the change on learning method and the wide integration of teaching resources, to effectively promote the innovation capabilities and application abilities of students of economic management, to make the students adapt to social and economic development.

articleTitle: A Cortex-M3-Based System-On-Chip Architecture for Wireless Communications in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a Cortex-M3-based system-on-chip (SoC) architecture designed for power-grid-dedicated wireless communication system based on IEEE 802.11ah protocol. The SoC is integrated with a 32-bit embedded microprocessor core using Thumb-2 instruction sets and multiple master/slave devices being compliable with advanced microcontroller bus architecture (AMBA) v2.0 protocol. Along with the various communication interfaces to make the chip more applicable, the whole system can accomplish data communication and processing in power grid applications with high performance and low cost.

articleTitle: Investigations on effects of the acquisition rate on the test accuracy of the data acquisition unit
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the effects of the acquisition on the test accuracy of the data acquisition unit. The DC voltage and resistance are tested with different numbers of power line cycles (NPLC). The standard deviations of test data are calculated to represent the test accuracy. The experimental results show that the test accuracy can be substantially improved by decreasing the acquisition rate for testing the DC voltage and resistance. In addition, it shows that the value of output voltage has little effect on the test accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Automatic Shaping and Processing Equipment for Distribution Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the automatic processing level of distribution line, the key technology of automatic shaping processing of distribution line is studied. Wire tractor structure was designed, and the dual axis drive crawler traction mechanism is adopted to solve the problem of overload and skid during traction. The stamping device and die are designed to realize the automatic stripping of wires, adopts double vertical knife cut vertical pressure method, the wire can be automatically cut off, ensure the quality of the cross section of the wire, An automatic upper terminal device is designed to accurately feed the stripped wire into the terminal for crimping. Through the field test, the equipment has stable and reliable performance, good safety and high efficiency, and realizes the automatic shaping processing of distribution line.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence Degree of Hydrological Parameters for Wave Induction Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The underwater electromagnetic field of marine environment is the background for the underwater vehicle to complete underwater electromagnetic communication. The characteristics of the electromagnetic field of marine environment directly affect the quality of underwater electromagnetic communication. And as the main source of the electromagnetic field of marine environment, the wave induced electromagnetic field is an important research object for domestic and foreign relevant personnel. Because of its complicated production mechanism, many hydrological parameters affect its amplitude distribution. The hydrological impact parameters of it are combed based on the analysis results of wave induced electric field theory in this paper. Combined with the actual hydrological parameter values, we determined the degree of influence of each hydrological parameter in the wave induced electric field and gave the key parameters affecting its amplitude. The research results of this paper can provide references for the establishment of wave induced electric field observation methods and statistical models. Based on the research results of this paper, the amplitude and spatial variation of underwater electric field in different depths under different hydrological parameters can be determined. The conclusions can provide reference information for electromagnetic communication frequency and depth selection of underwater vehicle.

articleTitle: Vibration Decoupling Optimization of Automobile Engine Suspension Mounting System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The design of automobile power assembly mounting system directly affects the vehicle comfort. The energy decoupling method has become an important method for the design of power assembly mounting system. Based on the energy method, people design various computer programs to improve the optimization efficiency. ADAMS is a mechanical system analysis software. ADAMS/View module in ADAMS can conveniently establish dynamics model needed.ADAMS /Vibration can calculate various vibration states, and energy distribution can be output of each mode. It is very suitable for the power assembly mounting system analysis of energy decoupling. Combined with MATLAB software, it can be used on the optimization of existing power assembly mounting system. This paper introduces the principle of energy decoupling method, and uses this principle to simulate and optimize power assembly mounting system of H100.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Angle Tracking Based on Antenna Pattern Under Multipath Effect
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Taking a single-channel monopulse system as an example, the mathematical model of angular error signal generation, modulation and demodulation is deduced from the formation mechanism of sum and difference signal after the signal enters the antenna feed. Based on the measured sum and difference beam pattern data of parabolic antenna, an antenna pattern modeling method is proposed to build a simulation platform of angle error demodulation based on PCM/FM telemetry signal. Then the whole process of angle error demodulation under the condition of multipath effect is simulated and analyzed. It is found that serious multipath interference will cause the polarity of angle error voltage to deflect. Through further analysis, the regularity conclusion of multipath effect on angle error voltage is drawn, and it is verified and analyzed by outfield test.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Modeling Methods for Internet Public Opinion Information
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the method of using mathematical graph theory and Artificial Intelligence idea to establish the Internet public opinion information model. It uses and compares the different mathematical algorithms - classical mathematic model, naïve Bayesian classifier, advanced time series K-means clustering model, self-organizing map (SOM) neural network algorithm and support vector machine (SVM), which are used in constructing the advanced Artificial Intelligence model. Then, it gives out the process of constructing the complete Artificial Intelligence model. Through theoretical analysis and experiment, the coverage rate and time efficiency with different sample size for the above various algorithms are verified. The results show that the advanced time series K-means clustering model can effectively improve both criteria. Besides, it also analyzes the advantages, applicable conditions and limitations of different models.

articleTitle: The high precise conversion method of detection and suppression coordinate system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The detection equipment search target to guide suppression equipment precisely aiming at target. The detection and suppression equipment in different space coordinates. Because of small target, far distance and high precision demand, if we use the one coordinate system, the suppression beam cannot cover the target and cause the failure of suppression. As for this problem, we propose a high-precision detection and suppression coordinates transformation approach. This method explains the mathematic model, transformation and error compensation. Then we explore the measurement method that has practical application value. Finally, we design the experiment to verify the feasibility of the method. This method can be widely applied to transformation of multi-coordinate system.

articleTitle: Optimization and expansion Analysis of WDM Transmission Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM) technology is widely used in transmission networks because of its advantages. With the rapid development of communication services, all the major communication network operators in China are carrying out large-scale expansion of the transmission network. In the later stage of network application, the network performance problems in the stage of network construction gradually appear. It directly affects the stability of the network in the later stage, and needs to be optimized and reformed urgently. In this paper, the current situation of WDM transmission system is analyzed, and the main performance indexes of existing WDM transmission network are optimized and analyzed. And the specific transmission network optimization and expansion of the specific implementation plan.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Traffic Administrative Law Enforcement Command and Dispatching System Base on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the general requirements of ruling the country by laws in an all-round way, management objects based on the transportation industry have the characteristics of complexity and liquidity with the comprehensive law enforcement reform of transportation and the rapid development of law enforcement business. Law enforcements involve a wide range of information channels and complex information contents. There is an urgent requirement for a law enforcement command and dispatch system that combines researches and designs with the application of big data relating to technologies. The "three-dimensional, dynamic and highly efficient" command and dispatch system proposed in this paper is to realize a full-scale and comprehensive monitoring, command and dispatch of law enforcement daily business operations by means of network and big data and other related technologies; realize a multi-channel clue collection application, carry out real-time law enforcement command and dispatch management, and improve the management level and disposal efficiency of law enforcement command and dispatch comprehensively.

articleTitle: Constructing Automatic Writing Template Library of NBA Sports News
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To achieve Automatic Writing of NBA Sports news, Constructing Automatic Writing Template Library of NBA Sports News is a necessary process, normalization of templates is an essential process of constructing template library. This paper uses the Cosine Similarity method and the word2vec word expansion method combined with the Cosine Similarity method to normalize templates respectively. Experimental results show that Using Word2vec word extension method combined with Cosine Similarity method is much more likely to identify the semantics similar sentences, realizing the normalization of the template library, it provide support for that Automatic Writing of NBA Sports News.

Author Keywords: Automatic Writing Template Library of NBA Sports News

articleTitle: An algorithm of Building Extraction by Fusing Spectral and Geometrical Features
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: LiDAR system can obtain 3D information rapidly and conveniently. It has been widely applied in object detection and extraction. However, because of the lack of spectral feature, error detections often occur at dense canopy in building extraction. Aiming at the problem, an algorithm of building extraction fusing spectral and geometrical features is proposed. Firstly, the spectral information is extracted by registration between LiDAR point data and aerial images. Secondly, spectral and geometrical features are fused by improved tensor voting, the new fusion feature is created. Finally, extract building points by random forest algorithm. Simulation test dataset are provided by ISPRS, the simulation results show that building points extraction accuracy is improved a lot after fusing spectral feature. The extraction accuracy reaches 94.26%. The importance of spectral feature has been proved.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Scene Classification Based on Decision-Level Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the convenient acquisition of high spatial resolution remote sensing images, scene classification has attracted great attention in recent years, leading to the boom of scene classification methods. Among these methods, feature-level fusion strategies are widely used. Different from the existing methods, we propose a decision-level fusion method for remote sensing scene classification using the features extracted from convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The classification task is accomplished at the decision level through two steps. In the first step, the top-N possible classes of a test sample are obtained using the features extracted from the soft-max layer of a fine-tuned CNN. In the second step, the final class of the test sample is determined from the above N possible classes using the features extracted from the first fully-connected layers of two fine-tuned CNNs. Thorough experiments conducted on the UC Merced data set and AID data set demonstrate that the proposed method is effective, achieving comparable classification results with the state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, the decision-level fusion strategy is novel, providing a new idea for remote sensing scene classification.

articleTitle: Analysis of the MAP/M/1 Retrial Queueing Model with Markovian Flow of Breakdowns Repairable Server
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper considers an MAP/M/1 retrial queueing model with Markovian flow of breakdowns repairable servers. In the case of blocking, the blocked customers join the infinite waiting positions retrial group in accordance with an FCFS discipline. It assumes that the server is unreliable and repairable. The main queueing indexes are derived by a quasi-birth- and-death (QBD) process. Besides, we conduct some numerical examples to illustrate the effect of the parameters on several performance measures.

articleTitle: On Space Of Topological Graphic Passwords Based On Chinese Characters
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Graphical passwords have been applied in a wide range of scientific areas, as well-known, QR code is a successful example of graphical passwords. In this paper, we design a new-type of graphical passwords, called as Hanzi-gpw, which are the abbreviation of Hanzi graphical passwords, that can be use conveniently and have higher level security in information networks by mean of topological structures and colorings/labellings of graph theory. We estimate the space of Hanzi-gpws, and find that it is easy for converting Hanzi-gpw into text-based passwords. But in general, the operation of "Hanzi-gpw → text-based password" is irreversible, so such property likes that of the Secure Hash Algorithm..

articleTitle: Synchronous Condenser's Application and the Effect of Loss of Excitation on HVDC Receiving End
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the lack of reactive power during failure, high voltage direct current (HVDC) receiving end is prone to commutation failure. Synchronous condenser can force excitation during short time and has flexible reactive power output, which can be used on HVDC receiving end. However, research on synchronous condenser and its loss of excitation is still scarce. This paper analyzes the mechanism of commutation failure on HVDC receiving end, establishes Ximeng-Taizhou HVDC transmission system including synchronous condenser and its excitation control system in PSCAD-EMTDC. In order to verify the reactive power support of synchronous condenser, electrical quantities during the AC system fault when receiving end with or without synchronous condenser are compared. The Impact of synchronous condenser loss of excitation on the stability of HVDC system is discussed under different voltage sag levels. This paper aims to provide theoretical basis for the further research of synchronous condenser.

articleTitle: Positive ramp compensation of Boost converter and its impact on Electromagnetic Interference
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of electromagnetic interference (EMI) in a current mode controlled Boost converter circuit. In order to meet the requirements of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), the circuit introduces a positive ramp compensation to the current reference, which makes the converter system chaotic and reduces the peak values of the power spectrum. By constructing the discrete iterative model of the system and calculating the corresponding eigenvalue, the stability of the converter system is analyzed, which confirms that the positive ramp compensation has the privilege of chaotic anti-control. The results obtained by numerical simulation are consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Time-based Self-Cleaning Control Mechanism in Moving Target Defense
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The static nature of networks gives attackers the asymmetric advantage of time. A new approach called Moving Target Defense (MTD) has emerged as a potential solution to this problem. A time-based self-cleaning control mechanism which comes from MTD is proposed in this paper. This mechanism which is based on trusted timely computing base(TTCB) constantly changes the attack surface by adapting the servers online and service types, in order to prevent attackers probing the system status or completing the attacks successfully. The simulation results show that the time-based self-cleaning mechanism for servers can increase the system security and availability. These results also provide effective references to improve quality of service of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Pendulum Characteristic of Natural Convection Gas within Three-dimensional Closed Cavity
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the pendulum characteristic of natural convection gas within the 3D spherical closed cavity are discussed. By using the finite element method, the flow and temperature field caused by heat source within the 3D spherical closed cavity under different tilted conditions are calculated. The results are as follow: (1) Under buoyancy effect, the direction of natural convection gas in the cavity always stays in the direction of the buoyancy. (2) The isotherm is approximately oval. The temperature field in the direction of buoyancy is stretched and in the vertical direction of buoyancy is compressed. The temperature gradient which is parallel to the baseline near the heat source O is equal with the cavity horizontal. The temperature gradients are not equal with the tilted angle of 10°. The temperature gradient difference Δδ=4.7 K/mm, when the temperature of heat source is 473K and the radius of the closed cavity is 10mm. The temperature gradient difference Δδ=9.5 K/mm with the tilted angle of 20°. (3) The difference of the temperature gradients on both sides increases with the increase of tilted angle. There is a linear relationship between the temperature gradient difference Δδ and the tilted angle θ.

articleTitle: Research of Network Intrusion Detection Based on DF-FSVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the low detection rate in network intrusion detection system, the paper presents a method of imbalanced data classification based on Double Factor FSVM (DF-FSVM). Considering the problem of imbalance and noise and isolated points in the training sample, the FCM clustering method is used to calculate the intra-class imbalanced factor to form the fuzzy membership function. The sample imbalance is caused by factors such as the number and the dispersion of samples. Therefore, inter-class imbalanced factors were introduced in the fuzzy membership function. And machine learning and classification were designed for imbalanced samples based on DF-FSVM. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the detection accuracy of intrusion detection system compared with standard support vector machine (SVM) and fuzzy support vector machine (FSVM).

articleTitle: Harmonic Detection in Electric Power System Using Wavelet Transform and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When using wavelet transform for electric power system harmonic detection, different decomposition scales, wavelet bases, and signal sampling rates have a great impact on the quality of signal decomposition. In order to find a set of parameters with universal ability, this paper proposes a wavelet transform power system harmonic detection method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO), and sets the fitness function. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation experiments, and the decomposition quality of wavelet transform is improved.

articleTitle: Performance of Analysis of LoRa Signal in the Presence of LO Leakage
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the development of the IoT, various communications technologies have emerged which aim to achieve high coverage at low cost and minimal energy consumption. All of those communication networks are called low power WAN (LPWAN). LoRa is one of the LPWAN which is acquiring quite a lot of commercial traction. At the same time, LO leakage (LOL) is a common problem for modern communication system, which can affect the performance significantly. So we analyze the influence of LOL in LoRa, and present the corresponding theoretical model. A simulation on performance of LoRa with LOL has been completed, and the result shows that BER decreases as the SIR grows high, and becomes lowest with specific initial frequency. The loss of nonlinear amplification is simulated as well, and when SIR=40dB, the gain reduces by 0.75dB.

articleTitle: An algorithm about spatial characteristic for non-reference video quality assessment based on visual characteristic
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of computer network technology and communication technology, people's demand for multimedia applications related to video is increasing, and video in the process of compression, transmission and storage will suffer all kinds of damage, so the necessity of research on the video quality assessment algorithm is also growing. In this paper, a non-reference video quality evaluation algorithm combining human visual characteristics with video spatial characteristics is proposed. This method is to use visual features modification and pooling of spatial characteristic parameters, and the experimental results show that there is no reference video quality assessment algorithm performance are improved compared to the direct use of the spatial feature parameters, after joined the human visual characteristics of the factors.

articleTitle: Research on electric load simulator based on dual loop control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The load simulator of electric steering gear can simulate the aerodynamic hinge moment of the steering gear during the flight under the experimental conditions, which is an important device in the hardware in the loop simulation. This paper presents a dual loop servo loading system, from the perspective of actuator structure, the passive tracking load is approximately converted to active load. The frequency band of the system is improved by the influence of the redundant force of the steering gear, and the two degree of freedom H∞ optimal torque tracking strategy is designed to further improve the operating frequency band while improving the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Parallel Design of CMF Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Sequential signal processing based on single digital signal processor (DSP) for Coriolis Mass Flowmeter (CMF) can hardly achieve critical real-time performance. A multi-task parallel signal processing scheme based on dual-core DSP for CMF is proposed in this paper. While the sample-based task implements data acquisition and digital filtering, the frame-based task conducts frequency detection and phase difference detection tasks and etc. The two tasks are synchronized via event-based inter-processor communication. Since no real time operating system (RTOS) is needed for task scheduling, the software is of low complexity. Experimental study verifies the higher real-time performance of the proposed scheme over sequential signal processing.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Method of Information Network Integrated Networking Based on 3D GIS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the integrated networking and connection training of equipment in information network, a block-building modeling method of information network integrated networking based on 3D GIS was proposed, by using the thoughts of component modeling and EBNI modeling for conference. Firstly, the main ideas, modeling framework and operation flow of the method were introduced. Secondly, three items of key technology: the 3D GIS environment modeling, the decomposition of equipment and the reassembled of elements, interaction rules modeling, were analyzed in detail. Finally, a training simulation system was constructed. The effectiveness and feasibility of the method were proved by the application.

articleTitle: A modified algorithm of Guetzli encoder
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Images are the main media type on the Internet. Image compression efficiency plays a key role in image transmission and storage. Recently, Google opened the source code of Guetzli, a subjective quality guided algorithm which can increase the compression rate by 30% compared with the most popular image compression format of JPEG. However, the running speed of Guetzli is too slow. To solve the problem, we propose a modified method based on Guetzli by making the search window variable instead of a constant value, which is able to obtain a higher processing speed while lose an acceptable compression rate. Finally, we present a model with about 70% time cost and nearly the same data size compared with the original Guetzli.

articleTitle: Attitude Control of Over-shoulder Launched Helicopter-borne Missile based on Control-saturation Sliding-mode
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To realize agile turn of over- shoulder launched helicopter-borne missile, an attitude control method based on control-saturation sliding mode was proposed. Firstly, the nonlinear motion equations was established for missile based on aerodynamic/thrust vector composite-control. Secondly, the state space model of single input single output system (SISO) was established by dual-rudder's linear combination strategy. Then, considering actuator limit in low dynamic pressure flight, an attitude control law was designed based on control-saturation sliding mode. Finally 6-DOF trajectory model was established and simulated. Results show that the proposed algorithms can achieve attitude tracking control and control error is less than 0.5 degrees. It meets effectively helicopter-borne missile agile turn.

articleTitle: Technology Research on CH4 Sensor with Pd Catalyst using Supported Nano-material Carrier of γ-Al2O3-ZrO2-ThO2

A nano-material carrier of γ-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-ThO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was designed by chemical deposition based on these templates. articleTitle: Research and application on the model of power parallel data integration
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a model of parallel data integration. Firstly, the paper design an standard interface system based on the Neo4j, which can carry on the interconnection of multi-source data; then there is the algorithm of parallel forward maximum matching to remove redundancy, which can filter redundant data within the system; finally it puts forward the method of data consistency processing for correlation degree, which can repair inconsistent data by determining the relation between data, according to the cosine of the angle between the feature vector value. By the experiment of data integration based on a electric power dispatching center, it can verify the validity of the data integration model.

articleTitle: Network-based control of discrete-time Systems with nonlinear perturbation and transmitting data constraint
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper considered the stability analysis and stabilization problems of the discrete-time networked control systems (NCSs) with nonlinear perturbation and transmitting data constraint. The transmitting data of the sensor to the controller and the controller to the actor channels was processed by signal transmission deadbands. In the consideration of time-varying delays, data transmitting deadbands, and nonlinear disturbance, the model for the discrete-time NCS was presented. By using the novel Lyapunov functional approch, the new stability analysis and stabilization conditions for the discrete-time NCS were proposed, which are in terms of linear matrix inequality.

articleTitle: Design of Simplified Signal Generator and DC Power Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the purpose to improve the use convenience of electronic measuring system instruments, we design a simplified signal generator and DC power integrated system by taking AT89C52 Single Chip Microcomputer as the core and combined with Programmable Gain Amplifier Technology, LCD Technology, Filter Technology, Regulator Technology and V-I Technology. As the test, the output sine-wave frequency from the system is 1Hz~30Hz with the amplitude 1~5V and output error not more than 63Hz; the output DC voltage is 1.25V~3.7V with the output error not more than 0.3V; the output DC current is 4mA~20mA with the output error not more than 0.8mA, presenting the system meets the normal demand of electronic measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Application of TDOA Wi-Fi Positioning Based on Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Taking into account that TDOA genetic algorithm is susceptible to measurement error, TDOA positioning algorithm based on adaptive genetic algorithm (ADGA) is proposed in this paper on the basis of original TDOA positioning algorithm which is based on genetic algorithm. In addition to applying the dynamical crossover and mutation probability distribution in the evolutionary process, the distribution of the parent and the individual progeny are also taken into consideration in the improved algorithm, so as to avoid premature convergence. The simulation results show that the method is effective, and the positioning accuracy is vastly improved when Gaussian noise is used.

articleTitle: A Novel Power Quality Disturbance Recognition Method Based on Improved HHT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Most of the power quality disturbances are complex power quality disturbances in practical engineering applications. Algorithm based on SAX (symbolic aggregate approximation) signal into a series of symbols, and then according to the differences between different symbols, find the singular value point, and then confirm the time of beginning and ending disturbances and end time, then according to these time to signal segment, and then uses the HHT (Hilbert-Huang Transform) extraction of characteristic value, the use of decision tree for power quality disturbance identification. However, in the face of high frequency small value or similar frequency disturbance, the traditional HHT cannot be decomposed. The iterative HHT is adopted to improve the accuracy and avoid the phenomenon of modal aliasing.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Compliant Constant Force Hand Claw Based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The compliant mechanism satisfies the design requirements through its own deformation. This paper mainly introduces the design and simulation of compliant and constant force hand claws for injection molding manipulator. The mechanism was analyzed and designed to divide the motion process. First, motion analysis and qualitative analysis were carried out for the mechanism. So the influence of joint number on the constant output clamping force was obtained. The related design parameters were obtained by trial and error method. The design parameters were proven reasonable on Matlab simulation. It will lay a foundation for further research on the constant force grasping over injection molding manipulator in the future.

Author Keywords: Compliant and constant force hand claws

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low Power FMCW Radar System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the short range of FMCW radar, a S band FMCW coherent radar system is designed with Mini-Circults Series RF devices as the core. The production mode and signal processing mode of FM signal are improved. Compared with the traditional radar system, this design has the advantages of low cost, good maintenance, and large room for improvemengood maintenance, and large room for improvement.t.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Parallel Topology Analysis Algorithm of Coalmine High-voltage Power Network based on First-come-first-serve
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the existing adaptive topology analysis algorithm of coalmine high voltage power network based on correlation matrix, there are problems of high time complexity and low computational efficiency. By introducing the first-come-first-serve parallel scheduling algorithm into the adaptive topology analysis algorithm, the computational efficiency can be improved to a certain extent. The simulation results show that compared with the existing adaptive topology analysis algorithm based on correlation matrix, the calculation efficiency can be further improved and the time cost can be reduced.

articleTitle: User Mining Algorithm Based On PageRank Modeling Improvement and Comprehensive Influence Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Microblog has become the most popular medium of mass information dissemination. Users can know more friends in this virtual network through microblog's recommendation function. For example, Sina microblog, users can find like-minded people through the "add friends - interest" module, at present, microblog only recommends authenticated users or users' friends, and does not recommend most influential users to them. In view of the shortcomings mentioned above, this paper improves the PageRank modeling and adds the assessment of interaction and personal influence, thus improving the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the influential users' mining. In order to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the algorithm, the real user data on Sina microblog based on Python grabbing were used for algorithm simulation, the experimental results show this algorithm has obvious advantages in terms of accuracy and recall rate when searching for potential influential users.

articleTitle: Connection Pattern Based Android Network Traffic Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Network traffic clustering plays a fundamental role in network flow analysis. Existing Android network traffic clustering methods have three shortages. First, these methods always focus on partial features, such as port numbers, with the absence of holistic features. Second, existing methods sometimes fail to work if payload of one network package is encrypted. Third, some methods are valid only for several specific application-layer network protocols. To handle these inefficiencies, we adopted network-connection-pattern based features to facilitate Android network traffic clustering. First, a record platform was constructed. This platform executed 575 Android applications and recorded network traffic. Second, we obtained input datasets of clustering through the record platform and extracted features based on network connection pattern. Then, we clustered the input datasets. Finally, we employed Information Gain algorithm and Fast Correlation-Based Filter algorithm separately to rank contributions of features according to the clustering results. Experiments show that the network-connection-pattern-based features lead to more efficient clustering result than the port-number-based features.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Internet Public Opinion Monitoring and Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the frequent occurrence of Internet public opinion on the Internet, this paper analyzes the Internet public opinion monitoring and analysis system requirements and business processes. It introduces five-layer architecture of public opinion monitoring and analysis system, which consist of information automatic collection, information preprocessing, public opinion database, public opinion analysis and service, as well as public opinion visualization and report. Then, we study the implementation of key technologies in the system, including public opinion information collection technology, information search and clustering analysis, speech analysis and trend prediction analysis. Compared with the original system, the extraction accuracy of the theme and the accuracy of predicting the trend of public opinion for this redesigned system are significantly improved, which further verify the correctness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Data Independent Karhunen-Loéve Transform for Image and Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Transform coding plays an important role in image and video compression. The Karhunen-Loéve transform (KLT) is the optimal transform for its full decorrelation ability. However, there is no general algorithm that enables its fast computation since the KLT is data dependent. Instead, the discrete cosine transform (DCT) is used widely for its good energy compaction and fast implementation algorithm. The DCT matrix can be derived by letting the correlation coefficient ρ be 1 for the Markov-1 model of signal. Since such a perfectly correlated signal is rare the DCT is usually suboptimal. In this letter, taking the real image signal into consideration and setting the ρ to be a value ρ* closer to the actual correlation coefficient in the real image, we obtain the data independent KLT (diKLT). Experimental results show that the diKLT outperforms DCT in terms of the mean square error (MSE) and structural similarity (SSIM) as long as the ρ* is big enough and the retained transform coefficients are sufficient. Although the superiority of diKLT over DCT is not prominent the advantage that a transform independent of data outperforms DCT is worthy to be noticed.

articleTitle: A Compound Method for Identifying and Suppressing the Thrust Fluctuation of Synchronous Linear Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Thrust fluctuation of linear motor is caused by many factors, of which the detent force caused by cogging effect and end effect changes periodically with the displacement of linear motor mover, and non-periodic thrust fluctuation is caused by the change of load resistance, nonlinear friction, motor parameters changing and other factors. If the detent force feedforward compensation or disturbance observer (DOB) is used simply to suppress thrust fluctuation, the effect is not satisfactory. In this paper, the two methods mentioned above are combined effectively.
