The parameters of the detent force model are identified by the improved tabu search algorithm, on the basis of this, a feedforward controller is designed, and the integral + proportional form DOB is applied to form a compound controller. The experimental results show that the proposed method fully suppresses thrust fluctuation of linear motor, and the system tracking accuracy is improved significantly.

articleTitle: Accurate Measurement of Optical Angle Sensing based on Polynomial Fitting Tool
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the automatic measurement of light angle instrument, all of the experimental light sources have nonlinear attenuation characteristics. A nonlinear compensation method based on polynomial fitting is proposed and a specific experiment is given. The computer controlled equipment is designed as a sensor with an unknown tilt angle to automatically capture the incident light illumination angle. The compensation method model is a polynomial curve fitted through the least square method. It is shown that the compensation result makes the calibrated angle sensor more accurate in outdoor experiments than the uncompensated angle sensor.

articleTitle: Research on High Precision Terrain Dynamic Loading Technology Based on Flight Trajectory Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at establishing a high-precision large-scale scene in flight simulation, a high-precision terrain dynamic loading method based on flight trajectory prediction is proposed. The dynamic Bayesian network model for aircraft maneuver online identification is established according to the flight parameter. What's more, the flight trajectory prediction mathematical model is designed for each maneuver motion, which improves the accuracy of flight trajectory prediction. By predicting the flight trajectory and line of sight direction of the aircraft in the future, the view frustum culling algorithm is used to accurately select and load the terrain block. Experiments show that the proposed method can dynamically load terrain with high efficiency, which can solve the problem of terrain "missing blocks" effectively and make up for the problem of slow data scheduling between memory and external memory.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Energy Saving Scheme of DTN based on Geographic Grid for Human Living Areas
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Delay Tolerant Network (DTN) is playing a pivotal role in the future human living areas, especially in the future development of smart cities. In the future smart cities, the available energy resources are very limited. In this condition, the intelligent transmission is required as soon as possible, to achieve the goal of saving energy resources. At present, most of the researches focus on optimizing the transmission unit or routing algorithm for prolonging the network life time. There is no good adaptive energy saving scheme according to urban environmental rules. In this paper, an energy protection mechanism under human encounter characteristics is proposed in terms of AESS (Adaptive Energy Saving Scheme based on geographic grid) approach, which can be applied to various DTN routing protocols such as Epidemic, Prophet, ADAF etc. According to the rules in the urban scenarios, nodes can sleep dynamically to save energy. Simulation results verify the performance of proposed AESS which is used in Epidemic, Prophet and ADAF , under an urban scenario, are better than the corresponding original algorithm in delivery ratio, network overhead ratio and energy consumption status.

articleTitle: Circular Trajectory Planning with Pose Control for Six-DOF Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a circular trajectory planning with pose control for the six-DOF manipulator. Establish a circular trajectory according to the variable input points and radian values in Cartesian coordinate system. Then take the piecewise quintic polynomials as the motion model of the end-effector to ensure the jerk curves are continuous. Finally, accomplish the motion planning under the kinematic constraints to achieve the stable operations of the manipulator. The synchronous control for position and orientation achieves the pose control. Requiring the end-effector to move with the different orientation control schemes along the same trajectory path is usual. In this paper, two different fixed orientation control schemes are introduced and the simulation experiments for them show the circular trajectory planning of the six-DOF manipulator with pose control is effective.

articleTitle: Structural Damage Detection Based on Statistical Process Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In most of the present research on damage detection, secondly processed raw monitoring data of structures are usually used. In order to deal with the above problem, damage detection was implemented based on the raw measured data using techniques of statistical process control (abbreviation of SPC) in this paper. However, those data are measured with rather high frequency of sampling, which often produces strong correlations of them and makes errors of damage detection finally. In order to alleviate those negative effects, techniques of SPC were carried out using residuals between raw data and predicted ones of autoregressive (abbreviation of AR) models, and furthermore the minimum problem was given with the objective function of Aktain’s information criterion (abbreviation of AIC) to obtain appropriate orders of AR models. The Benchmark structure, proposed by International Association for Structural Control and American Society of Civil Engineers, was adopted as the case study to prove validity of the method proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of the Ridge Thickness of the CAM with Large Swing Angle and Multiple Arcs based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the design of large swing Angle multi - head arc CAM,the phenomenon of thin ridge and over-cutting is often easy to occur.These phenomena can easily lead to machining and assembly errors or even scrap situations.In this paper, the thin ridge problem of multi-head cams with large swing Angle is discussed and studied in depth.This paper presents a method to approximate the ridge thickness of arc CAM by using the knowledge of space curve distance in differential geometry.And using MATLAB as a programming tool.The ridge thickness of multi - head cams with large swing Angle is calculated and modeling with creo verily the correctness of the conclusion.

Author Keywords: Large swing Angle multi - head arc CAM mechanism

articleTitle: Investigations on the reaction characteristics of direct carbon fuel cell with molten antimony anode
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to investigate the reaction characteristics of direct carbon fuel cell with the molten antimony anode, the corresponding experimental system together with the reactor is designed and manufactured. The predicted reaction mechanisms in the molten Sb anode are analysed before the experiment. Then the cell performances including the open circuit voltage, the maximum current density and the electrochemical impedance spectroscopy are tested in the battery, the reducing gas fuel and the carbon fuel modes, respectively. The effects of reaction temperature and Sb quantity on the cell performance are studied. The results show that the cell performance can be improved by increasing the reaction temperature in all of three modes and deteriorated with too less antimony in the first two modes. The cell performance using the molten Sb anode is also compared with that employing the molten Sn anode, in which the discrepancies are analysed and the optimization methods are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-thread Parallel Computing Fault-Tolerant Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the high reliability and high efficiency of parallel computing system for parallel computing, according to the basic methods and ideas of computer system reliability and fault-tolerant technology, the design of multi thread and multi thread parallel fault-tolerant computer system is proposed and the midway message and isolation in the calculation process are presented. The corresponding model design and technical evaluation work are carried out. The simulation verification shows that the design of multi thread parallel computing fault tolerance model can effectively improve the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Test Method of Bus Interconnection Technology in Spacecraft Data System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: 1553B bus data processing occupies an important position during the voyage. Accurate, efficient and fast data processing is the main link to improve the finalization of the spacecraft's various systems. The practical application of 1553B bus data processing technology shows that it is of great significance to adopt new testing means and methods, among which the investigation and study of bus interconnection technology will help to improve the testing and diagnostic level, improve the development efficiency and meet the mission reliability and security of the system.

articleTitle: Vibration Modal Analysis of Parallelogram Linkage Palletizing Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: this paper analyzes the relationship between vibration modal characteristics and mechanical size of parallelogram linkage palletizing robot, the post optimization were proposed based on the analyze result. First, palletizing robot kinematics was established as the foundation for the kinematic analysis, then building the mechanical model of the main institutions of the palletizing robot for finite element analysis, using finite element analysis software analyzed vibration modes of the palletizing robot at two typical postures, analyzed the first six modals of the two typical postures, The natural frequency of vibration modes and Vibration mode shapes were obtained; In the optimization design, the optimization is to improve the first-order vibration modes frequency. Optimization design carried on from both structure and materials aspects, through the actual parameters simulation; the optimization results were obtained and verified.

articleTitle: Study on deformation and dynamic clearance of the injection mechanism under temperature control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In squeeze casting, changes of the clearance between punch and chamber under thermal-mechanical loading impact the injection process of greatly, including the stability and precision of the forming process. This study aims to control the changes of the dynamic clearance to ensure the smooth operation of the injection mechanism. A temperature control method by cooling punch was proposed, and two cases of vertical injection processes, cooling and non-cooling, were simulated during ten forming cycles, besides the corresponding actual experiment was carried out. The results of simulation and experience indicated that the temperature control method which primarily affected the punch's deformation is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Installation Method of On-board Detection Equipment for Distribution Line
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional inspection method for distribution lines is manual inspection, which uses paper media to record work content. This method has many shortcomings, it is highly susceptible to human factors, and the management cost is too high. It is failed to understand the inspection status of the patrol. In order to improve the efficiency and quality of inspection and improve economics, State Grid Shandong Electric Power Company has developed an on-board intelligent inspection system for distribution lines. The detection probe installs on the top of the vehicle, which is composed of visible light camera, infrared thermography, and ultrasonic testing device. Due to the ultrasonic testing device is installed in the detection probe; therefore the distance from the detected object is far away, which affects the accuracy of data collection. In tackling these questions, this paper designs an on-board detection device suitable for distribution lines inspection and proposes installation method.

articleTitle: Structural design and optimization of modular underactuated multi-fingered manipulator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the configuration diversity and flexibility of the manipulator jaw, a kind of modular under-actuated multi-finger manipulator claw is proposed, which is mainly composed of modular fingers, indexing mechanism and drive mechanism. The jaw can be configured with different numbers and configurations of fingers according to the work requirements, and the finger positioning mechanism is designed to improve the adaptability of the grasping action. The three-dimensional model of the manipulator jaw is established, and the kinematics simulation is carried out to study the motion characteristics of the fingers mechanism. Besides, the paper analyze the influence of each component in the fingers on the fingers movement and optimize the design of the sensitive components. According to the D-H method, the mathematical model of the fingers is established, and the forward kinematics analysis of the manipulator jaw is performed, and the working space of the jaw is simulated and verified. Optimized analysis by the modular fingers of the opponent's jaw expands the working space of the jaw and improves the operating efficiency of the entire gripper.

articleTitle: The Design and Completion of No Resource Attitude Measurement Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the inertial navigation system(INS) will be accumulated over time, the course angel error can be diverged especially. The structure of SINS/Gravity/Log integrated navigation system was designed based on the current equipment of space tracking ship. 12 dimension of Kalman filter is extended which will correct the error of system calculated. The experiment results shows that the Algorithm designed can efficiently improve the performance and meet the long-endurance, high-precision attitude measurement requirements.

articleTitle: Decision of maintenance shop planning project based on TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Concentrative planning of maintenance shop sets up former address continuation, new address remotion construction or new address augment construction. The planning decision method based TOPSIS is present. Make use of principium of TOPSIS, the optimized decision model for choosing planning project is deducted by designing up evaluation index. The example planning is given to validate the planning model and method.

articleTitle: Research on Single-Phase Grid-Connected Inverter Based on PR Regulator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Inverter adopts PR controller to realize the control of current without static difference. Taking single-phase full-bridge inverter as the research object, the mathematical model of single-phase grid-connected inverter is analyzed, in order to realize grid-connected inverter. The static control of the output AC current is designed. A PR controller is designed. The current loop simulation model is built by Matlab/Simulink. The results show that the proportional resonance (PR) control can realize the static-free control of the fundamental sinusoidal current.

articleTitle: Generation Mechanism and Suppression Strategy of Background Harmonic Current at MMC AC Side
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: MMC AC-side current is subject to distortion by background harmonic current under low load conditions. In this paper, the generation mechanism of background harmonic current at MMC AC side was studied, and the influence of background harmonics on capacitor voltage of MMC sub-modules was analyzed. On the basis of this, the harmonic current generated by a particular background harmonic was calculated and the generating rules of harmonic current were obtained. MMC harmonic mathematical model was established, and AC-side harmonic current suppression strategy was proposed. A simulation model based on the field parameters of flexible DC transmission project was built, and the control strategy of this paper was verified by the simulation. The simulation results show that the harmonic current composition is consistent with the theoretical analysis, and each harmonic component is effectively suppressed, which proves the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Novel Metal Fixture with Extra Tuning Function for Millimeter Wave Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A cylindrical dielectric-resonator-based millimeter-wave antenna is presented in this paper. A novel fixture is utilized. It consists of a pair of hook-shaped probes which are place in the same direction as the feeding slot. It is soldered with both the ground plane and cylindrical resonator antenna. The fixture not only has favorable fabrication simplicity and satisfying stability, but also tuning function. It brings about extra degree of design freedom. The HEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11δ</sub> excited by the slot is either purified or suppressed by the pair of probes with different locations. Therefore, the fixture has potential to work as coupling assistors, isolation enhancers or cross-polarization suppressers. The antenna operates at 24 GHz with a bandwidth of 18.2%, and a gain of 6.1 dBi. The antenna is suitable for modern communication systems like automotive radars and other systems at even high bands.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Biomechanical Information Acquisition Platform for Human Motion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper a comprehensive biomechanical information platform about human motion is proposed. This platform integrated different ways which can process measured biomechanical data conveniently and guarantee synchronization acquisition for different usage. A new design of biomechanical six axes force plate based on holistic structure and flexible pressure sensors array is introduced and Video motion capture and EMG technology are also discussed in detail. This platform is very meaningful for the therapy, animation and sports scene.

articleTitle: Influence of the Voltage Level on the Propagation Characteristics of Optical Signals Gener-ated by GIL Partial Discharge
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Partial discharge occurs with acoustic, electrical, optical, and thermal phenomena. In the study of UHF electromagnetic signals generated by PD, it was found that different voltage levels and size structures of power equipment have an impact on the signal propagation. This article used the research ideas of UHF signals to simulate and model different voltage levels of GIL and simulated the propagation of optical signals in GIL. By observing the optical parameters on the detection planes and the detection point, the influence of voltage level on the propagation of the optical signals in GIL was studied, which provides a reference for GIL equipment manufacturing and partial discharge optical detection research.

articleTitle: Research on Cleaning and Drying Process of Quartz Wafer based on Orthogonal Experiment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The insulation impedance resistance value is the decisive factor to realize the "quasi static" measurement by the multidimensional piezoelectric force sensor. In order to improve the insulation impedance of the quartz wafer, the sources of contamination and the impact on measurement performance are analyzed. By analyzing and comparing the existing cleaning methods on the quartz wafer surface, three kinds clearing methods on the quartz wafer are designed. The cleaning process of quartz wafers is made. The drying technology of quartz crystal is studied. Finally, the insulation impedance resistance test is designed and carried out. The main factors which affect the impedance of the insulation are analyzed. The optimum selection of cleaning temperature, drying time and cleaning method is obtained through orthogonal test. This paper provides an important reference for the piezoelectric sensor to realize high impedance quartz chip for quasi-static measurement.

articleTitle: Supermarket security system based on STC89C52 , PLC and KingView
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper is mainly about the design of the security system for supermarket mainly including the upper computer part and the lower. The lower computer is the hardware design and software design of MCU and PLC. And the upper computer is mainly the design of configuration interface and configuration program design. The hardware circuit design adopts STC89C52 as the main control module to regulate flame sensor module, gas sensor module, infrared sensor module and serial port module. PLC uses FX-2N series as the actuator to realize the sound-light alarm and the directional light for personnel evacuation. At the same time, KingView is used as a real-time display of collected data and data circulation tool between MCU and PLC. Software design and debugging is a necessary way to realize the system. The design of supermarket security system is mainly used to timely alarm when the fire and gas leakage occur in the warehouse, counter, kitchen and other places of the supermarket, in order to reduce financial loss and personal injury.

articleTitle: Research on Recognition System of Facial Expression for the Robot to Help Elder and Disabled
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the inflexibility of human-computer interaction for the robot to help elder and disabled, this paper introduces the recognition technology of facial expression to integrate with the robot. So, the robot can perform corresponding actions according to different facial expression, which greatly improves the convenience for human to control robot. This thesis mainly focuses on the accuracy of face location, the recognition rate of expression recognition and the application of expression recognition system. This thesis is trained and tested on the HELEN face dataset and the self-built face dataset respectively. The tests achieve good results in both face alignment experiments and facial expression recognition experiments. Finally, by combining the expression recognition system with robot platform of helping elder and disabled, the purpose of controlling the movement of the robot by expression information is realized, which proves the feasibility of the method.

Author Keywords: the robot of helping elder and disabled

articleTitle: The Fingerprinting Analysis of Power Amplifier Predistortion Error from Wideband Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Radio frequency fingerprinting is caused by the hardware non-ideality, especially the analog components' non-ideality. With the rapidly increasing demands for higher data transmission rate, the requirements for efficient modulation schemes and wider channel bandwidth are continuously increasing, which needs digital predistortion (DPD) to eliminate the nonlinear and memory effect of the power amplifier. Aiming at the power amplifier predistortion error, this paper analyzes and identifies typical DPD architectures. Firstly, a power amplifier behavior model which coefficients extracted from a real PA is used. Then, three typical DPD architectures are employed to compensate the PA's nonlinear and memory effect respectively. The DPD and PA architecture is stimulated by a 5 MHz long term evolution (LTE) signal. Finally, the three DPD and PA architectures are identified above a neural network classifier using overall AM-AM and AM-PM performance. The analysis and simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Detection Method of Aircraft in Remote sensing image Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The detection and identification of aircraft in high-resolution remote sensing image has important military and civilian value. Aiming at the difficulty of aircraft detection in remote sensing image, this paper proposes a fast detection method based on deep learning. This method avoids the problem of designing manual features in the traditional aircraft detection. It provides a more general and concise solution to solve the problem of aircraft detection in remote sensing image. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of the method is 84.58%, and the recall rate is 89.3%, The detection speed reaches 50f/s. This method is reasonable and feasible. This paper also analyzes the errors in the detection and provides a reference for the next optimization.

articleTitle: A classification method of Active Protection System radar for distinguishing moving missiles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The target classification of interceptor system faces with the problems of high speed, short sampling time, and high echo fluctuation and so on. In order to distinguish the intercept target effectively, this paper proposes a method of echo difference with different frequency points. The data of two channels sampling from different frequency points, is compared to distinguish the target. This method can distinguish large threat projectile target and small non threat bullets target, reducing false alarm rate and avoiding mistaken injury to our own personnel under battlefield environment.

articleTitle: Enforcing security for real-time multicore embedded system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Most of the complex real-time embedded control systems are composed of security-critical system and non-security-critical system, and consolidating them into a single hardware is a development trend. For security requirements of such systems, in this paper, a secure and reliable multi-core architecture of real-time embedded system is proposed, which has a malicious behavior detection mechanism and guarantees a lossless control. Introducing a hypervisor software layer, it realizes the consolidation of security-critical and non-security-critical system into a multicore processor and complete isolation. The execution behavior of control application is detected by the instruction stream tracking module and security core in the security-critical part which uses two cores. The proposed detection algorithm uses hashing operation to mask the complexity introduced by the instruction set diversity, which makes the detection has universal applicability to the embedded systems with various instruction set. The experimental results show that this method can detect unplanned code execution with minimum granularity, and with small average detection latency.

articleTitle: Application of Grid Spectrum Monitoring in Power Wireless Private Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the frequency resource management and wireless interference location in the power wireless private network, , a grid spectrum monitoring system for the application scene of the power wireless private network is designed based on the comprehensive consideration of the development status of the spectrum monitoring technology and the actual needs of power wireless private networks, and the overall architecture, technical architecture, business architecture and system functions are presented, and the key technologies and the next research direction are analyzed. The application of the system will play an important role in the frequency resource planning, network optimization and rapid operation & maintenance of the power wireless private network.

articleTitle: SPIFFY: A Simpler Image Viewer for Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Medical imaging visualization technology takes a significant role in the medical community. With the assistance of medical imaging visualization applications, huge convenience has been brought into clinical diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment. It allows doctors and researchers to see inside the human body, to identify medical problems, and to diagnose diseases. This article presents a lightweight, fast and user-friendly image viewer for medical imaging called SPIFFY. Some developing methodologies with the integration of VTK, ITK, and Qt will be presented in this article. Besides, the minimalist user interface(UI) design of SPIFFY with an application of Human-Computer Interaction(HCI) psychology principles will also be introduced. Moreover, this article will identify the benefits provided by SPIFFY and present a benchmark against some existing medical visualization applications. Experiments using cognitive walkthrough evaluation shows that SPIFFY provides both high effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Speed control characteristics of ultrasonic motor drive control system based on DDS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the open-loop speed control characteristics, frequency-speed characteristics and low-frequency PWM duty cycle-speed characteristics of the ultrasonic motor drive and control system based on DDS were studied. The experimental results show that the output waveform of the ultrasonic motor drive and control device based on DDS can be satisfied the functional requirements of the ultrasonic motor drive and control system.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Kinematics Analysis of Compound-driven Pipeline Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A compound-drive pipeline robot was proposed, which can solve the problems of inaccurate positioning, low detection quality and poor adaptability of traditional differential pressure pipeline robot. The mechanism and advantages of the compound-driven mode with motor and fluid differential pressure were studied and the structure design and working principle of the compound-driven pipeline robot based on pipeline constraint were analyzed. Through simulation analysis, the kinematic characteristics of the compound-drive pipeline robot under multiple working conditions were studied. the results show that the compound-driven structure of the robot can provide multiple working statuses that meets the requirements of high-quality inspection and maintenance in the pipeline conditions.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Electric Power Big Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the background of the presentation of panoramic visualized analysis,this paper proposed the scene management method of 3D electric power big data visualization. The space partition algorithm is optimized by the method. The organization and association model of electric power big data scene is constructed. The objects, the environment, and the real-time analysis data are overall organized. And, the real-time switch of the display status of the object and the environment in the scene and the fast rendering of the scene roaming are realized. Finally, the experiment conducted on the scene management in the 3D visualized analysis system of the substation data demonstrates effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Robotic Assembly Work Using Force Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the method of automatic installation of large equipment robot is deeply studied. This system achieves motion control and completes assembling process by calculating the trajectory of the target according to its spatial coordinates and attitude. The system use the ATI six axis force/torque sensor to acquire information and compliant force control algorithm to avoid the acceleration phase, and reduce the interference of inertia force. At the same time, the problem of inertial shock and vibration affecting the control effect in the course of motion is solved by acquiring in advance, analyzing and filtering interference waveform. The force and torque, compensated by the gravity component of a certain direction, are transformed into space coordinates to calculate the increment of motion, and then the motion is carried out by the controller. Finally, the validity of the method is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: No-reference Distorted Image Quality Assessment Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new no-reference Image Quality Assessment (IQA) algorithm for distorted image using deep learning network is proposed. The algorithm is composed of three steps. First, a multi-layer convolutional neural network is designed, which consists of four convolutional layers, four pooling layers and three fully connected layers. Second the original distortion image database is used to train the network. In order to solve the problem of insufficient training samples, this paper proposes an image segmentation method to segment the image expansion data set. Third, the trained network is used to predict the distorted image quality score. And it is not necessary to manually extract image features, it makes full use of the deep convolutional network learning ability. Experimental results on four open distorted image databases show that the proposed method predicted distorted image quality scores results have high consistency with the subjective assessment results. This method overall performance is better than other classic image quality assessment method.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-object Job-shop Scheduling Strategy under Uncertain Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved PSO algorithm to optimize the RBF neural network(IPSO-RBF)for function approximation on the basis of the multi-objective stochastic scheduling model established by predecessors using stochastic programming knowledge. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can solve the job-shop scheduling problem. The accuracy and speed of the solution have been improved.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling of cement denitrification under typical working conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Cement denitrification is an important part of cement production. In cement denitrification control, cement denitrification under a single model is difficult to achieve the desired control effect. Based on the statistical analysis of production site data, this paper adopts K-means clustering method to classify working conditions, and establishes a dynamic model of continuous characteristics of each typical working condition. The simulation proves the validity and practicability of the model. To lay the foundation for the SNCR denitrification control under multiple conditions.

articleTitle: New Techniques For Topological Graphic Passwords Made By Chinese Characters
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Graphical passwords are convenient for mobile equipment with touch screen. QR code is a successful example of graphical passwords. In this paper, we design a new-type of graphical passwords, called Hanzi-gpw, which are the abbreviation of Hanzi graphical passwords, that can be use conveniently and have higher level security in information networks by mean of topological structures and colorings/labellings of graph theory. Hanzi-gpw can be saved in computer by classical matrices and run quickly than the existing graphical passwords. In the course of our research Chinese Characters, we find a new-type of graph labellings called flawed graceful labelling, so we can keep their disconnected property. Our result can be provided two or more users and to meet the needs of special populations. The methods can easily be converted into polynomial time algorithms.

articleTitle: ROBOCON2018 Robot Overall Control System Design(Passing Robot)
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the design of the overall control system of ROBOCON2018 croquet robot, and briefly describes the connection principle between motor, motor drive, electric push rod, sensor, etc. and STM32 main control chip. The connection diagram of STM32 MCU and the above hardware and the main software implementation flow chart are given. Based on the actual debugging situation, the whole control system has good stability under the premise of realizing the function.

articleTitle: The comparison analysis of typical control strategies for LCL type inverter in Frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The LCL type inverter plays a significant role in the grid integration of renewable energy, the control strategies are the key factor to influence the performance of inverter. In this paper, several typical control strategies in synchronous or stationary frame for LCL type inverter are compared and analyzed in frequency domain to interpret the similarities and differences among them. First, the transfer functions of control strategy in synchronous frame are deduced to the stationary frame in frequency domain. Then, all of control strategies are compared and analyzed in the stationary frame to derive the essential reason of similarities and differences in detail. It is shown that the performance of PI controller in synchronous frame and PR controller in stationary frame can achieve the zero steady state error since two transfer function of are similar, however, PI controller in stationary frame cannot eliminate the steady state error because the integration of PI controller is only suitable for dc component. At last, the simulation platform is built in MATLAB Simulink, the simulation result verified the above analysis of transfer function in frequency domain.

articleTitle: Intelligent digital alarm clock
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: There are many design methods for digital clock, but this paper designed a single chip microcomputer STC89C52, DS1302 clock chip, DS18B20 temperature sensor and LCD1602 liquid crystal display are the main components, adopting microcontroller C language programming, which has the intelligent digital alarm clock with time and temperature display, alarm setting, time of the hour on the hour and lunar viewing.

articleTitle: Modeling, Control and Simulation of Underwater Kite
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The modeling of underwater kite is carried out, and the influence of tether tension on the stability of attitude is analyzed. A method of trajectory control for underwater kites is presented, which is simple and easy to implement and can output smooth heading angle commands. The attitude control law for tracking heading angle commands is designed. Based on the proposed trajectory control method and the attitude control method, the simulation of the kite's six degrees of freedom motion is carried out, and the effectiveness of this method is verified. The influences of flow velocity and elevation angle on the trajectory characteristics and velocity of underwater kite are analyzed through the motion simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Airborne Data Bus Test Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the advantages of high reliability, low delay, certainty, etc., military 1394B bus is used as the onboard data bus in aircraft such as F-35 and X-47B, which brings a new choice to the aircraft designer bus selection. For system designers, bus testing of onboard systems is critical and complete bus testing will guarantee system communication. This paper carries out related research according to the protocol of 1394B bus. In the test and test, start from the aspects of cable, physical layer, link layer, AS56643 protocol and application layer of military 1394B bus, and propose a wide-scale airborne data bus test method for other airborne data bus test reference.

articleTitle: Lower-Limb Soft Orthotic Device for Gait Assistance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we present a soft wearable orthotic device for gait assistance. The components of the orthotic device are mainly made of soft materials and the device only has a mass of 680 g worn on the subjects lower extremity, which do not add significant inertia during walking. Fully soft pneumatic artificial muscles (PAMs) with low threshold pressures are utilized as actuators. A bundle of four PAMs are used to provide force for the plantarflexion of ankle joint in certain gait period. The gait cycle is detected by two inertial measurement units (IMUs) mounted on the calf and foot braces, respectively. The orthotic device applies a force of 65 N for ankle plantarflexion, which corresponds to 3.5% of the nominal biological force at the ankle joint during walking.

articleTitle: Human-Computer Interaction Using Fingertip Based on Kinect
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Controlling the computer through the hand and eye is a new type human-computer interaction, which overcomes the problem of insufficient flexibility in controlling the traditional computer through the mouse and keyboard. This kind of human-computer interaction is more natural and is an inevitable trend of human-computer interaction in the future. The Kinect based hand-eye positioning system is capable of quickly locating the hand-eye position through depth images and color images, and has a strong real-time performance. Kinect based gesture recognition is widely used in human-computer interaction systems, and the Xbox system developed by Microsoft is the most representative. However, these gesture recognition systems do not pay attention to the problem of finger positioning. From finger positioning point of view, this paper solves the precise position of the finger on the screen by homogeneous coordinate transformation, and realizes a complete set of human-computer interaction system based on hand-eye positioning with simple gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of DC transform circuit of isolation bridge
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: He isolated full-bridge DC transform circuit with full-wave rectifier circuit on the output side is studied. Firstly, the working principle is expounded, and two working modes, continuous and intermittent, are analyzed. The simulation model is established in MATLAB/Simulink, and the simulation results are consistent with the theoretical analysis. The output effect is basically the same as that of the entire bridge rectifier circuit on the output side, so it has a higher cost performance in the field of medium and small power ratio.

articleTitle: GPU-based distortion correction for CMOS positioning camera using star point measurement
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to machining errors and assembly errors, the optical system of the camera is somewhat different from the ideal model through the pinholes. That means, there are different degrees of non-linear optical distortion between the ideal image and the actual image formed by the camera. In order to improve the positioning accuracy of the camera, distortion correction should be done. This paper puts forward a GPU-Based Star Calibration and Proofreading Algorithm (GBSC-PA). This algorithm is completed by CUDA programmable graphics processor technologies, and a number of lens distortion coefficients are solved using star point images. Moreover, the optimal distortion correction matrix can be used to improve the accuracy and speed of the algorithm greatly. Through the experimental measurements and simulation, the feasibility and efficiency of the new algorithm are verified. Compared with the conventional correction algorithm based on CPU, the speed-up ratio of GPU-based parallel program can be reached to 43.094.

articleTitle: Extraction of Trend Data of Cement Raw Material Based on On-line Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the cement production process, the ingredients and preparation of cement raw materials have always been a crucial link. In order to achieve real-time monitoring of cement raw meal ingredients and automation of cement raw meal ingredients, we have introduced a near-infrared analyzer. This article based on the raw material production field data collected by the analyzer, after obtaining the raw material trend information, can be modeled on the operator's manual operation experience to adjust the ratio properly. This paper uses the least square polynomial fitting to transform the raw material saturation rate in 1 hours into a smooth curve, and divides the data up and down through extreme value, and provides more information raw material for the cement automation. The effectiveness of the trend extraction method is demonstrated by fitting the field data with MATLAB.

articleTitle: Boosting Gabor Feature Extraction for Gesture Recognition using Tri-axis Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new feature extraction method for gesture recognition based on single tri-axis accelerometer has been proposed. We present a novel human computer interaction for cell phone through recognizing seventeen complex gestures. First of all, we propose 1D Gabor coefficients of acceleration signals as features for gesture recognition. Although Gabor wavelets can extract discriminative information from acceleration signals effectively, dimensionality of the feature space is very high. To cope with this problem, we adopt boosting algorithm to select and compress the Gabor feature. The Classifier we used is Multi-class Support Vector Machine. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method which not only can solve the problem but also can improve recognition accuracy. The encouraging results indicate that gesture recognition based on single tri-axis accelerometer can provide a novel human computer interaction.

articleTitle: Functional Design and System Development of Power Sales Management and Control Platform in Electric Power Market
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The opening of the power sale side is an important part of the current reform of the electricity power market. The power sales management and control platform is an important tool for the sales business of power sales company, and is also a necessary condition for the access of power sales companies. Firstly, the situation of the power sales reform in current market environment is analyzed, and the importance of the power sales management and control platform for the power sales company to carry out user management, achieve electricity bill settlement and information release services. Based on the characteristics of the power sales market, the construction requirements of platform are proposed, the structure diagram, technical framework route and functional design are introduced. Finally, from the perspective of expansion of the power sales business, the implementation benefits and development direction of the power sales management and control platform are analyzed.

Author Keywords: power sales management and control platform

articleTitle: A novel power calibration method for microwave digestion system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the importance of output power of microwave digestion system, the article proposes a new method for power calibration. It uses a wireless temperature probe instead of a platinum resistance thermometer to measure the temperature, and the measurement uncertainty is evaluated. Compared with the conventional method, an experiment shows that the calibration result is more accurate without changing the measurement uncertainty. This method can improve the calibration of output power, and guarantee the quality of all related works.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of FFT Signal Processing System for Ion Mobility Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the structure and characteristics of FFT algorithm, this paper designed an optimized 1024-point and 16-bit fixed-point FFT and it was implemented based on FPGA. This design adopted the algorithm of radix-2 with decimation in time(DIT), according to system performance and resource consumption, pipelined structure was selected. On the Altera-based CYCLONE II hardware platform, the algorithm was implemented using Verilog HDL language. After the FFT algorithm was transplanted to the Ion Mobility Spectrometer (IMS), air reactive ion and Dimethyl Methyl Phosphate (DMMP) experiments were carried out. The experimental results show that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and the root mean square error (RMSE) of the IMS signal have been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Large Scale Terrain Generation Method Based on Geometry Clipmap Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the OGRE terrain system, the LOD (Levels of Detail) algorithm has a problem of reduced rendering rate and reduced rendering efficiency in large-scale terrain generation. The GPU-based Geometry Clipmap algorithm is applied to large-scale terrain generation. The Geometry Clipmap algorithm uses the quadtree as the data structure of the terrain block. The terrain generation process based on the Geometry Clipmap algorithm is described, and the key factors for dynamically changing the pyramid structure of the clipmap are clarified. A comparative study of the two algorithms was performed. The experimental results show that the Geometry Clipmap algorithm can increase the frame rate of the flight simulation system and reduce the memory consumption, which provides a feasible direction for the development of the OGRE engine.

articleTitle: A Novel Polyphase Filtering Channelization Based Dehopping Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel scheme of frequency hopping and dehopping which is based on polyphase filtering channelization technology. The hardware platform of the solution adopts high-speed FPGA device, which implements real-time dehopping and demodulation of frequency hopping signals and has good real-time performance.

articleTitle: A Control Platform Design of Servo System Based on Image Positioning in Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The application of pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) motor has been widely used, and was used in image transmission system more. This paper designed a set of special control platform for multiple spindle PTZ figure system with the Matlab guide development interface. The platform was built in image recognition algorithm and motor control strategy and could finish identification and tracking of the intended targets. It could support numbers of control functions such as rotation and translation in the actual environment, and truly reproduce the real-time positioning function in the three-dimensional space environment. The results indicated that this design can be used a variety of positioning system based on image target.

articleTitle: A Palmprint Classification Method based on Local Sparse Coding
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A palmprint classification method based on local sparse coding is presented. Firstly, patch-wise statistics based local binary patterns features are as input of local sparse coding classifier. And then the method finds k samples, which are similar with the test sample. Finally the sparse representation classifier is applied to the test sample and the k samples to determine the classification information of the test sample in the database. The experimental results on PolyU palmprint database show that new method has higher classification accuracy than the tradition methods.

articleTitle: IPv6-based Electric Vehicle power battery management platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Through the research on IPv6 and Internet, Internet of Things, Big Data and other technologies, this paper realizes the remote control and data collection of the Electric Vehicle battery management system (BMS) by the management platform, upgrades the traditional Electric Vehicle, makes BMS fully support IPv6 technology, and solves the problems of high concurrency and battery data compression in the transmission of massive terminal data in the IPv6 network environment. The IPv6-based Electric Vehicle power battery management platform can obtain the real-time operation data of the battery pack and timely diagnose its health status to ensure the driver's driving safety; and further improve the battery pack's active balance, parameter online estimation, remote upgrade of BMS and other features through data analysis.

articleTitle: A single image dehazing method based on sky recognition and average saturation prior
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Images captured in bad weather are often degraded due to the existence of atmospheric suspended particles, which is a fatal problem for both consumer photographs and computer vision applications. In this paper, a single image dehazing method based on sky recognition and average saturation prior is proposed. First, we put forward a novel sky region features prior, which is a statistics prior based on thousands of images. Based on this prior, we clip sky region from images and set it as the basis of global atmospheric light estimation. Next, the transmission is estimated within sky region and non-sky region independently, and further refined via the guided total variation model. Finally, a high-quality haze-free image can be achieved based on the atmospheric scattering model. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms several state-of-the-arts with respect to the visual effects and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on the Open Z-axis Fluidic Gyroscope based on MEMS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper reported the design, simulation, fabrication and performance test of fluidic gyroscope, which is fabricated by using the integration process of MEMS process of silicon wafer and high-precision laser cutting and modeling process on PMMA. The 3D transient numerical analysis based on the fluid-structure interaction was used to calculate the flow movement. Calculations and results indicate that sensitivity SFZ is 2.0μV/°/s, the nonlinearity is less than 0.5%. Open flow channel includes two inlets and one outlet inside the sensitive component. With the driving of piezoelectric pump, the fluid flows into the channel through two inlets and gathers together. The flow from the nozzle forms the sensitive jet, without a circulation flow inside the sensitive component. The sensitive component structure is simple. Sensitive jet is deflected along Z-axis by the Coriolis force, the flow exchanges heat with hotwires. Therefore, Wheatstone bridge outputs an unbalanced voltage proportional to angular velocity.

articleTitle: Skin Embryo Classification Model based on BP Neural Network optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For correlation between attribute values in the pickling process, the characteristics of the property value within a certain range, introducing genetic algorithm of BP neural network weights and thresholds for global optimization, the optimized model of pickling process after skin embryo quality classification. Experimental results show that the optimized BP neural network can improve the skin embryo classification calculation accuracy and convergence rate, a 9.16% increase over the mean square error (MSE) is not optimized, the optimized model and the bayesian decision tree algorithm, classification accuracy were higher than in both algorithms. Therefore, this model has certain guiding significance and reference value in the leather production process, and improves the actual production efficiency of the factory.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparative Research of XML Parsing Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of information technology and network technology, XML technology has played an increasingly important role in current internet and IT application environment. As a universal standard language for data transmission and exchange, extensible makeup language (XML) integrates data presentation, storage, transmission and processing as a whole, and plays an increasingly important role in various information applications. However, XML is just a plain text format for encoding data , parsing technology is needed to process XML file to obtain corresponding data. Therefore, how to efficiently parse XML file is of vital significance. On the basis of analysis and experiment of xml parsing technologies that are commonly used in application development, this study compares the parsing technologies in terms of memory consumption, execution efficiency and programming complexity, which provides theoretical reference and application guidance for selection of xml parsing technology.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Evaluation of Electricity Selling Enterprises Based on Users’ Maslow Demand Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Electricity selling side opening is the main content in China's electricity market reform. Different types of enterprises participating in the market competition have different competitive advantages. This paper puts forward the users' maslow demand model based on user demand and maslow's demand analysis. According to the demand of the competitive evaluation of electricity selling enterprises, a comprehensive evaluation method for the competitive power of electricity selling enterprises is put forward to comprehensively evaluate the competitive ability of different types of electricity selling enterprises. Finally, some suggestions are puts forward on how to participate in the electricity sale competition in China for electricity selling enterprise.

articleTitle: Study on the control method of medical rehabilitation robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Since the development of twenty-first Century, the theory and methods of robot control have become more and more mature. With the continuous development of control methods, various kinds of controllers have been innovating and breaking through the production. The performance of the control devices is becoming more and more powerful and the price is getting cheaper and cheaper. In terms of robot control methods, the robot control method can be divided into two categories: PID control method and control method based on robot dynamics model. In this chapter, the feasibility analysis of the control method of rehabilitation robot is discussed, and the control effect of the rehabilitation robot control system is optimized by adding fuzzy control on the basis of sliding mode variable structure.

articleTitle: Research on Accounting Method of Carbon Emission Reduction for Three-phase Load Balancing Project of Low-voltage Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the access to numerous single-phase loads, the unbalanced status of three-phase loads in low-voltage distribution networks is always happening and prevalent, resulting in additional losses in the lines and transformers and increasing the indirect carbon emission intensity of the power grid. Based on the analysis of the relationship between current imbalance and power grid loss, based on ISO14064-2:2006, measures the carbon emission reductions caused by unbalanced three-phase load management, and forms the carbon emission reduction accounting method at the project level for the technology to guide the project participants to evaluate carbon emission reduction benefits. To guide project participants in assessing the benefits of carbon reduction. Finally, combined with the actual engineering data to provide the examples, which have reference value for the check computation method raised by practical application.

articleTitle: A Classification Algorithm for Water Environment Health Risk Assessment based on Unascertained Mathematics and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve the unascertainty in water environmental risk assessment, a classification algorithm that based on unascertained mathematics is established is proposed. And the unascertained information of pollutant concentration in water environment systems, population health life and body weight are considered in the algorithm. Among it, ammonia nitrogen (NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N) and arsenic (As) are selected as a non-carcinogenic chemical indicator and a chemical carcinogen index respectively. Then the risk degree and risk index can be calculated separately according to the proposed risk level classifications. The case study in Taoge River System shows that the proposed algorithm is capable of evaluating the health risk level in water environment and could provide useful information for the regional water environmental management.

articleTitle: A Signal Denoising Method of Gesture Radar Based on Weighted Principal Component Analysis and Improved Wavelet Threshold
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When using radar to recognize gesture, radar echo signals are susceptible to noise. In order to improve detection resolution and data interpretation quality of gesture radar, this paper proposes a new denoising algorithm based on weighted principal component analysis and improved wavelet threshold, named WPCA-IWT denoising algorithm. First, radar echo data are standardized and each echo data's variance are calculated. Each echo data is multiplied by it's corresponding variance to complete weighting operation. By using WPCA processing, the dimension of echo data is reduced and echo signal's principal components are extracted. Then, a new threshold function is proposed and an improved wavelet threshold denoising algorithm is designed to denoise principal components. Finally, denoised principal components are multiplied with an eigenvector matrix to reconstruct radar echo. The proposed WPCA-IWT denoising algorithm has obvious advantages at the aspects of efficiency and denoising effect. Both simulation and on-site radar data experiments verified the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Thread Image Processing Technology Research Based on Combination of Edge Detection and Subpixel Positioning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a new method for auto-measuring parameters of thread based on image processing techniques. According to the characteristics of the thread, this paper select median filtering method, Histogram edge detection and sub-pixel positioning and other image processing methods. Then the parameters of thread, such as the pitch diameter, half of thread angle and the pitch of thread were obtained, an example image was introduced to prove this method. It is very useful in improving the detection precision of thread.

articleTitle: An Antenna Design Scheme of Dual-transmitting Mode Based Projectile-carried Communication Jammer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The fact that multiple projectile-carried communication jammers need to be launched to cover the full frequency band results in inefficiency. Drawing on the idea of "multi-transmission, multi-reception", this paper proposed a scheme in which the projectile-carried communication jammer used two transmitting ends. The jammer is implemented to interfere with two stations in different frequency ranges instead of the traditonal mode that a jammer can only interfere with a small range of the frequency, and the scheme was simulated and verified.

articleTitle: Analysis on the damage efficiency caused by image terminal guided rocket to fort targets
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The damage efficiency analysis of image terminal guided rocket to solid targets is an important basis for the demonstration and use of this kind of rocket. The fort target was selected as the research object, and according to its structural characteristics, material performance, rocket warhead power and penetration effect at different impact points, a area calculation model of vulnerable zone of the target was established. Based on the firing theory, a damage efficiency model based on the area of vulnerable zone was established. The results of the example show that the method is simple and practical, and the damage efficiency of the image terminal guided rocket is greatly improved compared with that of the normal guided rocket.

articleTitle: Computer Electromagnetic Leakage Emission Automatic Test System—Based on CVI Platform Research and Design
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The leakage emissions of computer electromagnetic pose a certain level of information security risk which require testing and assessment of such risks. The traditional test methods have problems such as complicated test steps, low test efficiency, poor scalability, and incomplete test results. Based on the CVI platform, this paper conducts in-depth research and modular design of the computer electromagnetic leakage emission automatic test system, which realizes the automation of the test process and improves the work efficiency.

articleTitle: System-level Test Scheme Design and Implementation of Dynamic-probe Attitude Maneuver Mode for Astronomy Observation satellite
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As a new work mode of Astronomy Observation satellite to achieve local sky coverage scanning, Dynamic-probe Attitude Maneuver Mode has such characteristics as complicated maneuver, real time change of attitude, higher process index and Multi-system collaborative work. It is difficult to validate the maneuver mode in the existing test environment using current test method. A System-level test scheme is designed to solve this problem. The design of test environment contains dynamic model, time unification and data analysis system. The automatic test, Multi-system validation and visualization of test system are realized. The system-level test results show that the designed scheme can verify the correctness of function and the validity of performance index, which provides ideas for ground test and on-orbit application.

articleTitle: Classification for target model Based on fuzzy integral function
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve simple classifier that is unable to adapt for the modulation characteristics in a wide range, the signal modulation classification algorithm based on fuzzy integral function has been proposed, which is combining the classification accuracy uncertainty and fuzzy density, using the fusion for multiple classifiers, in order to reduce the uncertainty of single classifier, then to improve the reliability of signal modulation classification. Combining with the Choquet fuzzy integral function, and ensuring the accuracy of the fuzzy density, we use 11 kinds of digital modulation to verify the performance of fuzzy integral function modulation classification algorithm. According to the simulation result, the stability and the classification of the modulation recognition rate is higher than before not less than 99% at the condition of 0dB.

articleTitle: Research on Cracks Image Detection System for Subway Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The detection of cracks which is one of the main diseases of the tunnel lining plays an important role in the tunnel safety. In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of crack detection, this paper proposes an improved crack detection algorithm and an interface program for interaction. An image acquisition scheme based on a linear array camera system is proposed, and the system can be mounted on a track vehicle for image capturing. Experiments show that for the same image, the detection speed of improved algorithm is twenty times faster than the speed on MATLAB platform. In addition, this paper presents the design of three-dimensional display software for subway tunnel based on OpenGL, which is used to locate the position and predict the tendency of tunnel diseases.

articleTitle: Study on Spectral Preprocessing and Wavelength Selection for Determining Kinematic Viscosity of Aviation Lubricating Oil By Infrared Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The effects of spectral preprocessing and wavelength selection on determining kinematic viscosity of aviation lubricating oil by infrared spectroscopy were studied. The methods were optimized respectively and compared with each other by the correction coefficients and root mean square error of the calibration set and validtion set. The noise filtering effect of wavelet transformation method is better than Savitzky-Golay smoothing convolution in spectral preprocessing of aviation lubricating oil. The prediction accuracy of the model with daubechies2 wavelet function and 7 decomposition levels was highest. Meantime, the application effects of three spectral wavelength selection methods, including correlation coefficient, backward interval partial least squares and synergy interval partial least squares were studied. The spectral wavelength selected by the synergy interval partial least squares with 4 combination intervals in 37 subspace intervals was the best to model prediction effect. The wavelet transformation combined with difference derivation and was applied in spectral preprocessing, and the model on kinematic viscosity of aviation lubricating oil was built by siPLS. The ten used oil were analyzed by the model. The experiment results demonstrate that model predict kinematic viscosity of samples accurately and stably.

articleTitle: Elimination of External Acceleration of AHRS Based on Secondary Cubature Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The external acceleration acting on the navigation body will cause the accelerometer output angle information error, which will result in a decrease in navigation accuracy. This paper proposes a method for external acceleration elimination of accelerometer acquisition data using the secondary Cubature Kalman filter (CKF). The method uses measurement noise to have obvious difference in the presence or absence of external acceleration, constructs the difference model between the actual measurement value and the estimated measurement value, uses the secondary CKF to update the measurement noise, and achieves The purpose of the impact of the elimination of external acceleration when the accelerometer measures the gravity acceleration.

articleTitle: Optimized Decision Making for Power Grid Safety Correction Based on Sub-regional Load Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the case of large-scale power loss fault in the operation of UHV AC-DC hybrid power grid, it is impossible to adjust the grid correction control problem by the unit output adjustment. Fully utilize the adjustable capacity of the load control to achieve safety correction control to meet the load control aid decision-making requirements of existing dispatching system. According to the characteristics of the dispatching system in accordance with the sub-regional load as the target of unified implementation of load control, this paper proposes a safety correction optimized aid decision-making calculation method based on sub-regional load control, with the sub-regional load as the control object and the minimum sub-regional load as the target. Consider the system power flow constraint, the sub-regional controllable load constraint and the key monitoring section safety constraints, the continuous power flow method and the line planning method are combined to solve the problem. The proposed method has the characteristics of simple model, easy solution and good convergence. It shows the effectiveness of the proposed method in the actual power grid.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Frequency Measurement by FFT and Frequency Counting
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for frequency measurement by FFT and frequency counting(FC) in FPGA. It can be used in automobile Doppler radar system. Nowadays, frequency counting and FFT has been widely used in frequency measurement while they have disadvantages. This method combines the FFT and FC into a system. It can obtain the more accurate data of vehicles whether in high frequency of low frequency. This can improve the accuracy of blind area detection and avoid accidents effectively. Ordinary users’ demand can be meet easily because of the low cost of this system. It can be widely used in automotive electronics.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Constructing POI Data Model Based on AP-MRO
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of mobile communication and Internet technology, the scale of travel time and space data has expanded dramatically, resulting in massive POI data. How to organize POI data efficiently and completely is extremely urgent. The conventional POI data organization methods are generally mixed organizations, and there is no special organization for specific tourism information, which leads to the irregular management of tourism information and restricts the popularized service of tourism information. In this paper, the POI data is organized by the AP-MRO method for tourism data, and the analytic hierarchy process is used to analyze the tourism decision-making, and the best tourism plan is obtained through calculation.

articleTitle: Movie Retrieval Based on Shazam Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of multimedia and Internet technologies, the number of movie is growing at an unprecedented rate. How to quickly find the desired movie in a massive movie becomes more and more difficult. At present, most movie retrieval is still in the keyword search stage. This paper proposes a new method to retrieve the corresponding movie information based on movie audio. According to the characteristics of movie audio, this paper selects Shazam algorithm to optimize, which has good performance of the algorithm based on the audio retrieval algorithm in the current. After optimization, the average retrieval accuracy of the algorithm was improved by 0.82%, and it was applied to the mobile terminal.
