The experimental results proved that the actual retrieval effect was good and of great use value.

articleTitle: On Bayes Method for Determination of Fault Sample Size Based on Post-test Risk
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the problem that the old approach of determining the sample size is too rough and the test sample size is too large, a reasonable application of information entropy method is proposed to obtain the test data of the equipment system by fusing the prior information of each unit of the equipment system. The testability indexes of the prior distribution are obtained, the fault sample size and the test scheme are further determined by Bayes posterior risk criterion. The test data of an electric actuator system's module is taken as an example and the failure detection rate is adopted as the test index, the fault sample size is reduced by 86.5%, and the test index error is figured out as 0.75% compared with the classical test through analysis and calculation, reduce the test cost and guarantee the credibility.

articleTitle: Image Edge Detection Based on a Spatial General Autoregressive Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A new scheme for image edge detection based spatial general autoregressive model (SGAR) is proposed in this work, which takes into consideration the nonlinearity at both edges and non-edges. First the SGAR model is derived which fuses both linear and non-linear spatial autoregressive model in one expression and whereafter the spatial relation of a lattice site with its neighbors is adaptively learnt by using a SGAR model with a robust parameter estimator named GM estimator. Then the edge image is produced by thresholding the residual image which is equal to the difference between the original image and the prediction image. Finally, experiments are carried out on a worldwide dataset to verify the feasibility of the proposed scheme. Experiment results also indicate that the future works need to be carried out to further improve practicability of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Design of plant distance measuring device control system based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the adaptability of maize harvester to different plant distances, reduce the rate of missed harvest and improve the working efficiency, this paper designed a new plant distance measuring device for maize harvester with adjustable plant spacing, which greatly improved the operating precision and efficiency of maize harvester. Device with single chip microcomputer as the control center, pressure sensor for measuring the force component, stepper motor as the power source, planting distance is obtained by measurement of photoelectric encoder, is converted to A digital signal by A/D converter, again by single-chip computer for processing, to implement the instructions issued at the end, adjust the corn harvester the spacing of the removable ear device, so as to realize the different planting distance of corn harvesting operations, for the research of corn harvest machinery automation provides A valuable reference.

articleTitle: Application of PLIF on Optical Display of Transverse Jet Flow Field under Supersonic Inflow
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Optical display and measurement of transverse jet flow field under supersonic inflow is performed with PLIF. Results indicate that the fluid field configuration can be shown very obviously by using PLIF. Mixing process of the inflow gas and jet flow can be observed easily, too. With the decreasing of inflow mach number, barrel shock will be displayed gradually. Space resolution ratio can be increased by allocating ultraviolet imaging lens or camera lens with short focal length, and altering fluorescence particles from acetone to NO.

articleTitle: Clustering Evaluation Methods based on Multiple Attribute Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Cluster analysis has been widely used in many fields since its appearance, and the validation method of clustering has received much less attention. In fact, the quality evaluation of clustering results is also a crucial link in the whole clustering process. Clustering validation are generally divided into external clustering validation, internal clustering validation and relative cluster validation. This paper studies the external clustering validation method. Firstly, the article selects several different categories of clustering verification methods. At the same time, the article introduces the Maclaurin symmetric mean (MSM) operator and multiple attribute decision making (MADM) method. Finally, an optimal clustering algorithm selection model for a certain data set can be obtained. The experimental results show that the proposed method can select the corresponding optimal algorithm for inhomogeneity data sets.

articleTitle: Design of networked monitor system for environmental radioactive aerosol
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper described a networked continuous monitor system for environmental radioactive aerosol, which is composed of some radioactive aerosol continuous monitor devices and central management server. The monitor devices can be remotely controlled by the central management server and transmit the measured data to the central management server through internet with the TCP/IP protocol in the system. This system is used to continuous measure and monitor the content of radioactive aerosol (uranium, plutonium and beta.), which is harmful to human health after being inhaled by human body, in the atmosphere. If the content of radioactive aerosol in the surrounding environment exceeds the standard, the system will give an alarm in time to remind people to take action as early as possible. Because of the networked monitor system, people can remote control the monitor devices and remote measure the content of the radioactive aerosol, which can keep the surveyors away from the potentially dangerous measurement sites and can achieve 24 hours unattended continuous monitoring.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Calibration Method for Camera with Occlusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to overcome the need for the user to give additional information on the calibration template during the camera calibration process, or the fully automatic calibration point recognition algorithm can not accurately calibrate the intrinsic parameters of the camera within the occlusion situation, the paper proposes an intelligent calibration method based on GSI coded point in the presence of significant occlusions. The method uses the GSI target attached with the GSI code to calibrate the intrinsic parameters of the camera, and proposes an automatic detection and matching algorithm for the image feature points under the new calibration plate. In addition, it can maintains the intrinsic parameter calibration accuracy of the calibration plate under partial occlusion. The detection algorithm is efficient and free of parameters. The final experimental results show that the error is very small when the calibration plate is partially occluded, which can meet the calibration accuracy requirements of the camera. The recognition and matching algorithm is robust.

articleTitle: A Node Localization Algorithm in WSNs Based on Iterative Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the application of range-free measurement for wireless sensor networks (WSNs), a novel localization algorithm of nodes in based on iterative centroid estimation is proposed in the paper. First, we derive the centroid of the plane enclosed by the current connected beacon nodes as well as the received signal strength (RSSI) between target and beacon nodes. Then, we replace the farthest beacon node from the target node with the centroid node we derive in order to narrow the area of the plane enclosed by the connected beacon nodes and improve the location accuracy through multiple iterations. Judging from the simulation results, the proposed algorithm presents decent results of all indications and is thus eligible for localization in WSNs.

articleTitle: Information Integration System for Microgrid based on the Electric Power Router
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Working as the "energy hub" and control center of the microgrid, the electrical power router (EPR) provides standardized electrical and information interfaces to the various distributed generations (DGs) and guarantees seamless connection and plug-and-play to the equipments in the microgrid. However, existing information integration technologies for microgrid need further improvement because they are not adequate enough to guarantee seamless connection and plug-and-play for the DGs and loads getting access to the microgrid through the EPR. Therefore, the information integration system of small AC/DC microgrid with the power router as its core is studied in this paper. Based on the IEC61850 standard, the information model of the electrical router is established. A new logical node-bidirectional power converter is created as supplementary definition to the energy converter information model of IEC61850-7-420. The integral information model of microgrid and exchanging method of information were studied by the end. The works of this paper will enrich the information integration technologies for the microgrid system, and provide reliable support for the operational scheduling and equipment management of microgrid.

articleTitle: Troubleshooting and Modification of the class 1E Speed Sensor for Reactor Coolant Pump IN NPP
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The reactor coolant pump is called the heart of the reactor. It is Safety Class-1 components [1]. Speed is an important parameter for reactor coolant pump operation. The structure and principle of the Class 1E speed sensor for reactor coolant pump in Nuclear Power Plant (NPP) is introduced. During the commissioning and operation of the reactor coolant pump, the Class 1E speed sensor has encountered many problems, including loss of signal and output error. To solve these problems, the authors analyze the waveform to identify the problem and then, according to the fault types, adjust the on-site installation mode or improve the signal processing unit. This paper presents the symptoms of the problem, the way to find the problem, and the final resolution, hoping to provide some solutions for peer workers to solve similar problems.

articleTitle: Cooperative Location Method of Muti-UAV System under Environment of Communication Jamming based on Tri-Layer Trust Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Muti-UAV System has the characteristics of complex system, and its survivability is affected by location dependability. Global Satellite Navigation System (GNSS) is usually used by low-cost cooperative Multi-UAV system, which is easily being cheated when there are some GPS jammers, especially when there is a deception GPS jammer. Meanwhile Multi-UAV system can improve the responsibility of location by communication, which is also easily being disturbed and cheated. Aiming at the location safety problem of multi-UAV system under deceitful and interferential environment, a new Tri-Layer Trust Model (TLTM) has been established in this paper. In view of the characteristic of multi-UAV's cooperation, there is transaction layer, rating layer and communication layer in TLTM. The trust model can be computed through information of demander, tenderer and the third party. Meanwhile, the best cooperated partner will be selected through the results. The introducing of communication layer simulates the real condition of UAV system under deceitful and interferential information. When there is GPS jammer and communication jamming, it can also provide a safety decision method for multi-UAV system. Simulation results verify that this method could afford a reliable mean of location under deceitful and interferential environment.

articleTitle: A Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia Classification Method Using Feature Extraction and Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to achieve automatic diagnosis of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) in the screening technique of acetic acid test, a classification method based on feature extraction and Back Propagation Neural Network(BPNN) was developed in this paper. Firstly, the respective cervical regions were segmented from the pre- and post acetic acid test images, obtained their overlapped area after the registration, and it was considered as the region of interest(ROI). Secondly, four features were extracted from ROI by using different way. Lastly, using the dataset consisting of features and diagnostic results to trained the BPNN as a CIN classifier. In our experiments, the average accuracy, sensitivity and specificity of the proposed algorithm reached 80.5%, 79% and 82% separately, and the overall performance of BPNN classifier is better than the other two classifier: K-nearest neighbor (KNN) and random forest (RF) classifiers. The result proved that the proposed method is a promising way in realizing the automation and intellectualization of clinical CIN diagnosis.

articleTitle: Subdivision path planning for robot polishing irregular surface
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the precision of robot polishing irregular surface is not high, a quadratic subdivision planning of irregular surface based on curvature and processing technology is proposed according to the computer graphics information, the characteristics of surface construction and the optimal path of robot polishing. Firstly, the irregular surface is constructed, and the graphical information of the irregular surface is obtained by computer, then the curvature of the whole irregular surface is calculated. According to a certain range of curvature, the surface is divided into several irregular surface pieces. The second is to divide the surface pieces into regular rectangles surface pieces according to the highest efficiency when the robot's trajectory is equidistant rectangle. The simulation results of subdivision planning show that the precision of robot polishing can be improved according to the quadratic subdivision programming.

articleTitle: Research On Feature Extraction Method For Motor Rotor Broken Bar Based On Optimized Wavelet Packet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A method for detecting motor rotor broken rotor bars based on optimized wavelet packet analysis is proposed. The method improves the defects of soft and hard threshold functions by optimizing threshold function. Meanwhile, the signal is denoised based on best wavelet packet basis. The method effectively optimizes the performance of wavelet packet analysis. It is better noise removal on the basis of maintaining the original signal characteristics. The simulation results show that the combination of optimized wavelet packet analysis and Fourier analysis effectively improves the detection ability of rotor broken bars of the motors.

articleTitle: Product module partition method based on edge betweenness agglomeration characteristic of complex network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Module partition is the key part of product modular design. The existing methods have the shortcoming of relying on functional structure and complex algorithm. In this paper, the product module partition method is put forward based on the edge betweenness agglomeration characteristic of complex network. The network reflecting the product assembly structure is constructed by taking the parts as nodes and the connection between any two parts as edge. The definition and agglomeration characteristic of complex network edge betweenness is introduced. The edge betweenness search algorithm of undirected acyclic network is given. The proposed method is illustrated and validated by taking the automobile engine as an example.

articleTitle: Analysis of Complex Electromagnetic Environment Adaptability of Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the adaptability of electronic equipment in complex electromagnetic environment, this paper establishes an analytical model based on the experimental samples collected, and completes the adaptability analysis of the electronic equipment to the complex electromagnetic environment. Firstly, the zero phase component analysis (ZCA) is used to process the experimental data to remove the data correlation. On this basis, the problem is regarded as unsupervised learning. The hierarchical clustering method is used to classify the electromagnetic environment, and the optimal adaptability of the equipment under different environmental classification is analyzed. And gives the range of the system parameters that can make the equipment achieve the best adaptability. The validity of the model is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Distributed Wide-Area Back-Up Protection Configuration Scheme and the Method of Confirming Protection Domain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper puts forward a new idea of wide-area back-up protection. Firstly it establishes a distributed system architecture whose basic structure and functional unit is circuit breaker centered IED (Intelligent Electronic Device). Second The principle of division of protection range based on IED is proposed. The IED types in the system are classified into three kinds of protection structures: "Line-Bus", "Line-Transformer" and "Bus-Transformer". The process which confirming information interactive objects in the three protection structures is analyzed and explained. Finally, through the analysis of the system simulation example, it confirms the validity and accuracy of the implementation scheme.

articleTitle: Threshold Re-weighting Attention Mechanism for Speaker Verification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is difficult for the method of average pooling to get the optimal utterance-level features in applications of end-to-end speaker verification, because the importance of each frame is considered to be equivalent. A novel end-to-end architecture of ResCNN based on threshold re-weighting attention mechanism is proposed. Firstly, attention mechanism is introduced into the process of converting frame-level into utterance-level features to obtain the important frames then the larger weights are given by training. Secondly, the weights less than the average value of all weights are set to zero due to the fact that less speaker information is contained, and others are re-weighting to obtain new coefficients. Experimental results show that the equal error rate (EER) of the proposed method is 10.88% on the Voxceleb1 dataset, which is 1.41% lower than that of the average pooling method. This shows that the frames containing more speaker information can be selected by the proposed method more effectively, thus the performance of speaker verification system is improved. Furthermore, the extended experiment shows that the proposed method is also applicable for noisy scenes.

articleTitle: Quasi-distributed temperature detection based on multi-wavelength demodulation technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposed an FBG multi-point high-precision temperature measurement system and builds a multi-point temperature measurement system based on fiber grating: ASE (amplified spontaneous emission) light source, fiber grating sensor, demodulation module, MEMS optical switch and demodulation module. Five-point central wavelength method is used to calculate the central wavelength offset, which is compared with other fiber grating temperature measurement systems to improve the measurement accuracy. Temperature calibration experiment through the experimental 3-point temperature measurement system and the temperature-wavelength calibration system verify the multi-point temperature measurement accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on the Precise Finding System of Close Range FM Radio
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: How to locate the illegal radio station quickly and accurately after the area of the illegal radio station is known has been a problem for radio monitors. In this paper, based on the research of radio direction finding and positioning technology, a set of direction finding and positioning system for close range FM radio is realized by using Tektronix RSA503A spectrum analyzer. The system can locate the FM transmitter in the range of about 10 meters through the experiment of direction finding and positioning in the range of 500 meters.

articleTitle: On-line Statistical System Of Cut Tobaccoflow Based On Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Flow of cut tobacco is an important processing parameter of high speed cigarette machine. In order to meet the demand of cut tobacco flow statistics in the whole sealing pipes, this paper shares a machine vision based on-line statistical system of cut tobacco flow. Besides the introduction of the system's hardware, this paper focuses on the image processing algorithms such as cut tobacco image preprocessing, thresholding and morphological processing. Firstly, after the preprocessing of image denoising, the cut tobacco color image is transformed into gray-scale image by weighted average method. Secondly, the gray-scale image is converted into to binary image by the maximum entropy threshold method. Finally, the binary cut tobacco image is processed by dilation and erosion of the morphological image processing, which lay the foundation for the on-line statistic process of cut tobacco flow. The practical engineering application of the system shows that the on-line statistic of cut tobacco flow is real-time with high reliability, which can meet the requirements of the production process of tobacco companies and greatly improve the automation and intelligentization of high-speed cigarette machine, resulting in certain generalization value in the industry.

Author Keywords: on-line statistics of cut tobacco flow

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Design of Hybrid Active Power Filter based on genetic particle swarm composite algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In dealing with the parameter design and the investment optimization of hybrid active power filter, we comprehensively consider the price, the reactive power compensation and the filter effect in a new mixed algorithm of genetic theory and particle swarm optimization. On this basis, the multi-objective mathematical model of capacity assignment is created and the penalty function theory is applied; and then, the multi-objective design is converted into a single-objective design, making the capacity assignment simple and flexible. Secondly, simulation analysis is carried on the power systems computer aided design/electromagnetic transients including DC(PSCAD/EMTDC); the results demonstrate that the cost performance of the hybrid active power filter is improved by using the proposed method. Finally, experimental results and comparison analysis are presented to confirm the above-mentioned method.

articleTitle: Research on the application of RFID technology in color TV life cycle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, RFID automatic identification technology has gradually become the core of the development of information technology, and has been widely used in power, logistics, access control and other fields; However, actually, the application of RFID technology in color TV industry is relatively weak. Therefore, this paper focuses on the application of RFID technology in the life cycle of color TV, and introduces its implementation methods in the following three scenarios: RFID chip built-in core board, RFID technology to intelligent storage management, RFID technology is applied to production line .It is hoped that the application research in this paper can play a role in attracting RFID technology to the application of color TV industry. Finally, the application research is applied to a color TV production enterprise, and the results show that the effect is remarkable in product quality traceability and material control.

articleTitle: A Research of Power Analysis Based on Multiple Neural Network Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to explore the performance difference of different deep neural networks used in power analysis attacks, DPA_Contest_V4 dataset is used to complete the experiment. After cracking the loop mask, first we compare the deep neural network with the traditional machine learning algorithm model such as SVM. Then we analyze the influence of the changes in the structure of the neural network model on the experimental results. Finally, combined with the recurrent neural network, different network models are compared comprehensively. The result shows that under the same experimental conditions, the neural network model is superior to the traditional machine learning model and the recurrent neural network model is superior to the deep neural network model, in which different layers of neural networks taking different activation functions lead to large changes.

articleTitle: Study on Sensitive Mechanism and Numerical Simulation of Fluid Gyroscope based on Thermal Expansion Flow Principle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel fluid gyroscope based on thermal expansion flow principle was reported. The structural design and sensitive principle were shown. The temperature field and fluid field inside the sensitive component were calculated using COMSOL. Calculation results indicate that temperature inside the sensitive component has a fluctuating growth and form a symmetrically distributed thermal expansion flow driven by 10Hz square wave. When angular rate is applied, the change of temperature difference between the detectors is caused by the flow deflection under the Coriolis force. In the range of ±3rad/s, temperature difference rate is 1.56×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>K/rad/s.

articleTitle: The Intelligent Search Method of Ambiguity Function Main Ridge Based on the Adaptive Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The ambiguity function is an effective tool to solve the problem of radar emitter signals sorting in complex systems. To improve the real-time and accuracy of the ambiguity function main ridge (AFMR), this paper proposes an intelligent method to search AFMR based on adaptive differential evolution algorithm. The signal is pre-identified by the instantaneous frequency (IF) features to reduce the AFMR search range and the complexity of the problem. In this way, the differential evolution algorithm parameters can be adaptively adjusted according to the pre-recognition results to accelerate the convergence of the algorithm. Then the statistical hypothesis testing theory is used to analyze and test the search results. The experiment results show that the proposed method reduces the time of searching AFMR to about 4% compared with the exhaustive method with higher accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis for Power Transformer Based on HHGA-WNN
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at some problems of the training algorithm of wavelet neural network(shorted for WNN) used for power trasfomer fault diagnosis, a new hybrid hierarchy genetic algorithm was introduced by combining hierarchy genetic algorithm and least-square method. The hybrid algorithm was able to determine the structure and parameters of the RBF neural network. Adaptive crossover and mutation probability could accelerate the genetic speed and avoid the occurrence of prematurity. A lot of data of power trasfomer fault diagnosis, and the normalized data were fed into the radial base function neural network to predict the fault diagnosis for power transformer. The simulation demonstrates that the wavelet neural network based on hybrid hierarchy genetic algorithm(shorted for HHGA-WNN) is robust, promising and converges very fast.

articleTitle: Transformer winding inter turn short circuit fault analysis and corrective measures
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is introduced that the fault of inter turn short circuit of low voltage winding of 2# main transformer in a 220kV substation. According to visual inspection, diagnostic test and disassembly inspection depot, the fault reason is found out: the bad quality of wrapping paper of the transposition wire and outermost wire, the transposition "S" curve in cake defects and short wedge block length, resulting in main transformer failed to withstand short-circuit current. On this basis, the repair scheme of transformer is put forward, and relevant technical improvement measures are given to prevent similar equipment from short circuit capability failure.

articleTitle: Behavior Level Modeling and EMC Analysis of Audio Communication System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: 5G makes the interconnection of multiple electronic devices become normal. Compatibility problems of multiple electronic devices become more and more prominent because they work in the same electromagnetic environment. Based on the electromagnetic compatibility problem caused by 5G communication system, this paper establishes the behavior level models of audio communication system, analyzes the electromagnetic compatibility and anti-jamming ability of communication system in complex electromagnetic environment. The system parameters are given according to the actual communication system equipment, and the simulation model library can also be used in EMC analysis of 5G systems by other candidate frequency bands.

articleTitle: Research Design of Adjustable Collimator for Irradiation Field
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The radiation field adjustable collimator is a mechatronics product. The rectangle opening of collimator is mainly composed of four collimation blocks. Every collimation block has 2 degrees of freedom (DOF). And these collimation blocks are arranged stagger from end to end. The X-ray irradiation field is automatically adjusted by vertical and horizontal motors. The irradiation field adjustable collimator can meet the need of X-ray sources for different fields in industrial inspection and industrial CT. The collimation blocks are arranged in the same plane, which has a compact structure and effectively reduces the leakage of stray X-rays.

articleTitle: A Study on Driving Behavior Intelligence Detection Based on Discrete Wavelet Transform and Support Vector Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence, big data analysis, smart detection of driving behaviors becomes the new focus of Intelligence and Connected Vehicles researches. The state-of-the-art research in this direction is to recognize driving scenes to support driving decisions, based on driver's driving data. This study used CATARC collected Controller Area Network (CAN) bus and CARTAC driving scene standard labeled data, implemented discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and support vector machine (SVM) algorithm, constructed a machine learning model with the ability of detecting 16 different driving behaviors. With details of feature selection, filter selection, SVC parameters selection and many others techniques to optimize the model, achieved cross validation accuracy rate around 88%. This method can be applied to vehicles' security warnings and intelligence control, therefore to improve vehicle safety performance.

articleTitle: Dielectric Resonator Based Millimeter Wave Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A cylindrical dielectric-resonator-based millimeter-wave array antenna is presented in this paper. The 1×4 array contains four elements which are equally excited, a fixture to stabilize and align the dielectric resonator antenna, and adhesives to connect the antenna and substrate. The fixture is co-fabricated with the substrate, which requires no extra procedures. The influence of low-permittivity and lot-height fixture, and epoxy glue is under consideration. It is proved that neither the fixture nor glue have obvious influence on the dielectric resonator antenna. Both the fixture and ground plane between elemental antennas are truncated to suppress cross polarization. The array antenna operates at around 25 GHz with a bandwidth of 20%, a gain of about 11 dBi, mutual couplings of about -18 dB, a side lope level of -16 dB, a front-to-back ratio of 15.5 dB, and a cross-polarization suppression more than 50 dB.

articleTitle: The Study of Load Identification Based on Raw Current Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The quality of datasets is very important for load identification. This paper proposes a method for identifying household appliances based on single-cycle raw current data. And the mainstream deep neural network (DNN), convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network (RNN) are used to evaluate the datasets generated from the method we proposed. Meanwhile, the load identification effects of three deep learning methods are compared on the same dataset. The experimental results show the load identification method based on single-cycle raw current data has good recognition effect on small power appliances, similar power appliances, multi-state appliances and combined appliances. Among them, the best performance RNN model reaches an accuracy of 98.34% for the identification of 58 kinds of single and multiple electrical appliances, which realizes the accurate load identification of electrical appliances commonly used in the family.

articleTitle: A Multidirectional Micro Jet Generator Driven by Piezoelectric Pump
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a micro jet generator that generates multidirectional jets in a closed cavity is proposed. And the design, simulation, experimental verification and manufacture are given. The airflow circulation mechanism in jet generator is explained by the method of combination of a three-dimensional transient numerical calculation based on fluid-solid coupling and constructing PIV experiments. The calculation and experiment show: (1) Two pairs of symmetrical jets which are complete stable and almost identical in orthogonal direction are generated in four jet chambers. The average velocity v of jet at the nozzle orifice 5.52 m/ s. The maximum relative error is less than 0.8%. (2) The measured maximum excitation voltage of the micro jet generator is 30V. The optimum working frequency is 10kHz. The micro jet generator can be used in multi-axis inertial jet sensors, microfluidic control chips and other fields.

articleTitle: Research on the Definition and Comparison of Satellite Equipments’ Assembly MBD Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: MBD model is the basis of MBSE. According to the requirements of satellite assembly design, the satellite equipment' assembly MBD model was defined. In order to meet the needs of comparison the different MBD model versions of the same equipment, the secondary development technology to compare text and comments was used, and model's principal component analysis and Boolean operation of three-dimension model were used to compare model difference. The method mentioned could give a comprehensive information comparison of MBD model, including non-geometric features and geometric features. Experience shows that the proposed method could meet the needs of satellite development.

articleTitle: Application and Experimental Research of Capsule Endoscope Based on Wireless Energy Supply
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Wireless energy supply technology provides MEMS inside body with a new power supplying approach. At present paper a conception of a multi-dimensional wireless energy transmission system is proposed and successfully implemented. Then the system is considered being miniaturized to meet capsule size. Finally, a capsule endoscope including the energy supply module and the camera module is assembled and its experiments indicate it can be powered successfully.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Optimization of Urban Transit Network Based on Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an approach for constructing the weights of edges in urban transit networks based on complex networks. Jinan City is taken as an example in this paper. At first, the undirected and unweighted network composed of bus stops and bus lines is constructed respectively, the static characteristics and transfer characteristic of transit networks are analyzed, and the robustness of the network is analyzed by means of random attack and intentional attack. In the second part, the weight of edges are assigned by the approach we proposed. Finally, we propose a method to optimize the structure of the bus network.

articleTitle: Research and Design of No-contact Tap-charger On-load Voltage Regulator in 10KV Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: There are some disadvantages in mechanism tap-changers, 10KV no-contact tap-changer on-load voltage regulator is proposed. The compensated principle is used to regulate output voltage and the switch process is completed by SCR. So it has fast dynamic response and low harmonic content, and produces no electric arc in the switching process. At the same time, the advanced compensation technology of combined winding and the optimized topology are adopted to make more compensation series and higher precision of voltage regulation. Based on the principle and topology, the power flow is analyzed in detail, and the inner nature of its operation is further expounded. The experimental results show that the topology is feasible and the theoretical analysis is correct.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Node Location Technology in Wireless Ad hoc Networks on Amphibious Robots
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The formation of amphibious robots is often interfered by external factors. Therefore, some robots' Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) equipment cannot provide accurate positioning, which has a great impact on the continuity and real-time performance of the work. To solve the problem, this paper adopts a positioning method based on the trajectory of a mobile anchor node. Proposed method determines the foot points and vertical lines of unknown points on the trajectory of anchor nodes according to the Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI) intensity values of these nodes. It then identifies the foot points and vertical lines of unknown points on anchor nodes' trajectory. Position of unknown nodes are identified based on the intersection of these vertical lines. Moreover, we conducted experiments with fewer nodes, and the results demonstrate more accuracy as compared with traditional node technology. It can better solve the problems of positioning fault caused by external factors, which has high application value.

articleTitle: Development of Design System for Spatial Cam Reducer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the excellent kinetic characteristic of the spatial cam mechanism, a kind of cam reducer is designed. First, a digital prototype of the reducer is built. Then, the multi-rigid body dynamics simulation is performed, and the driven disk motion curve and the contact force and contact torque curves are output. After verifying the correctness and feasibility of the design parameters by analyzing the simulation results, the design idea of the CAD system of the space cam reducer is established. The development of the CAD system of the space cam reducer was completed by using the Visual C++ compiler language and the secondary development tool Protoolkit. The computer aided design of the reducer is realized. Finally, the digital prototypes of spatial cam reducer are established by means of this system. It can make the design of reducer faster and easier by handing the repetitive design process and complicated calculation work to the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Outage Probabilities for Cooperative NOMA Users with Imperfect CSI
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) is a promising spectrally-efficient technology to meet the massive data requirement of the next-generation wireless communication networks. In this paper, we consider a cooperative non-orthogonal multiple access (CNOMA) networks consisting of a base station and two users, where the near user serves as a decode-and-forward relay to help the far user, and investigate the outage probability of the CNOMA users under two different types of channel estimation errors. For both CNOMA users, we derive the closed-form expressions of the outage probability and discuss the asymptotic characteristics for the outage probability in the high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regimes. Our results show that for the case of constant variance of the channel estimation error, the outage probability of two users are limited by a performance bottleneck which related to the value of the error variance. In contrast, there is no such performance bottleneck for the outage probability when the variance of the channel estimation error deceases with SNR, and in this case the diversity gain is fully achieved by the far user.

articleTitle: Object Detection Based on Saliency and Sea-Sky Line for USV Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a fast and effective object detection approach for a monocular vision system aboard an unmanned surface vehicle (USV) under the ocean environment. By utilizing the improved saliency detection and the sea-sky line (SSL) as well as the way of centroid-judging, the object detection method is constructed for an USV on the ocean environment. The improved frequency tune (FT) saliency detection algorithm is proposed to capture the salient objects. Moreover, based on analysing the prior information for the attitudes of USV, Hough transform and Mahalanobis distance are adopted to identify the SSL, which is implemented in a parallel programming. The SSL is used to filter out the clouds, meanwhile the irregular background noises from sea surface are excluded by judging the number of centroids of potential objects below the SSL among the randomly chosen history frames. The proposed approach is applied on our 'Jiuhang490' USV's video, and results indicate its real-time performance and accuracy.

articleTitle: Dynamic Network Security Situation Prediction based on Bayesian Attack Graph and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to predict attack behavior efficiently and dynamically and to quantify the network security situation, a dynamic network security situation prediction method based on big data and Bayesian attack graph is proposed. First, using big data technology to fuse network security situation factors, then use vulnerability prediction algorithm to predict the future number of vulnerabilities in real time and finally combine the new vulnerability with Bayesian attack graph to infer the attacker's subsequent attack behavior. According to the predicted results, the network security situation is quantified. Experiments show that the method can predict the attack behavior and efficiently quantify the network security situation accurately.

articleTitle: A Review of Representation, Model, Algorithm and Constraints for Mobile Robot Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Path Planning of intelligent artificial autonomous mobile robots is a critical technology to achieve the task of exploration, cruise, moving etc. A large set of methods and algorithms have been introduced to solve the path planning problem in complex environment, due to huge number of research has been done in the procedure of developing large practical used autonomous mobile robots, rovers, vehicles, airplane, ship, submarine in variety of application filed in recent years such as agricultural, industry, military, space exploring. This paper collects and presents the different represents, models and planning algorithms in the application of path planning of robots. The aims of this paper are to draw a whole procedure of robot path planning, to present a detailed analysis of the available technology in each designing phase, to make a useful comparison in critical performance between different algorithms. All the methods described are based on their characteristic and the performing environment. The analysis shows that despite the large number of methods developed for path planning in different environment and variety usage, considering the complexity, completeness, effectiveness and optimality, random sample based methods are the trend which can be efficiently used to solve practical complex path planning problem. There are also some suggestions of methods' choice in each designing phase such as environment construct, representation, and algorithm.

articleTitle: Connection Between Text-based Passwords and Topological Graphic Passwords
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Graphical passwords have been applied in information networks, such as QR code and those passwords for opening mobile phones. Topological graphic passwords (Topsnut-GPWs) differ from the existing graphical passwords, since they can be saved in computer by matrices and run quickly than the existing graphical passwords. We show that Topsnut-GPWs can be easily connected with text-based passwords, but no inverse process rewrite a Topsnut-GPW by the text-based passwords produced from this Topsnut-GPW. Our techniques can be associated with some well-known traditional encryptions. We point that Topsnut-GPWs have provable security and computational security since some graph labellings, which make Topsnut-GPWs, are related with mathematical conjectures, and many spaces of Topsnut-GPWs have huge cardinalities. The individuation of Topsnut-GPWs is an important working direction for withstanding breaks and attacks, and approximating unconditional security.

articleTitle: Overview of Wearable Haptic Force Feedback Devices and A Further Discussion On The Actuation Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Haptic force feedback devices are playing more and more important roles in virtual reality applications. During the last two decades, researchers around the world has developed many different types of haptic devices features different technologies. And several commercial haptic device have been introduced to the market. In this paper, several typical haptic devices are discussed, including ground-based and wearable types, and the paper mainly focus on wearable haptic devices, their advantages and drawbacks are listed and compared. Then different kinds of actuators, which are key parts of haptic devices, are demonstrated and discussed, and the conclusion of motor based actuators being more beneficial than other types of actuators are carried out. At last, the current problems and future works of wearable haptic devices are presented.

articleTitle: FPGA Interconnect Resources Test Based on A Improved Ford-Fulkerson Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Interconnect resource(IR) test is one of the most crucial parts in Field Programmable Gate Arrays(FPGA ) test. The Ford-Fulkerson algorithm of graph theory has already been applied in FPGA IRs testing. However, with the expansion of the FPGA scale, the efficiency of the Ford-Fulkerson algorithm is reduced. This paper improves the Ford-Fulkerson algorithm by dividing the FPGA IRs into three graphs, the horizontal graph, the vertical one and the oblique one, which reduces the algorithm complexity in large-scale FPGAs. This improved algorithm has been verified on mathematic model of XC5V110T FPGA IRs. Compared to the previous test methods, the efficiency of this improved algorithm has raised by 8 times.

articleTitle: UAV Autonomous landing algorithm based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Autonomous landing capability is very important for UAV, this paper presentes a UAV landing method based on visual navigation pose parameters calculateion. The navigation algorithm is based on monocular vision, and the shape and size parameters of land objects need to be carefully designed. The contour extraction method is combined with the Angle detection method to obtain 8 Angle points with good geometric distribution and moderate number. The algorithm can calculate the relative pose parameters of the UAV and the landing platform accurately by only using these 8 Angle points without the need of depth information. The 8 angular points extracted are directly used as the input of detection and tracking, which ensures the real-time performance of the algorithm and reduces the processing time of stable tracking landmarks. Finally, the real-time calculation of the flight pose parameters is carried out. The results show that the algorithm has an average period of 49.523 ms(about 20 fps) and can meet the real-time requirements of autonomous landing visual navigation when the speed is not higher than 2m/s.

articleTitle: Research on Target Location Method of UAV based on Aided Beacon in Different Field of View
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the UAV's single station angle and distance measurement are greatly affected by the UAV's attitude angle error, a method is proposed to solve the UAV's attitude by detecting the auxiliary beacon and combining with the inertial sensor. The attitude solving model of inertial sensor based on CKF is established, by using gradient descent method, the attitude parameters of UAV based on auxiliary beacons are solved, and the results are comprehensively used to estimate and correct the attitude error of UAV, finally the targets' location and simulation calculation under different fields of view are completed. The results show that the method proposed in this paper has improved the precision of UAV target location.

Author Keywords: Attitude estimation of unmanned aerial vehicle

articleTitle: The Study of Online Financial Information Service Quality Evaluation : A Perspective of Vertical Financial Websites in China
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Online information service is an important part of financial industry. Information is the driving force for the development of economy. The paper focused on the foundation of online information service quality evaluation theory and its characteristics to demonstrate and analyze the network information service quality evaluation indexation system. The index includes: operation, information and personalized services. We select vertical financial website platform in China as our empirical study model and implemented AHP method and SPSS software as our tool to analyze collected data. We presented our research results and evaluated them. Based on our findings and current practice in China, we provided suggestions for the improvement of Chinese network financial information service as follows: strengthen our network security; Enhancing quality of information; emphasizing on personalized information service; boost mobile information service; establishing trust of website information.

articleTitle: Vehicle Personnel Identification Model Based on Optimized ST-DBSCAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, in order to monitor and law enforcement, the on-board personnel detection of road mostly adopts infrared thermal imaging technology and video monitoring equipment, which requires a large amount of construction costs and equipment maintenance costs. The monitoring is mainly concentrated in the equipment deployment area, which cannot achieve comprehensive road monitoring. Based on the k-means ST-DBSCAN algorithm, the identification and analysis model of on-board personnel in the road vehicle can be established to obtain the actual number of passengers on the vehicle in the lane. It could determine effectively whether the problem of overcrowding exists in the vehicle, and provide a new auxiliary detection method for the vehicle in practice. The positioning data of vehicles and passengers' phones were collected on the road. The raw data information was preprocessed by the location of the data information track matching. Optimization of ST-DBSCAN clustering algorithm was used to establish the analysis model to identify out the actual number of each car on the road vehicle personnel and determine whether the car is overcrowding. Experiments show that the model can effectively detect the actual number of on-board passengers on the road and help to determine whether the on-board passengers are overstaffed.

articleTitle: A Survey on Location Algorithm Based on Vector Magnetic Anomaly Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The existing target location algorithm based on vector magnetic anomaly signal is reviewed. Through the theoretical deduction and analysis of various methods, the advantages and disadvantages of each method are summarized. Combined with the latest detector technology, the future development of underwater target location is discussed.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Wave Attenuation System Design based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To avoid and reduce the loss of flood disaster scientifically, rationally and intelligently, an intelligent wave attenuation system based on Internet of things (IOT), big data and cloud platform is constructed for intelligent wave attenuation. The proposed design is composed of regional wave attenuation network, cloud platform and server. It can make wave attenuation more automatic and intelligent to improve the wave attenuation effect, reduce lashing dikes and safeguard the bank. An intelligent wave attenuation system design based on IOT applying information technology and automation control to revetment works has the practical application value.

articleTitle: Attentive Autoencoder Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In real applications, sparseness of user-item rating data significantly causes degrading in recommendation performance. There are several effective techniques which reduce prediction error by auxiliary information. However, these works focus on how to increase the ability of extracting features from a particular part rather than how to fuse features from different parts effectively. And the difference of Gaussian noise is ignored in modeling latent factors of both users and items. In this paper, to address these issues, we propose attentive autoencoder(AAE) to effectively extract features from several different information sources, which is integrated into improved probabilistic matrix factorization (PMF). The improved PMF consider the difference of Gaussian noise between both users and items. We perform extensive experiments on three real-world datasets, and the result shows that our AAEMF significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Mathematical Problems From Topological Graphic Passwords of Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Topological graphic passwords (Topsnut-gpws) differ from the existing graphical passwords (GPWs), and possess advantages such as, it is convenient to use, easy remember, high secure and individual; and it generates easily text-based passwords from Topsnut-gpws, and Topsnut-gpws are provable security because they are related many mathematical conjectures or NP-problems. Researching Topsnut-gpws produces new mathematical problems and new objects. More complex and highly secure Topsnut-gpws need mathematical support. We collect the problems from Topsnut-gpws and classify them in set theory, graph theory and algebra.

articleTitle: Congestion Control Technology in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As we all know, the new generation of information and communication technology (ICT) represented by the Internet of Things is launching a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation on a global scale, and wireless sensors are one of the key technologies of the Internet of Things. The wireless sensor network is a special decentralized self-organizing network. The dynamic changes of the network topology, the complex environment of the wireless channel, the hop-by-hop forwarding communication mode, and the limit calculation and power consumption of sensor nodes, all of this makes wireless sensor networks vulnerable to congestion and seriously affect the energy efficiency of the network and quality of service (QoS) performance. Therefore, it is of great theoretical and practical significance to study congestion control to improve the transmission efficiency of wireless transmitter networks, save network costs and enhance network life cycle. Based on the characteristics of wireless sensor networks, this paper introduces the congestion detection, congestion avoidance and congestion procession strategy of wireless sensor networks, which focuses on and analyzes the congestion procession algorithm that based on rate control and resource scheduling. Finally, the development trend of congestion control technology is summarized.

articleTitle: An Improved Criterion for Uncertain Neutral-type Lur’e Systems with Time-varying Delay via a Novel Double Integral Inequality
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper considers the robust absolute stability for uncertain mixed neutral and Lur'e systems with time-varying delay and sector-bounded nonlinearity. A new double integral inequality is proposed for reducing conservatism of criteria. By constructing a suitable augmented triple-integral Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional(LKF), employing delay decomposition approach and the new double integral inequality and combining other techniques, the new delay-dependent absolute stability criterion is derived in the form of linear matrix inequalities(LMIs). Several examples show the more effectiveness and less conservatism of proposed approach than the pervious.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Neural Network based Sliding Mode Control for Hypersonic Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the air-breathing hypersonic vehicle(AHV) model with perturbation of aerodynamic coefficients and uncertain parameters in the system, taking into account the problems of aerodynamic co-efficients approximation and uncertain parameter identification, fuzzy function(FF) and Radial Basis Neural Network(RBNN) based sliding mode control is proposed. AHV control model has the characteristics of multivariable, strong coupling and nonlinear. Applying the powerful function approximation function of fuzzy function to approach the aerodynamic coefficient, using RBNN self-learning identification ability to identify the system uncertain parameters, combined with sliding mode variable structure control, to eliminate the aircraft's buffeting problem to some extent and improve the robustness of the system. Simulation results show that the system can maintain stability after adding velocity step instructions and altitude step instructions, and has strong robustness to uncertain parameters, and overcome the chattering problem.

articleTitle: Research on STATCOM DC side capacitor voltage stratified control strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Static Synchronous Compensator (STATCOM) has the advantages of fast response, small footprint, and high compensation accuracy in reactive power compensation and it is widely used in low voltage distribution networks. This paper mainly studies the DC-side capacitor voltage control. For the DC side capacitor voltage control, a layered control strategy is applied in this paper. The first layer control is the overall DC side capacitor voltage control, and the second layer control is the phase-to-phase DC side voltage equalization control. In the overall DC-side voltage control, the second-harmonic pollution caused by the second-harmonic component is suppressed by adding filter links in the feedback channel. This control strategy only exchange the positive sequence active components in the power grid and will not cause pollution to the grid. For the phase-to-phase DC-side voltage equalization control, this paper proposes a voltage equalization control method based on zero-sequence injection voltage. The zero-sequence voltage components is also discussed, which need to be injected when the grid voltage is balanced and unbalanced. The layered control strategy proposed in this paper will not inject negative sequence and harmonic components into the grid and avoid pollution to the grid during the compensation process.

articleTitle: Research on Monitoring System of Enterprise Energy Saving and Emission Reduction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Economic development and energy conservation and emission reduction are a contradictory unity. How to balance between the two tests the wisdom of the Chinese. Through the industry classification, selecting appropriate energy-saving emission reduction indicators, using the basic principles of statistics, applying techniques and methods of quality control, the indicator system and monitoring methods for energy-saving emission reduction are proposed, so as to implement dynamic monitoring on energy-saving emission reduction, which has important reference value for enterprise energy conservation and emission reduction work on current stage.

articleTitle: Signal statistical characteristics analysis and measurement of wireless channel during limited complex area
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the small radius and irregular shape of the limited area, the propagation environment is extremely complex, it is urgent to study the propagation characteristics of wireless channel during the limited complex area. In this paper, the propagation characteristic measurement was carried out during the limited area scene (office and staircase). The path loss and multipath effect of wireless channel were analyzed. Tapped Delay Line (TDL) model was proposed for studying the multi-path effect in the office and staircase scene. The results showed the amplitude of model taps was similar to the Nakagami distribution, and the m parameter of each tap was greater than 1. The m parameter and tap numbers of staircase was significantly larger than office, indicating that the waveguide effect of narrow structure of the stairs was more significant than open office environment. Finally, experiment test during limited complex area was carried out based on the multiple-input multiple-output model and the results were close to commonly theoretical channel models (Kronecker, Weichselberger). The wireless propagation characteristics and channel model studied in this paper provided effective theoretical basis and practical basis for link budget, coverage prediction and interference analysis of wireless communication during the limited complex area.

articleTitle: Stereovision Based Generic Obstacle Detection and Motion Estimation Using V-stxiel Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Driving environment perception is a critical and fundamental task of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) and self-driving technology. In object detection, one of the major challenges is how to achieve an effective model from real scene. Although A medium-level representation named stixel-world has achieve accurate detection results for the task of generic obstacle detection, robustness is still a problem and hard for application. To address this issue, this paper proposes a variant of approach named V-stixel that need no free space computation. Compared with the detection method of monocular image, a variety of obstacle types can be detected without the specific object modeling. It is a generic obstacle detection method and needs no previous training step. Finally, we compare this new method with baseline methods on the KITTI stereo dataset. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the detection results is good, the measurement error is robust in the long video sequences and gain a significant speed-wise.

articleTitle: Study on the optimal dispatching algorithm of ships in and out of tidal two-way channel
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Considering the complexity of the process of ships entering and leaving the port in coastal tidal natural river, the whole process of ships entering and leaving the port is divided into different links, such as entering and leaving the port by tide, sailing in and out of the harbor, berthing and unloading at the port of entry and landing. In this paper, the objective function is to minimize the completion time of the whole process of ships entering and leaving port. According to the characteristics of the model, the design is based on simulated annealing and genetic algorithm combines scheduling algorithm, by using integer coding rules design coding operator and decoding operator, according to the actual chromosome number dynamic control cross algorithm, improve the global search ability in the process of calculation algorithm. The rationality and validity of the model and the algorithm are verified by taking the arrival and departure scheduling of the ship in and out of the shandong TaoEr river as an example.

publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: feature extraction; learning (artificial intelligence); mobile robots; control engineering computing; optimisation; power grids; object detection; power engineering computing; neural nets; pattern clustering.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic characteristic and parameter sensitivity of diamond back wing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To study the dynamic characteristic of diamond back wing and Relevant influencing factors, a fine three-dimensional model and assembly of the main components of the small diameter bomb are established in Pro/E. The ANSYS software is used to analyze the dynamic characteristics of the equivalent density model, and the free mode of the full bomb is calculated. Then the global structure sensitivity analysis is executed, and the Spearman rank correlation coefficient between the design parameters of the wing and its mode was calculated by the Monte-Carlo method. The results show that the main vibration mode of the small diameter bomb in the range of 5~500Hz is caused by the wing. The parameters of significant influence on the mode are the thickness of the front and rear wings, as well as rear wing length, which should be verified in structural dynamics design.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics of Electromagnetic Damper under Impact Loading
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The electromagnetic damper has the inherent characteristic of "Constant damping-Constant power". In order to explore the working characteristic of electromagnetic damper under impact environment, based on the single degree of freedom system vibration model, the damping response model of electromagnetic damper under impact load is established, analyzed the matching relation between impact properties and damping output characteristic. The simulation model was built by Matlab/Simulink for analysis, and put forward the adjust method of damping stable output. The result of research show that, because of the high speed on demagnetization effect, electromagnetic damper in the process of braking the impact load, the phenomenon of damping sag will appear in the constant damping output platform, and the braking characteristic can be adjusted by load matching coefficient and attenuation coefficient.

articleTitle: A New Carrier Based Neutral Point Potential Control Strategy for Three-Level NPC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Modulation and neutral point (NP) potential effective balance are hot research topics for three-level NPC converters. A new modulation strategy and NP potential control based on the modulation strategy for three-level NPC converter is proposed in this paper. The basic principle of double modulation wave carrier-based PWM (DMWPWM) strategy is firstly analyzed and deduced. On the basis of DMWPWM strategy, a new modulation strategy is proposed. It deduces the analytical solution of the modulation wave, and added a model predictive control to achieve closed-loop control of the NP potential. Comparing with traditional DMWPWM strategy, it achieves a better control effect. Simulation verification shows that the proposed novel modulation strategy was simple and easy to implement, and it could not only achieve the NP potential balance under full modulation and full power factor but also reduce the switching loss of the devices and improve the system efficiency.

articleTitle: Command current detection algorithm based on Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The detection algorithm of compensation current command signal is one of the key technologies of power quality regulator. The real time nature of the detection algorithm affects the effect of compensation. However, its inherent delay characteristics make the detection real-time poor. In order to improve the real-time of the detection algorithm, this paper proposes an i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-</sub>i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> detection algorithm based on Kalman filter. First, Establish equations of state and measurement for the Kalman filter based on i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-</sub>i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>. Then, the Kalman filter algorithm is used to filter i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-</sub>i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> to obtain DC component, inverting the DC component to obtain the three-phase fundamental current. Finally, the proposed algorithm is simulated by matlab and compared with the algorithm which using Butterworth filter. articleTitle: An Automatic Interpretation Method based on Parameter Threshold for Space Utilization Payloads
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The spacecraft for space utilization usually has multiple space utilization payloads with complex work conditions and a huge amount of telemetry data, engineering data, and application data, thus the overall expert knowledge can hardly be collected easily and totally. Moreover, the data is gathered and transferred to the ground operating control system everyday with high transmission speed and quantity, therefore it is a big pressure to monitor the payload healthy by manually. In this paper, an automatic interpretation method based on parameter threshold is introduced. We designed a time-oriented model to get dynamic parameter thresholds as the expert knowledge by linking the time and parameter threshold directly and designed fast acquisition process for dynamic parameter thresholds and fast automatic interpretation process. The model can be used not only for real time telemetry data but also for engineering and application data. By using the method provided, we can gather the expert knowledge easily and totally, monitor the payload healthy automatically, and get the emergent condition immediately. The method is used in the ground operating control system for space utilization payloads on TG-02 spacecraft. It is proved to be efficiently and accurately.

articleTitle: Study on SF6 Gas On-line Monitoring Method Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of fault detection in GIS gas chambers, a joint fault detection method based on semi-supervised deep learning network for GIS equipment was proposed. Firstly, the SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas on-line monitoring sensors were used to obtain the GIS gas chamber physical index measurement values, and the semi-supervised deep learning network is used to detect equipment faults in the GIS air chamber, making the deep learning network model adaptive. Experimental results show that the semi-supervised deep learning network can effectively detect and analyze the fault types of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: Attribute Reduction of Hesitant Fuzzy Ordered Decision Table Based on Dominance Relation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Attribute reduction is one of the most important areas of research in rough sets. This paper mainly discusses the fuzzy approximate distribution reduction problem of hesitant fuzzy decision tables from the perspective of dominant fuzzy rough sets. Firstly, the triangular fuzzy number and the dominant relationship are used to calculate the assignment dominant relationship between the objects in the decision table; Secondly, based fuzzy lower approximate of the upward and downward, the fuzzy lower approximate distribution reduction is proposed in hesitant fuzzy ordered decision table. Finally, with introducing the significance and relative significance of condition attributes, a heuristic algorithm for computing fuzzy approximate distribution reduction is formed.

Author Keywords: Dominance Hesitant Fuzzy Ordered Decision Approach

articleTitle: Optimization Control of Industrial Boiler Furnace Combustion Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: An improved variable bias control technique is proposed to solve the problem of low combustion efficiency and boiler pollution caused by peroxide and anoxic combustion in the combustion process of industrial boilers. Using the genetic algorithm, the parameters of the offset function, fuel and air of the variable-biased double-crossing limiting combustion control system are optimized, and the optimized parameters are applied to the variable offset cross-limiting combustion control system.
