The furnace combustion system model was established, and the furnace combustion control scheme was designed to verify that the technology improved the combustion efficiency of the boiler and achieved the control goal of the furnace combustion, thereby achieving the purpose of curing the boiler pollution.

articleTitle: A Coding Identification Algorithm for code length and code rate of LDPC
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the channel coding identification system, in view of the low recognition rate of LDPC code parameters under low signal-to-noise ratio(SNR) environment, this paper proposes a coding identification algorithm for code length and code rate of LDPC codes. The algorithm uses the soft information of the channel output, establishes the relationship between coding parity relation and domain of the log-likelihood ratio, and uses the maximum mean square ratio (MSR) decision maker to recognize the finite set of LDPC. This algorithm makes full use of the statistical characteristics of the mean and variance of data, and effectively avoids the defect that the traditional algorithm is not ideal when the SNR is low. Moreover, for LDPC codes with high bit rate, the discrimination of the MSR judgment is very obvious, which can achieve a better recognition effect. Experimental results show that compared with existing algorithms, the proposed algorithm can still achieve better recognition results in low SNR environment, and the recognition gain can reach 2 dB to 5 dB. And when the SNR is higher than 5dB, the correct rate can reach 99%. For the recognition of high bit rate LDPC codes, the recognition effect of this algorithm is much better than that of the existing algorithm.

articleTitle: Approach for GNSS Constellation Based on Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Simultaneous satellite selection is a major challenge of multi-constellation satellite navigation systems today, since real-time positioning using all the visible satellites results in extremely high computation load. Therefore, quick and efficient satellite selection methods are highly demanded in the field of navigation. In this paper, for the first time, artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm is adopted to select visible satellites for positioning in multi-constellation satellite navigation system with minimum geometric dilution of precision (GDOP) value achieved. The proposed approach is evaluated by simulation and the results show that the ABC approach has better performance in convergence and speed compared to that of the conventional particle swarm optimization (PSO) approach.

articleTitle: Accurate 2D Localization for Mobile Robot by Multi-sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To achieve fully autonomous operation for indoor Mobile Robot. Localization solution has become an active research topic in the past decade. Normally a localization system is required to be reliable, fast, and have high accuracy. But single UWB measurement is very discrete and you can not get the exact orientation of the mobile robot. To overcome these shortcomings, we propose a novel UWB/Gyroscope/Odometer-integrated system, in which UWB measures the distance between the tag and the base station through Time of Flight and then calculating the tag position through the triangulation algorithm. Gyroscope and odometer can get the angular and linear velocity of mobile robot respectively. Which can provide accurate short-term tracking performance. The results of multi-sensor are fused using an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). The experiment results also show that the algorithm significantly improved accuracy and get reliable yaw angle.

articleTitle: A Method For Converting PLC Instruction List Into Ladder Diagram
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: By studying the data structure of the ladder diagram and instruction list sentence that can be followed by multiple operands logic, the transformation rules of PLC instruction table into trapezoidal graph were summarized. The instruction table statement adopts a bottom-up, first left and right sequential scanning method to convert the instruction list into a binary tree structure, and then performs the in order traversal on the obtained binary tree to obtain a ladder structure. By converting the test series-parallel configuration command table statement prove the correctness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: An Resilient Cloud Architecture for Mission Assurance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the demand for the continuous guarantee capability of the information system in the diversified task and the complex cyber threat environment, a dual loop architecture of the resilient cloud environment for mission assurance is proposed. Firstly, general technical architecture of cloud environment is briefly introduced. Drawing on the idea of software definition, a resilient dual loop architecture based on "perception analysis planning adjustment" is constructed. Then, the core mission assurance system deployment mechanism is designed using the idea of distributed control. Finally, the core mission assurance system is designed in detail, which is consisted of six functional modules, including mission and environment awareness network, intelligent anomaly analysis and prediction, mission and resource situation generation, mission and resource planning, adaptive optimization and adjustment. The design of the dual loop architecture of the resilient cloud environment for mission assurance will further enhance the fast adaptability of the information system in the complex cyber physical environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Hot Spot Transient Temperature Rise and Ambient Temperature of Oil-immersed Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to study the temperature rise of winding hot spot when the oil-immersed transformer is started at different ambient temperature, the transient temperature field of transformer cold start under different temperature conditions is calculated based on the finite element simulation method. The relationship between the hot spot temperature rise and ambient temperature during the cold start is explored by analyzing the calculation results, which provides a reference for the development of transformer start-up strategies in different environments and contributes to avoiding mechanical structure damage and insulation aging damage caused by temporary high temperature rise at low temperature.

articleTitle: Study on the Time Constant of DC Component and Its Influence on Short-circuit Breaking Capacity of Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: By introducing the time constant of the direct current(DC) component, which is specified by the specification, and the derivation of the DC component, we concluded that the time constant of DC component will affect the short-circuit breaking capacity. We introduced the influences of the time constant of DC component are the structure, the parameters and the loss of the power system, as well as the type of the fault. Combined with an accident of a power plant and some other cases, we proved that time constant which is beyond the specification will affect the short-circuit breaking capacity, and may further affect the safety of the power system.

articleTitle: Indoor sleep monitoring based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper uses a simple portable indoor sleep monitor as the design platform, the sound sensor system and the light sensor system serve as the main sensor module. The sound sensor uses ADC0832 acquisition chip to convert the analog signal detected into digital signal. LM393 comparator and photosensitive resistance are used to compare the signal of ambient light-intensity. DS1302 clock chip is used to provide the system clock with the time of year, month, day, hour, minute and second. STC89C52RC microcontroller is the main control chip of this system, which mainly control the operation of the whole system and realize its corresponding functions. The experimental results show that the performance of the system meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: B1C Signal Modulation Implementation and Acquisition Research
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: BDSIII uses a new civilian navigation signal B1C modulation signal at the B1 frequency. In this paper, the mathematical model of B1C signal is established, and the signal modulation is implemented by Simulink. The autocorrelation function and phase detector curve of the signal component are compared. For the flexibility and diversity of B1C signal acquisition, BOC(1,1) signal and QMBOC are proposed. The signal is captured separately, and the algorithm research principle is mathematically deduced. Secondly, the performance of the algorithm is analyzed and the actual acquired B1C signal is captured and analyzed by MATLAB. The simulation shows that the local pilot component capture can obtain a higher peak-to-average ratio. The peak-to-average ratio is better when the B1C signal is captured, and the overall peak-to-average ratio is improved by about 6 dB. The algorithm research provides a new B1C signal synchronization. The idea.

articleTitle: 3D Mechatronic Structures via Hybrid Additive Manufacturing Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For rapid manufacturing of customized 3D mechatronic structures, this work proposes a hybrid additive manufacturing technology combining dual-material fused deposition modeling (FDM) and selective electroless plating. High-conductive metallic film can be selectively deposited on 3D printed plastic structures made of ABS and PETG plastics. With current used 0.4 mm nozzle, FDM printer could produce the finest conductor of about 0.5 mm wide. Through four-point probe measurement, EDS inspection and SEM cross-section analysis, it was found that the minimal resistivity of Ni-P film was identified to be approximate 8.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> Ω cm, when the electroless plating was conducted at 50 °C and pH 8.5. A demonstrator of 3D LED blinking circuit was developed to testify the feasibility and potential of this technology in industry applications.

articleTitle: A Tunnel Crack Identification Algorithm with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Crack is a common tunnel disease, and the large crack directly affects the operation safety of the subway operations. Therefore, it is very important for tunnel safety to detect the tunnel surface crack accurately. The image processing technology based on machine vision has become the key method of automatic tunnel detection. In the field of image processing, it can be divided into two categories: traditional image processing algorithm and image processing algorithm based on deep learning. This paper uses a multi-stage cyclic filtering algorithm based on morphological processing and connected-domain filtering to extract the suspected tunnel crack region. Then the contaminated neural network is used to discriminate the suspected crack area. This paper uses the Open Source Computer Vision Library to write image processing algorithms in the Visual Studio environment. Construct a convolutional neural network using the deep learning framework Caffe. The experimental results show that the algorithm can realize the tunnel crack recognition under certain circumstances.

articleTitle: On Topological Graphic Passwords Made By Hanzi-graphs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Graphical passwords (GPWs) have been used in the world. Topological graphic passwords (Topsnut-GPWs) differ from the existing graphical passwords and have many virtues in usage of mobile devices with touch screen. In this paper, we design new Hanzi-GPWs based on Hanzi (Chinese characters). We try to transform Chinese characters into mathematical models, called Hanzi-graphs here. We show that a Hanzi-graph $H = \cup _{i = 1}^m{H_i}$ with disjoint Hanzi-graphs H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, ..., H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> admitting set-ordered graceful labelling admits an ε-labellings. Some problems, at the end of this article, are proposed for further research.

Author Keywords: set-ordered graceful labelling; topological graphic passwords.

articleTitle: Study on Equivalent Modeling Technology of Helicopter Complex Skin Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent decades, composite materials have been used in a large number of aircraft applications due to their light weight and high temperature resistance. However, due to the fact that the electromagnetic properties of composite materials are far less than those of pure metals, this poses a challenge to the design of the electromagnetic shielding performance of the complete machine. The current study is rarely to consider the exact structure of skin material. Besides, the exist method can not be applied to the electrically large size airplane model. To overcome these problems mentioned above, the equivalent modeling technology of helicopter complex skin structure is studied. Based on the vertical cross-over structure of carbon fiber prepreg and the multi-angle laying of the skin, the skin structure of the complex helicopter body is equivalent to an isotropic single-layer plate structure with electromagnetic parameters varying with frequency. By measuring the transmission coefficient and reflection coefficient of the typical skin structure of the helicopter, the complex permittivity and the complex permeability of the helicopter were calculated, and the equivalent model of the skin structure was established in the HFSS. Finally, the shielding effectiveness of the skin was measured by the flange coaxial device, and compared with the shielding effect in HFSS, the accuracy of the model was verified.

articleTitle: Process Analysis and Visual Interpretation Platform Design for Agile Satellite Dynamic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Agile Satellite, which has such characteristics as splicing Imaging, multi-attitude Imaging and nonparallel ground track imaging, has higher standards for test assessment of attitude maneuver. It is difficult to validate the complex maneuver mode using the existing assessment method of attitude angle and angular velocity. A platform of process analysis and visualization is designed to solve this problem. A method of calculating imaging trajectories base on the real time test scenarios proposed, to judge the real time imaging indexes such as imaging trajectory and mirror point moving speed. Real-time data visualization platform is also developed based on the two-way communication technology between Matlab and STK. The test results show that the designed platform can complete the process analysis and present an ocular demonstration of the complex maneuver, which provides theoretical references and utilities for system-level test and on-orbit task analysis.

articleTitle: Height Analysis of Planar Shoe-wearing footprint of Young people based on Gray-scale centroid algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the utilization of footprint, height analysis in public security practice, we remake the ink samples of 300 shoes of the 18-25 age group, and use the image grayscale centroid after the grayscale processing of the obtained image. The image gray centroid algorithm is used to calculate the grayscale centroid points of thumb, plantar and heel indentation areas, and the Euclidean distance between the particles is calculated automatically (independent variable X1, X2, X3). The single factor and multivariate analysis of the height of the young population was carried out by using the methods of univariate linear regression and multivariate linear regression. The feasibility of this height analysis method was discussed, and the influence of each factor on the height was also compared. It provides a certain reference for the automatic and quantitative development of height analysis using footprint.

articleTitle: A Novel Spectrum Sensing based joint Relaying and Jamming Method for Secure Relay Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This document proposes a novel joint relaying and jamming method based on the concept of spectrum sensing for secure relay networks. The opportunistic operating frequency point is determined according to the physical characteristics of wireless channels. The proposed method captures `two birds': anti-eavesdrop and anti-interference.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study on Optical Signal Propagation Characteristics of Partial Discharge in Single-core and Three-cores GIL
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Gas insulated metal enclosed transmission line (GIL) is gradually replacing traditional overhead lines and high voltage cables due to its large transmission capacity and low loss. As the basis of studying optical detection of partial discharge (PD), it is necessary to pay attention to the propagation characteristics of PD signals in GIL. Simulation models of the single-core and three-core GIL are established, and parameters of different detection points and planes of the optical signal generated by partial discharge are observed and compared. The results show that in different cavities, the color and symmetry of the detection plane are different, and the horizontal position of the PD source affects the spot and relative irradiance. The optical signals on the detection plane of single-core and three-core GIL have similar changes.

articleTitle: An efficient channel estimation algorithm for CO-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Coherent optical orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (CO-OFDM) system has the dual advantages of coherent detection and orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing technology. It has become a hotspot of current research in the field of optical communication. Channel estimation has a very important impact on the performance of the system as a critical technology in CO-OFDM. In this paper, we present an extra processing added to conventional LS channel estimation to further improve its performance in CO-OFDM system, the simulation results show that the improved algorithm achieves excellent performance with relatively low complexity.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for the Analysis and Synthesis of High Order Directional Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Conventional wireless communication is vulnerable to be intercepted due to the openness of channel. Directional modulation (DM), as one of promising wireless communication technology, can enhance the wireless transmission security. In this paper, a novel DM method is proposed to analyze and synthesize the traditional directional modulation, where the high order modulation structure is exploited. Specifically, we design the DM scheme based on one-dimensional phase array (PA) and synthesize the radiation pattern using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Some metrics such as error vector magnitude (EVM), bit error rate (BER) are also used to assess the performance of high order DM system. Simulation results show that proposed approach can enhance the security without reducing the gain of the antenna.

articleTitle: The Design and Numerical Simulation of Gyroscope Based on Multidirectional Jet Flow Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper reports structure design, sensing principle and numerical simulation of a novel gyroscope based on multidirectional jet flow generator. The finite element analysis method and COMSOL Multiphysics software were used to calculate the airflow field distribution and motion feature in the generator. The results indicate that: (1) When the angular velocity ranged from 0 to 60rad/s along the Z axis was applied, the deflection of flow is increasingly obvious with the increasing of angular velocity and linearly proportional to applied angular velocity. (2) The distance between hotwires and nozzle is L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sub>=1.4-1.6 mm and that between hotwires and central axis of nozzle is L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Y</sub>=0.33-0.35 mm, respectively.

articleTitle: Actuator fault reconstruction based on adaptive sliding mode observer for unmatched nonlinear system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Taking the actuator fault which widely exists in Lipschitz system as the research object, for a class of unmatched nonlinear system with uncertainty, relative order vector is introduced to construct auxiliary output, which breaks through the constraints of matching conditions. The high gain observer is established, and the accurate estimation of auxiliary output is realized. On the basis of the work above, the adaptive sliding mode observer for fault reconstruction is designed. Considering the circumstance that Lipschitz coefficient is unknown, the design method of observer gain is transformed into the convex optimization problem under LMI constraints. The adaptive law is adopted to ensure the sliding mode can overcome the unknown upper bound fault to reach the sliding mode surface. The equivalent output error principle is used and the fault reconstruction is realized. The proposed method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Moth Flame Optimized Adaptive Fuzzy Refrigeration Control Algorithm and Modeing in Air Conditioning Control refrigerated System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the thermal load of the refrigerant, in order to solve the problem of inadaptability of the control parameters of the traditional fixed parameter PID after the thermal load of the environment and the external environment is changed, the problem of controllability instability and control accuracy are not high. An adaptive refrigeration refrigerated truck model controller is designed. Specifically, a fuzzy adaptive control method is used. The optimization method uses a moth flame optimization algorithm (MFO) to adjust the control parameters, reduce the value of error accumulation as the function to be seen, and verify the validity and robustness of the algorithm through experiments.

articleTitle: Simulation of Information Bidirectional Transmission Using Single Switch Receiver in a SWIPT System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to keep the load voltage stable in the simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) system, the information transmission between the primary and secondary sides is required. A SWIPT system with controlled chopper circuit receiver is proposed in this paper. The secondary side has only one controlled power electronic device that enables chopper control. The relationship between the primary phase angle, the secondary controlled device voltage angle and the load voltage is obtained through theoretical analysis. The secondary side adjusts the voltage angle of the controlled device through the feedback control to achieve a stable load voltage. The signal is modulated by changing the power transmission frequency and the switching frequency of the secondary full controlled device to transfer the information forward and backward respectively. Simulation proves that the proposed structure can realize a stable output of 50V load voltage and bidirectional transmission of information at a rate of 2kbit/s.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless information and power transfer

articleTitle: A Wi-Fi based Pedestrian Navigation System using Kalman Filter and Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a Wi-Fi based pedestrian navigation system in indoor environment. The proposed system is constructed by a mobile phone and several Wi-Fi Access Points(AP). User carries the phone on foot while moving in indoor environment at normal speed without any external positioning techniques. The Wi-Fi Access Point are settled in the building, while calculating the distance between transmitter and receiver with the received signal strength (RSS) method. Since the radio wave propagates with the inverse-square law, distance can be calculated based on the relationship between transmitted and received signal strength. The user can be located by Weighted Circular Algorithm. The aim of this work is to acquire accurate results by implementing tow kinds of filters in the positioning framework. Tracking filters are integrated to reduce estimation errors causing by radio signal attenuation and multi-path effect. Regarding to the constant velocity model, Kalman Filter(KF) and Particle Filter(PF) are effective approaches to reduce the estimation errors. Experimental results have successfully validated the effectiveness of proposed positioning algorithms and its associated tracking filters.

articleTitle: Research on Mine Power System Leakage Criterion Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The problem of high false positive rate for mine grid selection method based on single criterion, A new scheme for mine grid selection based on multi-criteria fusion decision based on data fusion is proposed. The scheme extracts the zero-sequence current data of the half cycle after the occurrence of the leakage, Selecting a leak based on signal distance and selecting a leak based on improved gray absolute correlation, D-S evidence theory is used to combine discriminant results to select leaks. Improving the ability to select and judge the leakage branch. Simulation results show that the scheme has high accuracy of leakage identification.

articleTitle: ROI Adaptive Segmentation Method Based on Vanishing Point and Vehicle Height
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In image-based vehicle and pedestrian detection, the region of interest (ROI) divided by fixed ratio/region has poor adaptabilities to changeable road gradient and vehicle body pitch posture, causing excess wasted ROI or incomplete target segmentation of vehicles and pedestrians. Therefore, an ROI adaptive segmentation method based on vanishing point and vehicle height was proposed. Firstly, the method used vanishing point of lane line to get road location, avoiding excess wasted ROI. Secondly, it combined real vehicle height and detection distance to calculate vehicle height in images, complementing ROI boundaries to reduce incomplete target segmentation. Finally, the method used current frame's vanishing point and its derived real-time pitch angle to update next frame's ROI, adapting to road gradient and vehicle body pitch posture by recycling the segmentation-detection loop. Results show the method can get accurate ROI quickly under different conditions, improving real-time performance and accuracy of subsequent target detection.

articleTitle: An Optimized Adhoc Network Routing Protocol For Multi-performance Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved AODV routing protocol based on multi-parameter decision making, combined with multi-parameter decision making and ant colony optimization algorithm, to select the optimal route of adhoc network. The goal is to improve the delivery rate of data packets and the robustness of the network during the operation of the adhoc network. By dynamically obtaining the metrics of transmission distance, node connection reliability, node progress, direction, network delay and node lifetime of each node. Using minimization of three measures, transmission distance, node progress and direction, and node connection and maximization of reliability, network delay, and survival time metric as decision-making basis, the moving probability function in the ant colony algorithm is constructed.The global pheromone is updated by the combination of the constructed function with the local optimal path. According to the above strategy, the selection of each hop node in the routing process will be based on the calculated selection probability. Algorithm simulation with the help of the NS-2 platform, the analysis results demonstrated that the improved protocol packet delivery rate is higher than the unmodified protocol, resulting in better network performance indicators, such as average network delay, routing overhead, packet delivery rate and so on.

articleTitle: Range Migration and Spatial Variability Correction of FMCW SAR Imaging Based on NUFFT
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The paper focuses on the range migration and spatial variability during frequency modulation continuous wave synthetic aperture radar(FMCW SAR) imaging. It presents error with the envelope moving and deducts the mapping relationship in Range-Doppler domain. The traditional algorithm can not correct the range migration effectively, especially to long synthetic aperture, the spatial variability is obvious and has bad effect on imaging. Non-uniform Fourier transform(NUFFT) is applied to Range-Doppler(RD) algorithm to correct the spatial variability. The result from the simulation is that the method can correct the range migration and spatial variability and reduce the computation.

articleTitle: A novel no-reference video quality assessment algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The no-reference video quality evaluation method has become a hotspot and difficulty for video quality evaluation research due to its convenience and lack of reference information. This paper proposed a spatio-temporal domain combined no-reference video quality assessment method. On the basis of no reference image quality evaluation, temporal domain information is added, and multi-layer perceptron neural network(MLPNN) is used for training to obtain a no-reference video quality assessment model. The paper focuses on the extraction and pooling of temporal domain parameters. Standard deviation(STD) and GGD scale parameters extracted from the matching frame difference (MFD) are used as temporal domain feature parameters. Mean pooling of absolute value of differences is adopted to pool temporal domain feature parameters. The proposed framework is trained and tested on the LIVE (Laboratory for Image and Video Engineering) video quality database. The results have demonstrated the proposed method performs well in predicting video quality and it is current state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Voltage Sag Forming Method Considering Transient Process
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Voltage sag forming method considering transient process is proposed to simulate voltage sag caused by short circuit fault happened in infinite grid. Voltage after fault is composed of steady and transient component. Steady component can be obtained by symmetrical component method and transient component can be gotten from damping function. Transient component is not only related to circuit parameters, but also related to fault moment. Single phase to ground fault whose impendence is inductive which is the most common in short circuit fault is chosen as the example to analyze steady and transient component of voltage sag. Then the proposed method is testified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Optimized Trajectory Planning Method via Spline Function Theorems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Trajectory planning of dynamical control systems (e.g., robots and aircrafts) undergoes some constraints on input signals and output transients. It can be viewed as a special class of optimal control problems. But, solving these problems is not an easy task. We consider the optimal output trajectory planning problem of a singal input and single output system with controllable canonical form under some constraints on input and output signals. A novel method is proposed that applies polynomical spline functions to delineate the output trajectory profile. Particular properties on spline functions are proved theoretically to ensure that the constrained dynamical optimization problem is converted to a constrained static optimization problem. The latter can be solved easily through the nonlinear programming approaches (e.g. SQP), where a set of optimal spline functions for output trajectory tracking are derived.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Optimization Of Convolutional Neural Network For Liver Cancer CT Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to classify the liver CT images and make the initial weight of the convolution neural network to the optimal state. We propose a method of combine the genetic algorithm and convolution neural network to classify the liver CT tumor images which can be divided these liver CT images into two parts, have cancer and no cancer. This method used the global optimization and survival of fittest features of genetic algorithms and generated initial weight for convolution neural network by the operation of selection and crossover and mutation. After improvement, learning performance is better than traditional convolution neural network. According to simulation, the method of combining the genetic algorithm and convolution neural network has higher classification accuracy than traditional convolution neural network and support vector machine. It can help medical-aided diagnosis better.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a CMOS charge pump phase-locked loop
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Using TSMC 90nm LP CMOS technology, a CMOS charge pump phase-locked loop is designed. The reference frequency is 13.1072 MHz, the loop bandwidth is 1MHz, and it has a good linearity in the output frequency of 26.2144 MHz- 393.216 MHz. When the output frequency is set to 392.62 MHz, the frequency error is 0.15%, and the duty ratio is 50.6%, which meets the application requirements. The locking time of each frequency point is less than 5μs, and the average power consumption is 427 μA. The PLL layout is designed, and the layout area is 420 μm* 220 μm.

articleTitle: A stereoscopic symmetrical quadruple mass gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A stereoscopic symmetrical quadruple hair gyroscope (SSQHG) based on capacitive sensing is presented in the paper. A symmetrical device architechture is proposed to realize the differential detection of Coriolos acceleration, thereby effectively eliminate the common mode interference of axial acceleration. Four stereoscopic hair masses are adopted to optimize the angular rate sensitivity performance. The frequency distribution simulations based on Finite Element Method (FEM) program ANSYS have been performed to implement the structural parameters identification. An analog closed-loop self-oscillation driving system and an open-loop sensing system are proposed to detect the angular rate. The preliminary experimental results demonstrate that the atmospheric packaged prototype exhibits an angular rate sensitivity of 7.98 mV/°/s with a drive mode frequency of 465 Hz and a sense mode frequency of 500 Hz.

articleTitle: Sequential Inverse Covariance Intersection Fusion Steady-state Kalman Filter for Multi-Sensor Systems with Multiple Time-delayed Measurements
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to settle the fusion problem of multi-sensor systems with multiple time-delayed measurements, a steady-state suboptimal Kalman filter is derived, and the Inverse Covariance Intersection (ICI) fusion method is adopted which can be utilized in the system with unknown common information shared between sensors, and whose major advantage is that it is proved to be more accurate and represents an optimal-consistent and tight-solution to the problem of fusing estimates which share unknown common information. Then the Sequential ICI fusion steady-state Kalman filter is obtained. A simulation example shows the accuracy, the consistence and the tightness of the ICI fusing method, and the effectiveness of the presented fusion Kalman filter.

articleTitle: Study on the method of pseudo distance measurement based on DTMB signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the frame structure of DTMB, this paper studies the method of realizing pseudo distance measurement by using the partial PN code of the signal frame synchronization head to perform correlation operation with the received signal. In practical measurement, the influence of frequency offset on correlation performance is eliminated by square loop structure, and the correlation performance and pseudo range measurement accuracy of PN sequence are improved.

articleTitle: Design of Universal Equipment for Secondary Device in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper studies the necessary technical conditions for realizing the universal interchange of secondary device. Based on the general platform architecture, universal hardware platform and software interface, the conceptual design of universal equipment for secondary device is proposed. According to the characteristics of the secondary device in the smart substation, a universal equipment for secondary devices is designed. The universal equipment can realize the automatic downloading of configuration files of secondary device, covering secondary devices such as protection device, measuring and controlling device, intelligent terminal, merging unit. The universal equipment of secondary device can greatly shorten the development time and achieve standardized interface management.

articleTitle: Research on submarine signal detection method based on Welch algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the periodic graph method and Welch algorithm in classical power spectrum analysis, MATLAB is used as the simulation platform to simulate the submarine's commonly used modulation signals using the period graph method and the Welch algorithm. The results show that the Welch algorithm introduces the method of data segmentation overlap and windowing function, so it can achieve better variance performance and spectral resolution than the periodic graph method. At the same time, the 2FSK signals are simulated and analyzed by using different window functions and overlapping points. The results show that the Hamming window and Blackman window are more suitable for spectral estimation of signals, and the appropriate increase of overlapping points can improve the variance performance and resolution. The effectiveness of the proposed method under low SNR conditions is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Convergence and Control Technologies of IP Network and Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the serious problems in backbone network, such as high construction and operation cost, waste of resources and poor scalability, this paper proposes a model of IP network and optical transmission network convergence and proposes a centralized control technology based on SDN. In this paper, overlay model and peer model are described based on the requirements and key points of convergence between IP network and optical transmission network. By analyzing the characteristics of the two models, this paper proposes a cooperative control technology based on SDN, which realizes centralized control of electrical equipment and optical transmission equipment, and realizes uniform resource scheduling of heterogeneous networks.

Author Keywords: convergence of IP network and optical network

articleTitle: Safety Risk Control System based on UWB and 3D Visualization in Metallurgical Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Accidents caused by the workers who entering the hazardous areas are still occurring frequently because of complex metallurgical operation environment. This paper proposed a safety risk control system based on UWB and 3D visualization in metallurgical operation. The real-time indoor positioning in 3D digital scene and alerting the dangerous states for the workers play a significant role in achieving digital personnel management in the metallurgical plant. This paper studied the application of Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) in personnel positioning and the combinational utilization with three-dimensional visualization technology used to display three-dimensional scenes of the operation area. This system can achieve the metallurgical safety risk identification and grade assessment, precise positioning and dynamic control of field workers and 3D dynamic monitoring of converter operating area. Meanwhile, these functions can be targeted to update by security information statistical feedback after a period. It can be highly adaptable to complex environments and would be of practical values to improve the safety of metallurgical personnel, reliability of security check and man-machine orderly cooperation in working area of metallurgical plant if it would be built and put into application.

articleTitle: Discussion on Cyber Security Awareness and Awareness Model Building Based on Connectionism
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on problems happened under the informatization, such as informatization security, information leakage and cyber-attacks problems, which grow more and more serious, summarize the incidents about cyber security over the recent five years, and analyze risks and flaws of interaction between human and machine. We discuss the meaning and formation of cyber security awareness and build awareness model based on connectionism, and therefore offer a reliable support for practical cyber security system design and cyber security awareness evaluation.

articleTitle: Improved Edge Detection Algorithm of High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images based on Fast Guided Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to achieve fast and accurate extraction of edge and contour features of remote sensing images, a high-resolution remote sensing image edge detection algorithm based on fast guided filtering is proposed in this paper. The algorithm overcomes the disadvantage of losing a large number of edge information when the traditional Canny operator uses Gauss filter to smooth the image. We use fast guided filter instead of Gauss filter to reduce the loss of image edge information and keep the edge information of the image. Then the improved Sobel operator is used to accurately calculate the gradient and direction of the gradient. Finally, the edge of the remote sensing image is detected by the Canny operator. Compared with the previous edge detection methods, the edge detection contour information is more obvious and the pseudo edge is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: The Vehicle Trajectory Estimation Method Based on the Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: GPS has been widely used in the vehicle positioning and navigation due to its global and all-weather features. However, The accuracy of GPS positioning is affected because of the error which is difficult to eliminate by traditional methods. In particular, the vehicle driving in high-rises places of the city, GPS signals may be blocked, failing positioning and navigation functions. This paper proposes an optimal vehicle location algorithm based on information fusion technology. The GPS of the vehicle is the main positioning system, and the vehicle sensors (acceleration, gyroscope) constitute as the auxiliary positioning system. The mathematical model of the GPS system is linear, the Kalman Filtering(KF) method is adopted. The model of the INS system is nonlinear, so the Extended Kalman Filtering method is adopted. Two kinds of methods work simultaneously; the information was fusion effectively. Simulation results show that the algorithm solves the problem of the positioning distortion caused by the signal loss in the GPS system, and improves the positioning accuracy and reliability of the navigation system. The estimated error variance of the system can reach a stable value in a short time, effectively preventing the divergence of the filter.

articleTitle: Study on Simulation Calculation Method of Radar Wind Load Moment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To calculate the wind load moment quickly and accurately, to evaluate the influence of ambient wind on the radar shaft moment, the study on wind moment simulation is carried out. Firstly, a radar model is simplified, wind load moment is analyzed and typical point is calculated. At the same time, based on CFD engineering fluid software, the static wind moment of the radar calculation model was simulated, and finally the wind moment-angle curve was established. The comparison between simulation and theoretical calculation shows that the simulation method of wind moment is correct and feasible. In addition, it can provide reference for antenna equipment contour optimization and reduce the influence of radar wind moment.

articleTitle: Design of simple oscilloscope and spectrum analysis system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To design a simple voltage signal analysis system and realize waveform measurement and spectrum analysis on voltage signals inputted, adopt STC12C5A60S2 single-chip microcomputer (SCM) as core processor and, in combination with waveform shaping circuit, realize the function of period measurement on voltage signals measured, and then have the measured voltage signals transformed into digital signals using the 10-digit high-speed analog-digital converter provided within the single-chip microcomputer itself, followed by the storage of digital signals, thus finally realizing the functions of oscilloscope in combination with the function of period measurement. Realize the function of spectrum analysis on the measured voltage signals by FFT algorithm, and realize the function of display using LCD (liquid crystal display). The test reveals that for the oscilloscope, its frequency measurement scope is 1Hz ~ 5KHz, amplitude measurement scope is 0V~5V, the largest periodic error and amplitude error are respectively 12us and 19mV, and what shown in the frequency analysis chart of sine wave and square wave is basically consistent with corresponding theory.

articleTitle: Based on Multiple Time Series Affinity Propagation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In multivariate time series due to its high dimension, high signal-to-noise ratio and different length sequence of factors leading to poor clustering results, so the article by improving a semi-supervised clustering affinity propagation algorithm tries to solve the problem. The improved algorithm AP_DTW is obtained by using dynamic time warp distance measurement and the affinity propagation clustering of component properties. Then, two experiments are carried out on this algorithm. Experiment 1 is to compare it with the traditional distance measurement method, and experiment 2 is to compare it with the traditional clustering algorithm through ten numerical experiments. A method to verify the validity of clustering was used to evaluate the clustering results in high dimensional time series and the final experimental results were obtained.

articleTitle: Fast Inter Mode Decision Algorithms for x265
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The latest High-Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) standard achieves nearly 50% bit rates reduction for similar quality relative to H.264/Advanced Video Coding(AVC) . However, its complexity is enormously increased ,which becomes one of the most challenges for its deployment in real time applications. The only solution to decrease the coding complexity is to set up different settings by adjusting various coding parameters. Among them, low complexity settings are suitable for industrial applications and conducive to the popularization of HEVC. Traditional fast mode decision algorithms mainly aim at decreasing coding complexity for high complexity settings. In this paper, we propose a fast mode decision method for HEVC with low complexity settings according to machine learning. A decision tree is constructed to decide whether to check 2N×2N mode or the SKIP/MERGE mode by exploiting relevant information from spatiotemporal adjacent Coding Units(CUs). Further mode skipping is performed based on the result of the first step. Experiments show that the proposed scheme can only increase by 1.42% Bjotegaard Delta Bit rate(BDBR) with an average time reduction of 22.45% for HEVC with low complexity settings.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Lock-in Amplifier Based on DSP Builder
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of the digital lock-in amplifier and reduce the logic resources occupied in hardware, this paper designs a modular design scheme based on DSP Builder, making the design of the digital lock-in amplifier intuitive and simplified. This paper designs an internal excitation mode digital lock-in amplifier. After the simulation, the compiled program is downloaded to the FPGA device. The logic elements consumption rate is only 18%, reducing the resource usage of FPGA devices effectively. Experimental results show that the signal measurement error is less than 0.05% when the SNR of the measured signal is -14dB and the amplitude is greater than 500mV. Therefore, the digital lock-in amplifier can effectively detect weak signals.

articleTitle: Study on the characteristics of self-coupling resonator based on microring
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A self-coupled microloop resonant structure which can achieve transparency effect is proposed on the basis of the self-coupled resonator and the microloop resonator.The transmission function expression is derived by the model of scattering matrix, and the transmission spectrum is obtained at last.The results show that the structure can generate coupled-resonator-induced transparency(CRIT)effect.The transparent effect gradually decrease with the decrease of coupling coefficient k and transmission coefficient a. With the increase of R, the transparent effect is almost invariability, but the resonant wavelength gradually increase. Therefore, the transparency effect can be enhanced and the transparent frequency or wavelength that we need can be achieved by changing these three parameters. This study provides some guiding and referential value in the CRIT effect of the microloop resonator.

articleTitle: Research on personalized recommendation of distance education resources based on spark
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the face of mass distance education resource data processing, the traditional collaborative recommendation algorithm is inefficient in single machine. This paper proposes an improved recommendation strategy based on Spark parallel computing model. This strategy can give full play to the iterative computing advantage of Spark and apply it to the recommendation of distance education resources. The efficiency and recommendation quality of traditional algorithm and improved algorithm under distributed and non distributed conditions are compared. The experimental results show that the personalized recommendation algorithm based on Spark computing model can effectively improve the recommendation quality and recommendation efficiency of distance education resources.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Heavy Metal Pollution in Soil of the Daxia River Basin
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: By collecting and analyzing sediment samples from 16 river sections of the Daxia River and the main tributaries, the contents of five heavy metals Pb, Cr, Cd, Cu, and As in the sample data were detected, fuzzy comprehensive strategies were used to determine the heavy metals in the river basin,then made an assessment for the pollution situation . The result showed that the order of heavy metal pollution in the soil of Daxiahe River was Cd>As>Cr>Pb>Cu. Among them, the pollution assessment level of 16 river sections is V1, and it belongs to a clean state. The pollution evaluation level of the 6 river sections is V2, which is still in a clean state, and the pollution level of a river section is V3, belonging to a light pollution state.

articleTitle: Design Research on Submarine Cooperative Combat Simulation System Based on Underwater Self-organizing Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the development trend of submarine underwater cooperative combat and the actual demand for key technology application research, with the use of underwater acoustic sensor network technology, the underwater combat system which consists of underwater communication nodes and submarine nodes is proposed in the paper, and a submarine cooperative combat simulation system based on underwater self-organizing network is also designed. The system fully reflects the submarines cooperative combat "quiet, fast, far, accurate", and can complete the whole simulation demonstration of underwater self-organizing network, underwater acoustic communication, target localization and tracking, data fusion, coordinated attack of submarines cooperative combat. It provides a good testing platform for the development of future underwater combat system equipments and network collaborative combat technologies.

articleTitle: Study on Camera Calibration Error for Rail Profile Vision Measurement Based on Pin-plate Target
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The paper presents a camera calibration error of pin-plate target study method for rail profile measurement based on computer vision. The camera calibration pin-plate target is designed according to real rail profile. The camera for rail profile vision measurement is calibrated by pin-plate target. Both structured light vision measurement model and 1-D camera projection model are established from the perspective of geometric optics to study the cause and value of camera calibration error based on pin-plate target. The results of the experimental study show that the target inclination and pixel offset of pin-plate target have an effect on the camera calibration for rail profile vision measurement. With the increase of target inclination and pixel offset, the camera calibration error increases continuously. It provides an optimized direction and research aim for fast camera calibration method of rail profile vision measurement.

articleTitle: Study of Upper-Limb Exoskeleton Control for Spacesuit
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of China space technology, there is an impact on the outer space operation of astronauts which is imposed by damping torque of spacesuit. To eliminate the influence on astronaut operation by damping torque of spacesuit, an upper-limb exoskeleton was proposed. The dynamic model of spacesuit exoskeleton was established, and the effectiveness of control method was verified by simulation of exoskeleton movement. The exoskeleton proposed is able to decrease energy consumption of astronaut so as to extend outboard working hours.

articleTitle: Research on Pedestrian Navigation Zero Velocity Correction Method Based on Multi-sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Pedestrian navigation is an essential element in people's daily life. In some places where GPS signals are missing or weak, it is difficult to perform normal high precision navigation. As a strong supplement, inertial navigation does not depend on any external signals, but it has a large cumulative error. In this paper, a pedestrian navigation method with multi-sensor correction is studied based on the zero-velocity correction principle. The error source of pedestrian inertial navigation is analyzed and a multi-sensor error correction system is constructed. Based on the inertial sensor gyroscope and accelerometer, the magnetometer and altimeter are introduced to calculate the orientation and height. In the stance phase of pedestrian walking process the velocity and angular rate are reset and the orientation and height from navigation solution are corrected. The Kalman filter method is used to track and estimate the correction error for compensating the inertial navigation result. A pedestrian walking experiment was carried out. The results show that the constructed multi-sensor pedestrian navigation correction system can effectively track the pedestrian trajectory with a horizontal average error of 1.82% and a height average error of 2.53%. Therefore, the method can accurately perform pedestrian navigation and positioning.

articleTitle: Effect of Gas on Sensitivity of Thermal Expansion Fluid Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the effects of gas heat capacity, thermal conductivity, viscosity coefficient and pressure on the sensitivity of thermal expansion fluid gyro were studied. The temperature field and flow field of sensing component were calculated by using COMSOL software. When the angular rate is constant, the gyroscope sensitivity increases with the increasing of heat capacity and pressure, decreases with the increasing of the viscosity and thermal conductivity. When angular rate 20rad/s is applied, the sensitivity of fluid gyroscope sealed CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in the cavity is highest, SFZ=7.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>K/rad/s.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Control Strategy in Distribution Network with Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In distribution networks with distributed generation(DG) and flexible loads, the power of distributed power sources and flexible loads can change greatly in a short period of time. This results in a significant increase in the uncertainty of the distribution network, and the voltages of its nodes have a risk of exceeding the limits. This paper proposes a control strategy for distribution network voltage. By analyzing the real-time status of the distribution network, based on the analysis of the sensitivity between the reactive power and the voltage, the voltage regulation region is divided to adjust the reactive power of DG. Based on the improved particle swarm algorithm, the active power of DG is optimized, so that the node voltage of the distribution network system is adjusted, and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Visual Pipeline Robot Based on Wi-Fi
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A vision-based pipeline robot is studied in this paper, and a strategy of vision navigation is proposed. The key technologies such as anomaly determination of pipeline inner wall, curve identifying and multi-sensor fusion are investigated. The movement of pipeline robot is controlled by robot vision, at the same time Kalman filters are expanded to fuse measurements of multi-sensors to identify the robot in the environment of straight pipe, elbow pipe and T-tube, so as to realize the navigation and positioning of the robot in the pipe. The TCP/IP is used to provide the Socket programming interface to realize remote information exchange for the pipeline robot, and realize the data communication between the host computer and the router. According to standard experimental detecting on pipeline section, the method can meet the detecting requirements.

articleTitle: A Review of Semantic Segmentation Based on Context Information
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Semantic image segmentation, which is one of the basic tasks in computer vision, is the basis of instance segmentation. It predicts the dense labeling of each pixel in an image and is a very important task that helps us to understand the application scenario. This paper mainly studies the fully convolutional network (FCN) of end-to-end training in semantic segmentation. At the same time, it analyzes the problem that FCN can not handle the context well and the segmentation accuracy is low. There summarize the classical methods which are Conditional Random Fields(CRF), dilated convolutions, Multi-scale feature fusion and deconvolution networks, analyze their performance of semantic segmentation algorithm and explore the possible research directions in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the three-dimensional terrain reconstruction system of Four-axis eight-rotor aircraft with binocular camera
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of indoor 3D terrain reconstruction, a 3D terrain reconstruction system based on Four-axis eight-rotor aircraft with binocular camera is constructed. The binocular camera is a shooting tool similar to the human eye that can recognize the depth of field. It is planned to use a self-made four-axis eight-rotor UAV with a binocular camera as the hardware foundation of the system. The drone can achieve accurate indoor positioning by installing an optical flow module. The depth of field image is returned in real time indoors. The receiving end collects the depth of field image of the binocular backhaul, and uses an image stitching algorithm based on the phase correlation method to determine the similar area and adopts the feature point matching method to realize the automatic stitching of the image. The system can use Open CV to represent stitched images as images of depth of field rendered in different colors. The system is used to carry out 3D terrain reconstruction experiments. The results show that the 3D terrain reconstruction images obtained by the system meet the actual needs, which proves that the system has an ideal reconstruction effect on the indoor three-dimensional terrain.

articleTitle: A Robotic Grasping Algorithm based on Simplified Image and Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a grasping method based on convolutional neural network (CNN) and image simplification is proposed to solve the problem of detecting the optimal grasping pose of a parallel-jaw gripper for unknown objects in an RGB-D view. First, the outlines of objects are simplified to remove blurred details caused by the 3D-sensing device. Further, the depth data at the edge of objects is clustered to simplify the complex 3D structure of objects. Then candidates for grasp on the image are selected by force closure and is sent into the Grasp Quality Convolutional Neural Network (GQ-CNN) to estimate the best estimation of grasping pose. A variety of common objects are used for the grasp experiment and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of SAR Jamming Principle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the jamming principle of SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar), three different jamming techniques are analyzed. The principle of coherent deception jamming is emphatically discussed. Taking a typical airborne SAR system as an example, the imaging process of SAR and the effect of coherent deception jamming are simulated. The results show that the effect of deception jamming is not only related to the jamming power, but also to the backscattering characteristics of the protected area. Therefore, in order to achieve the same jamming effect, the required deceptive jamming power is different for the regions with different backscattering characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Open-Circuit Fault Protection and Positioning Isolation of Constant Current Remote Supply System in Cabled Underwater Information Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Fault protection measures and interval positioning isolation methods are proposed for open-circuit faults of the constant current remote supply system, in order to realize the efficient and reliable operation of cabled underwater information network. Achieving the protection of the power conversion module in the trunk node by researching the protection circuit, and based on the controllable electrical switching type switch in the main node of the trunk, the system fault isolation circuit was designed and a new method of open-circuit fault location isolation was proposed. The research content has reference significance for the design and construction of cabled network underwater information network in the future.

articleTitle: Node selection method based on Markov location prediction in vehicle networking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional vehicle network data acquisition is limited by coverage and real-time performance, while the data acquisition method based on Mobile Crowd-Sensing has strong mobility and perception. However, the current research on the data acquisition of the vehicle network Mobile Crowd-Sensing is insufficient. There is no reasonable node selection mechanism, so designing a reasonable service node selection method is a hot topic in current research. In this paper, a reasonable service node selection method is proposed. The Markov location prediction method of Gaussian analysis is used to estimate the probability of each vehicle node to the target area. Then we use the genetic algorithm to select the service node, and finally the optimal service node is output. Experimental results show that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: A low power and ultra long range UAV attitude measurement system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A low power and long range UAV attitude measurement system has been proposed in this paper, which adopts LoRa spread spectrum communication technology. A low power CPU is employed to calculate the data of sensors, including MEMS gyroscope, MEMS accelerometer and magnetic sensor in real time, which is embedded with efficient and powerful internet of things operating system Contiki and advanced multi-sensor fusion algorithm. The experimental test shows that the system can get the attitude information in real time during the long-distance flight, and it enjoys the characteristics of low power, stable performance and high precision, which can meet the requirements of the general UAV attitude measurement.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring and Control System for Bio-fermentation Process Based on Embedded Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The remote monitoring and control system for bio-fermentation process based on embedded Internet was designed. The system applied ARM9 microprocessor and transplanted an Embedded Linux operating system. Four channels input signals of bio-fermentation process are monitored and controlled. The Ethernet interface was expanded and the monitoring and control system was directly connected with the Internet. Users and operators can remote visit and control the system through the WEB browser. The bio-fermentation process field data can be real-time monitored and controlled online.

articleTitle: Research on smart factory model of color TV industry based on Intelligent Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the presentation of the 2025 strategy of Intelligent Manufacturing in China, the transformation and upgrading of Intelligent Manufacturing in various industries is imminent. However, the research theory, construction model and development direction that manufacturing enterprises can follow in intelligent manufacturing are almost nowhere to be found. They need to constantly explore and practice by themselves, and walk out of the road in line with the enterprise itself. Taking the color TV manufacturing industry as an example, firstly, this paper focuses on the construction model of intelligent factory based on Intelligent manufacturing. Secondly, from the aspects of intelligent manufacturing automation construction, information construction, intelligent storage system construction and industrial Internet system construction, this paper expounds in detail how to create intelligent manufacturing closed-loop ecosystem. Finally, this paper describes the effect of the model for manufacturing enterprises which have used the model in actual production. All of this confirming that the proposed intelligent manufacturing model in manufacturing enterprises has a great value of demonstration and promotion.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of Thrust Density for Permanent Magnet Linear Motor Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Electromagnetic catapult takeoff as a new way to take off UAV, can be launched within a short distance UAV accelerated takeoff. Linear motor is the key part of electromagnetic catapult and needs to have the features of small size, light weight and large thrust. In order to improve the maneuverability and large thrust of UAV electromagnetic ejection, this paper presents a genetic algorithm based optimization design method for motor parameters. On the basis of establishing the permanent magnet linear motor model, taking the main structure parameters of the primary core and permanent magnet of the motor as the optimization variables, the thrust density of the motor is the optimization goal, and the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the motor. The results show that compared with the initial motor, the motor quality is reduced, the thrust density is increased, and the optimized design is feasible.

articleTitle: Deformation Measurement Method of Spacecraft Structure based on Speckle Pattern Interferometry and Digital Image Correlation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: On-orbit deformation of spacecraft structure can affect spacecraft’s function and even its on-orbit safety, so it is important to measure and analyze deformation in space simulation environment. A measurement method based on speckle pattern interferometry and digital image correlation is introduced, including measurement principle and deformation measurement method of spacecraft’s structure. For large-scale deformation measurement, digital image correlation method is used. The measurement scale can reach 1m*1m and measurement accuracy is 5um. For small deformation with high measurement accuracy requirement, laser speckle pattern interferometry is used. The measurement scale is 0.1m*0.1m and measurement accuracy is 1um. Measurement experiment is introduced by measuring material of spacecraft structure, and the measurement accuracy influence factors are analyzed. The measurement results show that this method has good precision and can be used in spacecraft’s structure deformation measurement.

articleTitle: Design of Meander Line Dual-Circular Polarizers with Finite Aperture
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A meander line polarizer coupled with broadband step horn antenna is designed to operate in Ka-band satellite communication systems at 29.5GHz. In contrast to normal circularly polarized antennas, this design enjoys simple feeding mechanism and radiating structure. Supporting foam are used both between the antenna and meander line polarizer, and inside the polarizer to provide stability. Meander lines are etched at the bottom side of dielectric plates so that they are not exposed to air and moisture. During the design, it is found that tradition design methods based on formulas or periodic elements work poorly for such meander line polarizers with finite size. Great CP performance with axial ratio below 2dB is achieved between 29 to 30GHz. No gain or matching degradation caused by the meander line polarizer is observed.

articleTitle: Stability Evaluation Algorithm of Filtering Algorithm in Navigation Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To better evaluate the stability of filtering algorithm, the stability evaluation index filtering algorithm is proposed based on the analysis of the factors affecting factors. Then the index system of stability evaluation is constructed with its mathematical model established. Taking the application of Kalman filtering used in initial alignment in integrate INS/GPS navigation system as an example, stability of Kalman filtering is evaluated according to the index system. Simulation results show that the stability evaluation results are in consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Embedding Dimension of Built-in sensor Nonlinear Output
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper studies the nonlinear characteristics of the output signal of a built-in sensor in a smart device when the speech signal is excited. According to the lyapunov exponent calculation, the chaotic characteristics of the output signal are verified. Based on the theory of phase space reconstruction, the FNN and Cao algorithms are used to solve the embedding dimension. Comparing the two results, when the speech signal is used as an input, the embedding dimension of the nonlinear signal output by the sensor is more accurate than the FNN by the Cao solution. It laid the foundation for the subsequent establishment of relevant mathematical models.

articleTitle: Channel estimation for MB-OFDM UWB based on pilot sequence channel shortening
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A novel algorithm is proposed for MB-OFDM UWB based on channel shortening integrating the DFT algorithm. A channel shortening equalization based on MMSE is added to the receiver so that the length of channel duration is shorter than the length of cp. And the combined channel is estimated using the received signals after the shortening equalization. Finally the channel is estimated after deconvolution. It can improve the serious status because of the Inter Symbol Interference (ISI) and Inter Carrier Interference (ICI) resulted in insufficient of length of cp. Simulation demonstrates the proposed algorithm can reduce the Mean Square Error.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control for Six Rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Attitude System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The six-rotor UAV, which redundant performance is better than quad-rotor, was selected as the research object in this paper.
