During the flight of aircraft, it was possible that the six-rotor UAV catch some faults such as sensor fault, software fault and actuator fault etc. In response to the fault condition of the actuator, the control allocation algorithm based on weighted pseudo-inverse was used to redistribute the control quantity to compensate the impact of the failure and ensure the stability of the whole system. Comparing with the traditional fault tolerant control algorithm, the control allocation algorithm adopted in this paper applied the adaptive control algorithm of weight matrix to adjust the actual controlled quantity in real time. The fuzzy PID controller was selected to control the whole attitude system. Finally, the Simulink toolbox was adopted to verify the effectiveness of the fault tolerant algorithm and compare with the simulation diagram that generated by standard system as well as fault system.

articleTitle: The Application of BP Neural Network in Incinerator Model Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Incinerator is a nonlinear, time-variable and strong coupling system with multiple inputs and outputs. According to these characteristics and the complexity of the mechanism in incineration, it is difficult to build an accurate model. This paper proposes a method to identify the model of incinerator using back propagation neural network (BPNN). The BPNN can identify the model via adjusting the weights between the nodes of BPNN according to the error. To train and test the BPNN, 2000 sets of samples were measured. 1800 of them were used in the training of BPNN and 200 samples for testing. After training with the samples and determining the inputs and outputs, a model of the incinerator is built. Through theoretical analysis, the simulation results of the model are reasonable and can reflect the features of the incinerator. So, this model can be used in the analysis of incinerator and its control system.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Acceleration Compensation Mechanism for Piezoelectric Pressure Sensors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Shock wave electrical measurement is the main method for blast shock wave measurement, which can completely record the whole process of blast shock wave, and it is convenient for the analysis of shock wave signal and evaluation of weapon performance. During explosion pressure measurement, serious vibrations and shocks are used to severely interfere with the measuring signals of shock wave piezoelectric pressure sensors. To solve this problem, the source of vibration shock and the acceleration effect of sensor were analyzed. A novel sensor crystal group with acceleration compensation module has been designed. The result of theoretical calculations and ANSYS simulations indicated that the sensitivity of the sensor crystal group to the acceleration signal is greatly reduced, and it is suitable for explosive shock wave measurement in harsh environments.

articleTitle: Structural Learning Of Bayesian Network By Multi-population Bacterial Foraging Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The structural learning is the core of the Bayesian network learning. The study of Bayesian network structure from the sample data is NP-Hard problems, and the current mainstream approach is to combine the heuristic algorithm. The paper uses multi-population bacteria foraging optimization (MBFO) algorithm to study Bayesian network structural learning,. Finally, the algorithm is proved to be more effective in the standard Bayesian network Cancer network, Asia network, Car network than classical structural learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Improving Q-factor of electromagnetically induced transparency based on mirrored metasurface
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Improving Q-factor of analogy of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT-like) based on the symmetric and asymmetric quasi-dark mode has been numerically demonstrated. The Q-factor of EIT-like based on the symmetric quasi-dark mode (mirrored metasurface) is an order of magnitude larger than the Q-factor of EIT-like based on the asymmetric quasi-dark mode. The low radiative loss of the symmetric quasi-dark mode causes the improved Q-factor. Furthermore, the proposed way of improving the Q-factor has important application in microwave, terahertz and optical metasurface.

articleTitle: Interaction with a Electric Wheelchair Using a Laser Pointer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As the population aging becomes more and more serious, WMRA (Wheelchair Mounted Robotic Arms) has been rapidly developed. But it still has many problems in human-robot interaction. In this paper, laser pointer is used as an interactive method for wheelchair. First, the camera acquires the color image, then each channel of the image is carried on the weight process, causing the object with high brightness in the image to reduce. This operation eliminates environmental interference, and then color image is converted into HSV image. The background difference method and target matching method are used to detect the laser point in the home environment. In the experiment, the laser point in the home environment can be well detected, and the laser pointer is used as an interactive interface for the electric wheelchair, which enables the wheelchair to achieve the functions of forward, backward, left, right and so on.

articleTitle: Wavelet Image Compression Algorithm Combined with Neural Network for Feature Points in the Visual Measurement Area
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the feature point region compression in the visual measurement is encoded. First, the wavelet decomposition is used to obtain the high-frequency decomposition sub-image and the low-frequency decomposition sub-image. Second, the low-frequency signal is vectorized based on the improved neural network to form a quantized image. Then, the obtained high-frequency and low-frequency components respectively perform feature point coding point detection based on region statistics to identify the feature point region, and the feature point region and the background region are respectively processed. The feature point region is losslessly compressed by integer wavelet transform, and the background region adopts discrete cosine. The lossy compression is transformed, and finally the high and low frequency images are reconstructed to obtain the final compressed image. Besides, in order to display the characteristics of the algorithm more intuitively, the compressed image is compared with TIFF compression, JPEG compression and literature 3 compression. The experimental results show that the compressed image obtained by the algorithm is high fidelity under the premise of guaranteeing the compression ratio, that is, the feature point region. The information is completely saved. It is suitable for the study of lossless compression of feature points in visual measurement.

articleTitle: Underwater Topography Simulation based on Point Cloud from Multi-Beam Sonar
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of multi-beam sounding technique and point clouds processing technology, more and more elaborate simulation of underwater terrain tended to be possible. Combined with underwater riprap revetment engineering, this paper first briefly introduced the working principle and data processing flow of multi-beam sounding system, and then analyzed some key processing techniques of simulating underwater terrain, such as point cloud acquisition, point cloud filtering, point cloud compression and 3D model construction, lastly showed the simulation effect by the instance. The experimental results showed that the methods of curvature compression and Delaunay triangulation network had good applicability in building 3D models of underwater topography. From the perspective of the constructed 3D model, the underwater topography simulation could not only directly express the actual form of the underwater topography, but also played a good role in assisting the quality inspection and operation management of related water conservancy projects.

articleTitle: Design of Specification for Data Communication Interface in Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) Intelligent System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Formulating the specification for data communication interface in Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) benefits the rapid and healthy development of BRT intelligent system. There are many communication standards adopted in the BRT intelligent system in China and abroad, but less of them correspond to specify its practice application. With the aim to facilitate its rapid and healthy development, the framework for data communication interface in BRT based on practice is proposed. This paper presents a constituent content of the hierarchical model which integrates each specification of the communication protocols that combine with key technology and merits. Whereas the specification discussed has been utilized in many engineering practices, and has made a big difference in solving practical problems.

articleTitle: Research on information system architecture of standardized organization based on data repository
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Standard is the result of the progress of human civilization, the universal language of the world, and the standard promotes the interconnection of the world. It is of great significance to develop the work of formulating international standards, which promotes national standards to the world and gives full play to the role of standardization in promoting economic construction. The overall architecture of information system is on the basis of information network technology, and combines with the practical need of international standard work, and the overall system architecture we designed consists of the four layers of structure, including foundation support layer, data resource layer, application service layer, show layer, and two safeguards, including the information security management, outer interface extension support . It provides reference and basis for the further business architecture design, application architecture design, technical architecture design, data architecture design and security architecture design of the information system.

articleTitle: Circuit Design of Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Analysis of the Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence is a technique by means of collecting fluorescence radiation from the sample excited by X-rays, electron beams, or particle beams. On the basis of the energy spectrum distribution, the qualitative and quantitative analysis of the elements and the physical characteristics of the samples were studied. This paper focuses on the principle, circuit design and implementation of the energy dispersive X-ray fluorescence multi-channel pulse amplitude analyzer. It includes the design of pre-amplifier, main amplifier, pulse forming amplifier, pulse shaping amplifier circuit, baseline recovery circuit, peak discrimination and A/D conversion. This article elaborates on how to design the multi-channel pulse amplitude analyzer with the embedded microprocessor PSoC.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Train Based on Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Research on energy-saving optimization of train maneuvers can reduce train energy consumption. Firefly algorithm (FA) has the advantages of simple operation, better parameter and local search ability. Using the firefly algorithm can effectively solve this type of problem. The traction energy consumption of the train is taken as the objective function, and the mathematical model is established by converting the train speed, time, distance between two stations and working conditions into constraints. Simulation experiments were carried out on the basis of CRH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-350 EMU and Wuhan station to Xianning north road line. First, use the firefly algorithm to find out a train speed transition; then, use this algorithm again to optimize the speed in this interval. The simulation results show that the train energy consumption index is reduced by 20.60% and meets the requirements of safety and punctuality. Therefore, the firefly algorithm can achieve the purpose of reducing the energy consumption of trains.

articleTitle: Locating for Single-phase Ground Fault Based on the Analysis of Transient Recording Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to deal with the problem of single-phase ground fault for electric power distribution systems more accurately,the paper presents a method which is collecting the waveform information from transient recorded fault indicator devices by the master station of a distribution automation system,describes the principle of analytic technique for deep mining of waveform information, analyzes and introduces the characteristics of fault feature genes extracted by different analytic methods and constructing a feature gene set from the fault indicator feature genes attached to each feeder segment that used to obtain the most noticeable fault indicator information and describes the handling mechanism against existing phase-tophase short circuit fault in the master station of a distribution automation system as well as the realization method for Single phase ground fault location and fault zone display in distribution network . The proposed method preserves the original short circuit fault handling mode, display style and user acceptance of the distribution automation master station system, saves development cost and realizes closed-loop control of all faults in the distribution networks.Demonstration is performed for the feasibility and applicability of the method in combination with demonstration projects.

articleTitle: Research on Preparation Condition of Cement Raw Material Based on Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The change of working conditions during the production of cement raw materia will lead to the occurrence of algorithm misalignment and model mismatch in the automatic control system of cement raw material based on on-line analyzer. In this paper, cluster analysis is used to identify the working conditions of raw meal preparation system. First, clustering method is used to identify the raw material ratio and corresponding raw meal components, and then the recognition results are processed, and the template of working condition division is obtained. Finally, the results are controlled according to the recognition results. The practicality of the method was verified by the practical application on site.

articleTitle: Feature extraction of workpiece circular contour based on Sobel operator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the process of circular radius measurement of binocular vision workpiece, the circular contour feature extraction is the key of space arc reconstruction. Due to the texture of the workpiece surface, the interference of the surrounding environment, uneven illumination, the existing algorithm can not accurately extract the circular contour feature. In this paper, based on the Sobel operator edge detection, firstly, the fusion gray value is generated by adaptive convolution operation and DLBP texture feature, and the edge contour points are further screened by using the fusion gray value to the edge points detected by Sobel operator. At the same time, the polar coordinate distribution histogram is obtained and the normal distribution is carried out. It eliminates the interference of noise at complex background and can distinguish the outer contour feature and inner contour feature. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm not only overcomes the influence of illumination, but also has good accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A Faster Vehicle License Plate Localization Algorithm Using Multi feature Fusion Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: the vehicle license plate location algorithm is a widely applied algorithm and is investigated repeatedly. This paper proposed a faster vehicle license plate location algorithm (HPS) that using horizontal point-segment as hybrid multi features that dedicated to License Plate detection (LP) for china's automatic vehicles that with higher accuracy. The collection of multi features that consisted of some special points and some corresponding special segments were chose by edge detection and point-segment clustering. The plate location was determined by sliding box that according to the proportion of license plate character. The result shows that the algorithm has a faster rate of detection, and has a success rate of over 98% which is significantly high.

articleTitle: Dynamic Model of Robot Control System for Measurement Terminal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As one of the important links of the automatic measurement terminal auto-verification pipeline, the upper and lower table robot control system needs to be further improved and improved in terms of reliability, stability and failure rate etc. Based on the micro-structure of the robot control system and the system dynamics of the robot control system, the transfer function model of the robot control system in auto-verification pipeline for the measurement terminal is established. Then, the zero-pole, unit impulse response and unit step response of the model are analyzed by time domain analysis method. Finally the corresponding simulation results are given. The analysis results show that the upper and lower table robot control system is a stable closed-loop control system, the unit step response overshoot is low and the response process is rapid. Therefore, the system dynamics model can effectively analyze the stability, dynamic performance and other performance of the robot control system.

articleTitle: Study on A Kind of Warship Formation Underway Replenishment Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Underway replenishment for warship formation involve many types of warships which distribute in a wide range and need different types of supplies. What's more, the supply strategies are diversified. In order to study the process of underway replenishment scheduling and improve the replenishment efficiency, an analogy is made between the underway replenishment scheduling problem (URSP) of warship formation and vehicle scheduling problem (VSP), and the impact factors to URSP based on the analysis of the similarity and difference between URSP and VSP. The model of URSP is described, and its parameters are analyzed, and the quantitative approaches are given. The heuristic approach is provided to solve URSP, and an example is used to work out the replenishment sequence for ships, the type, quantity and sequence for materials, and the strategy to use. Results show feasibility and the effectiveness of the analogy of VSP and models and algorithm given above are able to provide decision support for underway replenishment of a kind of warship formation.

articleTitle: Research on Solar Tracking Control System of the Space Station’s Solar Alpha Rotary Joint
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A high stability servo control scheme with motion planning and vibration suppression is proposed for solar tracking control of the space station's solar alpha rotary joint (SARJ). The flexible dynamic model of solar cell wing and the electromechanical equation of SARJ are derived. Based on the dynamic modeling, a combined control system including spline motion planning, angle and angular velocity integral separation controller and velocity loop notch filter is designed. Through the simulation verification of solar cell wing solar tracking process, it is shown that the control scheme can achieve better tracking accuracy with large inertia and ultra-low frequency solar cell wing.
